title: 187 Ride or Die
description: 187 Ride or Die brings street racing and combat together in an explosive urban battleground. Race through the gritty streets of Los Angeles as you build your reputation in the underground racing scene. This isn't just about speed - arm your ride with deadly weapons and take down rivals in intense vehicular combat. Switch between driving and shooting as your co-pilot unleashes devastating firepower on enemy crews. The game features a deep story mode following Buck and Cortez as they fight to control the city's criminal underworld. Customize your vehicles with performance upgrades and an arsenal of weapons from machine guns to rocket launchers. Multiplayer modes let you prove your skills against other players in death races and combat arenas. With its unique blend of street racing and shooter mechanics, authentic hip-hop soundtrack, and raw urban atmosphere, 187 Ride or Die delivers high-octane action where only the strongest survive the streets.

title: 2002 FIFA World Cup
description: Experience the drama and excitement of football's greatest tournament in 2002 FIFA World Cup. Take control of any of the 32 qualified nations and lead them through the official stadiums of Korea and Japan. Feel the intensity with aggressive tackles, dramatic diving headers, and bicycle kicks that capture the raw emotion of World Cup competition. The game features authentic player likenesses, official kits, and real tournament structure from group stages to the final. Master the new airplay system for spectacular headers and volleys, while the star player system lets your best performers shine under pressure. Dynamic camera angles and thunderous crowd chants recreate the electric atmosphere of packed stadiums. Challenge friends in multiplayer matches or guide your nation to glory in the official tournament mode.

title: 2006 FIFA World Cup
description: Experience the passion and excitement of football's greatest tournament in 2006 FIFA World Cup. Lead any of 127 national teams through the official qualifying rounds and into Germany for the main event. Feel the atmosphere with authentic stadiums, official match balls, and realistic crowd reactions that capture the World Cup spirit. Master the new shooting mechanics that let you curve, dip and power shots with precision. The Global Challenge mode recreates 40 classic scenarios from World Cup history, letting you rewrite football's most memorable moments. Dynamic gameplay features include aerial battles, physical challenges, and tactical depth that bring authentic international football to life. With official teams, players, and the complete tournament structure, immerse yourself in the journey from qualification to lifting the trophy in Berlin.

title: 25 to Life
description: Choose your side of the law in this gritty urban warfare shooter that blurs the line between cops and criminals. Play as a street-hardened gangster fighting for territory and respect, or suit up as a SWAT officer bringing justice to the streets. Intense multiplayer matches pit law enforcement against organized crime in brutal 16-player online battles. With authentic street slang, motion-captured combat moves, and a hard-hitting hip-hop soundtrack, 25 to Life delivers raw, unfiltered urban combat. In these streets, you're either predator or prey.

title: 4x4 Evo 2
description: 4x4 Evo 2 takes off-road racing to the extreme with over 120 licensed vehicles from top manufacturers like Chevrolet, Ford, Dodge, Nissan, and Toyota. Race through diverse environments from arctic tundras to scorching deserts across massive open-world tracks. The revolutionary career mode lets you earn prize money to upgrade and customize your trucks with authentic parts and accessories. Challenge rivals in intense multiplayer races or tackle treacherous terrain in single-player championships. Dynamic weather and realistic physics push your driving skills to the limit as you navigate mud, snow, and rocky obstacles. With detailed damage modeling and authentic SUV handling, every race becomes a test of strategy and endurance in this ultimate 4x4 simulation.

title: 50 Cent: Bulletproof
description: Step into the gritty underworld as hip-hop icon 50 Cent in this intense action-shooter. Battle through the dangerous streets of New York seeking revenge against those who left you for dead. Experience brutal counter-kill moves that let you take down enemies with bone-crushing style. The game features an original storyline co-written by 50 Cent himself, bringing authentic street credibility to every mission. Unleash devastating combat combos mixing gunplay with hand-to-hand takedowns. Team up with G-Unit members Tony Yayo, Lloyd Banks, and Young Buck as you fight through gang-infested neighborhoods. With exclusive music tracks from 50 Cent and G-Unit, the soundtrack drives the relentless urban warfare. Raw, unfiltered action meets hip-hop culture.

title: Advent Rising
description: Embark on an epic sci-fi odyssey as Gideon Wyeth, a human thrust into an intergalactic war that threatens humanity's very existence. Advent Rising blends intense third-person combat with an evolving psychic powers system that grows stronger as you progress. Switch seamlessly between devastating firearms and telekinetic abilities, lifting enemies and hurling objects with your mind. The dynamic targeting system lets you engage multiple foes simultaneously while performing acrobatic dodges and flips. Experience a sweeping space opera penned by award-winning novelist Orson Scott Card, featuring branching storylines shaped by your critical choices. Master both vehicular combat sequences and on-foot battles across alien worlds. Your decisions determine not only the fate of humanity but which incredible powers you unlock along your journey to becoming humanity's savior.

title: Æon Flux
description: Based on the acrobatic assassin Æon Flux, this action-packed game puts you in control of the deadly secret agent on a mission to overthrow the oppressive Breen regime. Master Æon's signature fluid combat system, combining martial arts, gunplay, and devastating special moves to eliminate enemies with style. Navigate through the dystopian city of Bregna using parkour-inspired movements - wall-run, swing, and leap across futuristic environments while solving environmental puzzles. Switch between stealth infiltration and explosive action as you uncover a conspiracy that threatens both sides of the conflict. Unlock new abilities and weapons as you progress through a story that expands on the animated series' dark sci-fi universe. Experience cel-shaded visuals that capture the distinctive art style while delivering intense third-person combat and platforming challenges.

title: Aggressive Inline
description: Tear through massive urban environments on inline skates in this extreme sports masterpiece. Pull off insane trick combinations across sprawling levels filled with rails, ramps, and vertical surfaces. Master the innovative juice meter system that rewards aggressive skating with unlimited grinding and manual balance. Create custom skaters and unlock legendary pros like Chris Edwards and Franky Morales. Each environment offers complete freedom to explore and discover secret areas, from movie lots to industrial complexes. String together grinds, wall rides, and aerial tricks using the intuitive control system that lets you modify tricks mid-air. Compete in challenging objectives or just session your favorite spots. With a killer soundtrack featuring punk and hip-hop tracks, Aggressive Inline delivers the most authentic and creative inline skating experience ever created, pushing the boundaries of extreme sports gaming.

title: AirForce Delta Storm
description: Take to the skies in AirForce Delta Storm, where you command cutting-edge fighter jets in explosive aerial combat missions. Choose from over 50 authentic military aircraft, each with unique handling and weaponry, as you engage enemy squadrons in breathtaking dogfights. Master challenging missions across diverse environments from arctic tundras to scorching deserts, using advanced tactics and precision flying to outmaneuver opponents. The game features realistic flight physics that reward skilled pilots while remaining accessible to newcomers. Experience intense air-to-air combat, strategic ground strikes, and daring reconnaissance operations. With multiple difficulty levels and unlockable aircraft, every mission offers new challenges as you rise through the ranks to become an ace pilot in this thrilling flight combat experience.

title: Alias
description: Step into the world of super-spy Sydney Bristow in this action-stealth game based on the hit TV series. Master the art of espionage as you infiltrate enemy strongholds, using disguises and aliases to blend in before striking. Employ an arsenal of high-tech gadgets, from lock picks to explosive devices, while executing acrobatic takedowns and engaging in intense hand-to-hand combat. Switch between stealth and action as missions demand - sneak past guards using shadows and distractions, or engage in thrilling shootouts when cover is blown. Experience original storylines that expand the Alias universe, featuring voice acting from the show's cast including Jennifer Garner. Complete objectives across exotic global locations from casinos to military bases, gathering intel and preventing terrorist threats.

title: Alien Hominid
description: Blast through waves of FBI agents in this hand-drawn side-scrolling shooter that started as a Flash phenomenon. As a yellow alien whose UFO has crash-landed on Earth, fight your way through sixteen intense levels using an arsenal of weapons, from blasters to grenades. Master the art of biting off enemy heads, digging underground to ambush foes, and riding on the shoulders of terrified humans. The distinctive art style by Dan Paladin brings every frame to life with fluid animation and explosive visual effects. Team up with a friend in local co-op to double the chaos, or test your skills in challenging mini-games between missions. With its frantic gameplay, screen-filling boss battles, and relentless action that rewards quick reflexes and pattern recognition, Alien Hominid delivers pure arcade mayhem with a twisted sense of humor.

title: Aliens Versus Predator: Extinction
description: Aliens Versus Predator: Extinction delivers an intense real-time strategy experience where three iconic species clash for galactic supremacy. Command the Colonial Marines with advanced weaponry and tactical firepower, unleash the Alien swarm's overwhelming numbers and biological evolution, or lead the Predator clans with stealth technology and honor-bound warfare. Each faction offers completely unique units, abilities, and playstyles across 21 single-player missions. Harvest resources, upgrade your forces, and adapt your strategy as battles rage across diverse alien worlds. No base building here - focus purely on tactical combat and unit management. Experience the ultimate sci-fi showdown where survival depends on mastering your chosen species' strengths.

title: All-Star Baseball 2003
description: Step up to the plate in All-Star Baseball 2003, featuring authentic MLB rosters and stadiums from the 2002 season. Master the innovative Pitcher/Batter Interface that brings strategic depth to every at-bat, reading your opponent's tendencies while protecting your own weaknesses. Create custom players, manage franchises across multiple seasons, or relive baseball history with over 20 legendary teams. The game's refined batting system rewards timing and pitch recognition, while advanced fielding controls let you make spectacular defensive plays. With detailed player stats, realistic ball physics, and dynamic commentary from Thom Brennaman and Steve Lyons, experience America's pastime at its finest on Xbox.

title: Alter Echo
description: In Alter Echo, you are Nevin, a young psychic warrior who must stop his corrupted mentor from enslaving humanity. Harness the revolutionary EchoPlast suit that lets you morph between three powerful combat forms on the fly. Transform into the agile Sword form for lightning-fast melee attacks, shift to Gun form for devastating ranged combat, or become the massive Stealth form to crush enemies with raw power. Navigate surreal organic environments that pulse with alien life as you master the unique Time Dilation system, freezing moments to unleash spectacular combo attacks. Solve environmental puzzles using your shape-shifting abilities while battling bizarre creatures in this ambitious fusion of action and strategy. With its distinctive bio-mechanical art style and innovative form-switching mechanics, Alter Echo delivers a singular sci-fi adventure that pushes the boundaries of action gaming.

title: America's Army: Rise of a Soldier
description: Experience authentic U.S. Army combat as you rise from recruit to elite soldier in this tactical military shooter. Lead your fireteam through intense missions across diverse battlefields, from desert operations to urban warfare. Every decision matters as you command AI squadmates using real Army tactics and protocols. Master the Army's actual weapons and equipment while earning promotions through the ranks. The game emphasizes teamwork, strategic planning, and adherence to the Rules of Engagement over run-and-gun action. Complete Basic Training to learn core combat skills, then deploy to hotspots around the globe. Your leadership and tactical choices directly impact mission success and soldier morale in this realistic military experience.

title: American Chopper
description: Build the ultimate custom motorcycle in this high-octane racing and building game based on the hit Discovery Channel series. Design choppers from the ground up using authentic OCC parts and blueprints, then take your creations to the streets in intense racing challenges. Experience the drama and intensity of the Teutul family workshop as you complete customer orders under tight deadlines. Master welding, fabrication, and assembly through engaging mini-games while managing your crew and resources. Race your custom bikes against rivals across diverse tracks from city streets to desert highways. Unlock legendary OCC designs, rare parts, and exclusive content as you build your reputation. With realistic physics, stunning bike customization, and the authentic American Chopper atmosphere, create dream machines that look as good as they ride.

title: Amped: Freestyle Snowboarding
description: Experience the ultimate freestyle snowboarding rush as you carve through massive mountain ranges in search of the perfect run. Amped delivers an innovative open-mountain design that lets you explore vast terrains without boundaries, choosing your own path down the slopes. Pull off insane tricks and combos using the intuitive control system that captures the flow and style of real snowboarding. Build your reputation by impressing photographers and sponsors scattered across the mountains, unlocking new gear and secret areas. With dynamic weather conditions and multiple mountains to conquer, each run offers fresh challenges and opportunities to express your unique riding style.

title: Amped 2
description: Hit the slopes in this groundbreaking snowboarding sequel that revolutionizes freestyle riding. Carve through massive open mountains across real-world locations from Laax to Mt. Hood, each offering unique terrain and challenges. Master an innovative trick system with Style Points that reward creativity over repetition - link grabs, spins, and flips into endless combinations while the dynamic soundtrack adapts to your performance. Build your reputation through photoshoots and video sessions, customize your rider's appearance and gear from top brands, and explore freely without boundaries. With butter-smooth controls, realistic physics, and the freedom to ride anywhere from backcountry powder to terrain parks, Amped 2 delivers the ultimate snowboarding experience where style matters as much as skill.

title: AND 1 Streetball
description: AND 1 Streetball brings the raw energy and attitude of street basketball to your Xbox. Create your own baller and rise through the ranks in the underground streetball scene, earning respect on legendary courts from Rucker Park to Venice Beach. The game features authentic AND 1 players and their signature moves, letting you pull off jaw-dropping tricks like the Boomerang, Helicopter, and Main Event. Master the innovative trick stick system to humiliate defenders with ankle-breaking crossovers and no-look passes. Build your reputation through Story Mode or jump into quick games with up to 4 players. With its hip-hop soundtrack, trash-talking commentary, and emphasis on style over traditional rules, AND 1 Streetball captures the essence of playground basketball where showing off is just as important as scoring.

title: APEX
description: Build your own automotive empire from the ground up in this unique racing-meets-business simulation. Start with a single concept car and grow into a global manufacturer, designing vehicles that compete on street circuits worldwide. Every race is a showcase for your brand - winning boosts sales and unlocks new technologies. Balance R&D investment with marketing while managing multiple car lines from economy to supercar. The innovative dream mode lets you design custom cars from scratch. With 80 real manufacturers and dynamic market competition, APEX delivers racing with real consequences for your bottom line.

title: Aquaman: Battle for Atlantis
description: Dive into the depths as DC's legendary hero in this underwater action-adventure! Battle through Atlantis and the seven seas, wielding Aquaman's incredible powers to defeat Black Manta and Ocean Master's evil forces. Execute devastating combo attacks, command marine life to aid your quest, and pilot the high-tech Battle Sub through treacherous waters. Switch between Aquaman and his fierce ally Mera, each with unique fighting styles and special abilities. Explore vibrant underwater kingdoms, solve ancient puzzles, and engage in epic boss battles that threaten the ocean's balance. From coral reefs to volcanic trenches, navigate stunning aquatic environments while mastering telepathic powers to summon sharks, whales, and other sea creatures. Fast-paced brawling meets exploration in this cel-shaded comic book adventure that brings the King of Atlantis to life!

title: Area 51
description: Step into the boots of Ethan Cole, a HAZMAT specialist caught in a catastrophic alien outbreak at America's most secret military facility. This intense first-person shooter blends conspiracy theories with visceral combat as you battle through Area 51's compromised corridors. Wield both human military weapons and devastating alien technology while uncovering a government cover-up decades in the making. Experience the horror of mutating into an alien-human hybrid, gaining superhuman abilities at the cost of your humanity. Team up in squad-based combat with AI teammates or friends in multiplayer modes. Navigate through authentically recreated sections of the legendary base, from hangars housing recovered UFOs to underground laboratories conducting forbidden experiments. With voice acting from David Duchovny and Powers Boothe, Area 51 delivers a cinematic campaign that transforms from military shooter to survival horror as the alien threat evolves.

title: Armed and Dangerous
description: Blast through a wild adventure as Roman, leader of the Lionhearts - a band of misfit thieves out to steal the Book of Rule from the evil King Forge. Armed and Dangerous delivers outrageous third-person shooting with the most insane weapons ever conceived. Wield the Land Shark Gun that launches ravenous sharks through solid ground, flip the world upside down with the Topsy-Turvy bomb, or unleash the planet-destroying Harbinger. Team up with a tea-obsessed robot, a mole-man demolitions expert, and a Scottish giant in this comedic action romp. Experience massive battles with hundreds of enemies, commandeer gun turrets, pilot jetpacks, and defend your pub hideout from waves of attackers. With its British humor, memorable characters, and arsenal of ridiculous weapons, this shooter turns genre conventions on their head.

title: American Chopper 2: Full Throttle
description: Build the ultimate custom motorcycle and hit the road in American Chopper 2: Full Throttle, where the famous Teutul family brings their legendary bike-building expertise to your console. Design and construct radical choppers from the ground up using authentic OCC parts and blueprints, then take your creations out for intense street races and stunt challenges across diverse environments. Experience the thrill of crafting unique bikes with hundreds of customization options including frames, engines, paint jobs, and chrome details. Race through city streets, desert highways, and mountain roads while pulling off insane stunts and competing in various game modes. The game captures the spirit of the hit TV show with the Teutuls' signature style and attitude, delivering both creative building mechanics and adrenaline-pumping racing action.

title: AMF Bowling 2004
description: Step up to the lanes in AMF Bowling 2004, where authentic bowling action meets arcade excitement. Choose from diverse bowling alleys, each with unique atmospheres and lane conditions that affect your game. Create your custom bowler with detailed appearance options and develop their skills through career mode. Master realistic ball physics with adjustable spin, power, and angle controls for strikes and spares. Challenge friends in multiplayer tournaments or tackle solo championships across multiple difficulty levels. Special game modes include trick shot challenges and mini-games that test your precision. With responsive controls, dynamic pin physics, and professional commentary, AMF Bowling 2004 delivers the complete bowling experience from your couch.

title: AMF Xtreme Bowling
description: AMF Xtreme Bowling transforms traditional bowling into an adrenaline-pumping arcade experience. Choose from diverse characters with unique bowling styles and compete across fantastical lanes that defy physics - from volcanic craters to frozen tundras. Master power-ups like explosive balls and lightning strikes that demolish pins in spectacular fashion. The game features multiple modes including tournament play, head-to-head battles, and trick shot challenges where creativity scores big. Customize your bowler's appearance and equipment while unlocking secret lanes and special balls. With responsive controls that make strikes satisfying and splits manageable, plus party modes supporting up to four players, AMF Xtreme Bowling delivers arcade bowling action that's accessible yet challenging. Turn up the music, unleash the power-ups, and experience bowling like never before.

title: Animaniacs: The Great Edgar Hunt
description: Join Wakko, Yakko, and Dot in this hilarious 3D platforming adventure as they race to stop the evil King Salazar from using Edgar's powerful gems to take over the world! Explore five massive movie studio lots inspired by classic film genres - from spooky horror sets to wild west towns and prehistoric jungles. Master each Warner's unique abilities: Yakko's paddle ball grappling, Wakko's mallet mayhem, and Dot's charming powers to overcome obstacles and defeat enemies. Collect film canisters, solve puzzles, and unlock classic Animaniacs cartoon clips as rewards. With the trio's signature slapstick humor, witty one-liners, and fourth-wall breaking antics, every moment captures the beloved show's zany spirit in an action-packed gaming experience.

title: Antz Extreme Racing
description: DreamWorks' neurotic ant Z races for glory in this insect-sized kart racer. Speed through environments from the film including Central Park, the colony tunnels, and Insectopia while dodging hazards like raindrops and human feet. Play as Z, Princess Bala, General Mandible and other movie characters, each with unique vehicles from leaf boats to beetle shells. Battle modes add combat to the racing with weapons like water balloons and sticky honey traps. While aimed at younger players, the game's creative track design and movie authenticity make it a decent entry in the crowded mascot racer genre.

title: Arctic Thunder
description: Race through frozen wastelands at breakneck speeds in Arctic Thunder, the extreme snowmobile racing game that takes winter sports to the edge. Tear across 12 treacherous tracks spanning everything from Himalayan peaks to Swiss Alps villages, each packed with deadly obstacles, massive jumps, and secret shortcuts. Choose from 10 unique riders and customize your sled with outrageous weapons and power-ups including atomic snowballs, proximity mines, and shield blasts. Battle through championship mode or go head-to-head in split-screen multiplayer mayhem. With arcade-style physics that let you pull off insane aerial tricks and boost pads that send you flying, Arctic Thunder delivers pure adrenaline-fueled racing action where anything goes and only the most aggressive riders survive the frozen fury.

title: Arena Football
description: Arena Football brings the hard-hitting indoor gridiron action to Xbox with all the intensity of the real AFL. Experience the unique 50-yard field with rebound nets that keep the ball in play, creating non-stop offensive shootouts. Control all 20 AFL teams with authentic rosters and playbooks designed for this high-scoring variant of football. The game features 8-on-8 gameplay where receivers can use the walls to their advantage, quarterbacks become dual threats, and defensive backs must cover multiple levels. Master the ironman rules where players handle both offense and defense. Engage in Season, Playoff, and Exhibition modes with full AFL presentation including team-specific entrances and arena atmospheres. Fast-paced arcade-style action meets strategic depth in this faithful recreation of arena football's explosive entertainment.

title: Army Men: Major Malfunction
description: Join the Green Army in a hilarious action-adventure as Sarge battles through a malfunctioning toy world! When Major Malfunction's experimental portal device goes haywire, everyday household environments transform into epic battlefields. Navigate kitchen counters, backyard gardens, and basement workshops while fighting rogue Tan Army forces and bizarre hybrid enemies. Switch between classic plastic soldier combat and powerful Plastro Laser weapons. Team up with colorful allies like Vikki Grimm and Riff as you platform across oversized furniture, commandeer toy vehicles, and use household items as strategic cover. With its unique blend of third-person shooting, platforming puzzles, and tongue-in-cheek humor, this miniature war brings big laughs and explosive action to the timeless toy soldier universe.

title: Army Men: Sarge's War
description: In Army Men: Sarge's War, lead the legendary green plastic soldier Sarge through a darker, grittier battlefield where the Tan Army has unleashed devastating weapons. Experience intense third-person combat across sprawling environments from backyards to beaches, wielding an arsenal of miniature military hardware including rifles, bazookas, flamethrowers, and grenades. Navigate through realistic household settings transformed into war zones, using everyday objects as cover and tactical advantages. Drive vehicles, command allied troops, and engage in brutal plastic warfare with enhanced graphics and destructible environments. This mature take on the Army Men franchise features a revenge-driven storyline as Sarge battles to avenge his fallen squad. With improved AI, strategic gameplay, and both single-player campaign and multiplayer modes, prepare for plastic combat that's never been more serious or explosive.

title: Arx Fatalis
description: Descend into the sprawling underground world of Arx Fatalis, where humanity has been forced to live in vast subterranean caverns after the sun vanished from the sky. Master an innovative gesture-based magic system where you draw runes in real-time to cast spells, combining elements for devastating effects. Explore interconnected levels filled with ancient secrets, deadly creatures, and rival factions vying for power. Craft weapons, brew potions, and cook food to survive the harsh depths. Your choices shape alliances with goblins, trolls, and other races as you uncover a sinister plot threatening all life underground. This immersive first-person RPG blends atmospheric dungeon crawling with dynamic combat and environmental puzzles in a richly detailed dark fantasy setting.

title: Atari Anthology
description: Relive gaming's golden age with Atari Anthology, the ultimate collection featuring 85 classic arcade and Atari 2600 games. Experience legendary titles like Asteroids, Centipede, Missile Command, and Pong in their original glory or enhanced with updated graphics and sound. Navigate through an interactive 3D arcade gallery where each cabinet holds gaming history. Unlock bonus content including vintage commercials, game manuals, and developer interviews as you play. Challenge friends with multiplayer modes, compete for high scores, and discover hidden easter eggs throughout the collection. From paddle controllers to trackballs, authentic control schemes preserve the original feel while modern options provide accessibility. Whether you're a nostalgic veteran or curious newcomer, this comprehensive anthology delivers the definitive Atari experience with timeless gameplay that defined generations.

title: ATV: Quad Power Racing 2
description: Rev up your engines and conquer extreme terrain in ATV: Quad Power Racing 2, where off-road racing meets pure adrenaline. Master challenging tracks across diverse environments from dusty deserts to muddy forests, each demanding different racing strategies. Pull off insane tricks and stunts to build your boost meter, then unleash turbo speed to leave competitors in your dust. Choose from multiple game modes including Championship, Single Race, and Freestyle competitions. Customize your ATV with performance upgrades and unlock new vehicles as you progress. The innovative trick system lets you chain combos for maximum points while the physics engine delivers realistic handling that rewards skilled riders. Face off against aggressive AI opponents or challenge friends in split-screen multiplayer battles.

title: Auto Modellista
description: Auto Modellista revolutionizes racing with its distinctive cel-shaded art style that makes every race look like a living manga. Choose from over 60 licensed vehicles spanning classic Japanese tuners, American muscle, and European exotics, then customize them with extensive visual and performance modifications. The unique Garage Battle mode lets you build your racing team and compete for territory across Japan's mountain passes and city circuits. Master the arcade-style handling that rewards aggressive driving and perfect drift angles through iconic courses like Shutokou highway and winding touge roads. The game's striking visual presentation combines with a pulsing electronic soundtrack to create an unmistakably stylish racing experience that stands apart from traditional simulators.

title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
description: Master the four elements as Aang or Prince Zuko in this action-adventure based on the beloved animated series. Switch between characters to harness unique bending abilities - unleash devastating fire blasts, create earth barriers, manipulate water flows, and command powerful air currents. Journey through iconic locations from the show including Ba Sing Se, the Fire Nation, and the North Pole while battling Fire Nation soldiers and solving environmental puzzles. Combine bending powers in spectacular combo attacks, unlock new techniques as you progress, and experience an original storyline that expands the Avatar universe. Features drop-in cooperative play, allowing a friend to join as your companion character at any time. Immerse yourself in cel-shaded visuals that capture the show's distinctive art style.

title: Azurik: Rise of Perathia
description: In the mystical realm of Perathia, you are Azurik, a young Lore Guardian wielding the legendary Axion - a staff that channels the elemental forces of Earth, Fire, Water, and Air. Battle through vast interconnected worlds filled with ancient puzzles and fierce creatures as you seek to restore balance to a land torn by chaos. Master devastating elemental combos, solve environmental challenges using your powers, and unlock new abilities as you grow stronger. From scorching deserts to frozen tundras, each realm tests your combat skills and puzzle-solving prowess. This Xbox exclusive action-adventure blends intense melee combat with platforming challenges, offering a unique elemental magic system that rewards experimentation and mastery.

title: Backyard Wrestling: Don't Try This at Home
description: Step into the most outrageous wrestling experience ever created! Backyard Wrestling brings brutal, no-holds-barred combat to unconventional arenas where anything goes. Battle through strip clubs, meat lockers, truck stops, and junkyards using everything from barbed wire bats to weed whackers as weapons. Create devastating combos with over 40 bone-crushing moves and environmental attacks. Play as underground wrestling legends and hip-hop personalities including members of Insane Clown Posse. Experience intense multiplayer mayhem with friends or dominate the single-player campaign. With its raw presentation, controversial content, and emphasis on extreme violence over traditional wrestling rules, this game delivers an unapologetically hardcore fighting experience that pushes boundaries.

title: Backyard Wrestling 2: There Goes the Neighborhood
description: Backyard Wrestling 2 takes the brutal action out of the ring and into suburban America. Create your own wrestler and battle through interactive environments packed with weapons and environmental hazards. Fight in strip clubs, truck stops, and backyard parties using everything from weed whackers to exploding cars. The game features a deep create-a-wrestler mode, intense multiplayer battles, and a roster including wrestling legends and underground fighters. Smash opponents through windows, toss them into pools of acid, or slam them onto barbecue grills. With its over-the-top violence, destructible environments, and outrageous special moves, this sequel delivers hardcore wrestling action where anything goes and every object becomes a weapon in your quest for backyard supremacy.

title: Bad Boys: Miami Takedown
description: Experience the explosive action of the Bad Boys universe in this intense third-person shooter based on the hit movie franchise. Play as Miami detectives Mike Lowrey and Marcus Burnett as they take down drug cartels and criminal syndicates across the sun-soaked streets of Miami. Switch between both characters, each with unique abilities - Mike's speed and agility complement Marcus's strength and firepower. Engage in high-octane shootouts, spectacular car chases, and destructive combat sequences. Navigate through diverse Miami locations from neon-lit clubs to dangerous docks. The game features cinematic camera angles, over-the-top action set pieces, and wise-cracking dialogue true to the films. Arsenal includes pistols, shotguns, assault rifles, and explosive weapons to unleash maximum carnage.

title: Baldur's Gate: Dark Alliance
description: Embark on an epic hack-and-slash adventure through the Forgotten Realms in this action-RPG masterpiece. Choose from three unique heroes - a dwarven fighter, elven sorceress, or human archer - each with distinct abilities and playstyles. Battle through the dark underbelly of Baldur's Gate, from rat-infested sewers to frozen mountain peaks, facing over 25 types of monsters including deadly beholders and frost giants. Master devastating combos and magical abilities while collecting powerful weapons and armor. Experience the thrill of local co-op as you and a friend unleash chaos together. With its intuitive controls, stunning visuals for its era, and addictive loot system, Dark Alliance delivers pure action-RPG excitement that keeps you coming back for more.

title: Baldur's Gate: Dark Alliance II
description: Embark on an epic hack-and-slash adventure through the Forgotten Realms in this action-packed sequel. Choose from five unique heroes including a Barbarian, Monk, Necromancer, Cleric, and Rogue, each with distinct abilities and playstyles. Battle through over 80 levels of dungeons, forests, and treacherous mountain passes while facing hordes of enemies and massive bosses. Master the innovative item crafting system to forge powerful weapons and armor. Team up with a friend in seamless local co-op to tackle challenging quests and uncover legendary treasures. With deep character customization, hundreds of unique items, and multiple difficulty modes, every playthrough offers fresh challenges. Experience refined combat mechanics and stunning visuals that push the boundaries of action-RPGs.

title: Barbarian
description: Enter brutal arena combat where 11 fierce warriors clash with devastating weapons in fully destructible environments. This 3D fighting game delivers Power Stone-inspired arena battles where every object becomes a potential weapon - smash pillars, shatter walls, and wield the debris against your opponents. Each fighter brings unique weapons and combat styles, from massive warhammers to swift blades, with alternate costumes unlocking different default weapons for varied gameplay approaches. The environmental destruction system transforms each battle as arenas crumble under the force of combat, creating dynamic battlegrounds where tactical use of your surroundings determines victory. Master the art of weapon-based combat while turning the very arena into your arsenal in this savage test of strength and strategy.

title: Barbie Horse Adventures: Wild Horse Rescue
description: Join Barbie on an exciting equestrian adventure across stunning wilderness landscapes! Explore vast open environments on horseback as you search for wild horses that have mysteriously disappeared from the stable. Master your riding skills to navigate challenging terrain including forests, mountains, and meadows while solving puzzles and completing quests. Bond with different horses, each with unique abilities, and customize them with various accessories. Race against time in thrilling chase sequences, perform spectacular jumps, and use special items to overcome obstacles. Features multiple gameplay modes including exploration, racing, and horse care activities. Help Barbie uncover the mystery behind the missing horses while experiencing the freedom of horseback riding in this family-friendly adventure that combines action, puzzle-solving, and horse management elements.

title: The Bard's Tale
description: The Bard's Tale delivers a wickedly funny action-RPG experience that gleefully mocks fantasy genre conventions. You play as the Bard, a selfish rogue whose magical lute summons creatures to fight alongside him - from lightning-shooting electric spiders to healing unicorns. Combat blends hack-and-slash action with strategic summoning as you switch between sword, bow, and dirk while your musical companions provide support. The game's sharp wit shines through constant fourth-wall breaking humor, with the narrator mockingly commenting on your every move. Choose between snarky or nice responses that affect your path through this Celtic-inspired world filled with beer-loving dwarves, temperamental princesses, and zombie dance numbers. With over 14 hours of hilarious dialogue, 50 enemy types, and 16 magical summons, this irreverent adventure turns RPG tropes on their head.

title: Bass Pro Shops: Trophy Hunter 2007
description: Experience the ultimate hunting and fishing adventure across North America's most pristine wilderness areas. Track and hunt over 20 species of big game including deer, elk, bear, and moose using authentic gear from Bass Pro Shops. Master realistic animal behaviors and use calls, scents, and camouflage to outsmart your prey. Cast your line in scenic lakes and rivers to catch trophy bass, trout, and more. Navigate diverse environments from dense forests to open plains with dynamic weather and seasonal changes. Complete challenging missions, participate in tournaments, and build your trophy collection. Features include realistic ballistics, multiple hunting techniques, and a variety of licensed firearms and fishing equipment. Whether stalking a massive bull elk or reeling in a record-breaking bass, every hunt tests your outdoor skills.

title: Batman Begins
description: Based on Christopher Nolan's dark reimagining of the Dark Knight's origin, Batman Begins delivers an intense action-adventure experience through the streets and rooftops of Gotham City. Master the art of fear as you employ stealth, intimidation, and combat to strike terror into criminals' hearts. Use Batman's arsenal including batarangs, smoke bombs, and the legendary Batmobile in explosive chase sequences. The innovative fear system lets you manipulate enemies' psychology, causing panic and confusion among their ranks. Blend martial arts combat with detective work as you uncover Scarecrow's sinister plot. From Wayne Manor's training grounds to Arkham Asylum's twisted corridors, experience Batman's transformation from man to legend in this faithful adaptation that captures the film's noir atmosphere and brutal combat style.

title: Batman: Dark Tomorrow
description: Step into the cowl of the Dark Knight in this action-adventure that pushes Batman to his limits. Navigate Gotham's shadowy streets using stealth, detective skills, and an arsenal of gadgets to uncover a sinister plot threatening the entire world. Face off against iconic villains including Ra's al Ghul, Scarecrow, and Mr. Freeze in brutal hand-to-hand combat and tense boss battles. Employ Batman's full range of abilities - from grappling across rooftops to analyzing crime scenes with high-tech equipment. The game features a dark, atmospheric storyline where your choices determine humanity's fate, with multiple endings based on your actions. Master combo-based fighting, solve environmental puzzles, and use the Batcave's resources to upgrade your gear as you race against time to prevent global catastrophe.

title: Batman: Rise of Sin Tzu
description: Step into the shadows as the Dark Knight in this action-packed beat 'em up adventure. Battle through Gotham's crime-infested streets as Batman faces a deadly new threat - the mysterious Sin Tzu, a master strategist orchestrating chaos across the city. Master Batman's signature combat moves, gadgets, and stealth tactics while taking down waves of thugs and iconic villains including Scarecrow, Clayface, and Bane. Team up with Robin, Batgirl, or Nightwing in cooperative gameplay to execute devastating combo attacks. Explore atmospheric locations from Arkham Asylum to the Gotham docks, using detective skills to uncover Sin Tzu's sinister plot. With fluid martial arts combat, environmental takedowns, and authentic Dark Knight atmosphere, deliver justice to Gotham's underworld.

title: Batman Vengeance
description: Step into the cape and cowl of the Dark Knight in this action-packed adventure based on the animated series. Batman Vengeance delivers intense combat as you battle Gotham's most notorious villains including The Joker, Harley Quinn, Mr. Freeze, and Poison Ivy across 19 massive levels. Master Batman's arsenal of gadgets including Batarangs, grappling hooks, and smoke bombs while solving environmental puzzles and uncovering a sinister plot threatening the city. Drive the Batmobile and pilot the Batplane in thrilling vehicular segments. The game features fluid hand-to-hand combat, stealth takedowns, and detective work true to Batman's character. With cel-shaded graphics capturing the animated series' distinctive style and voice acting from the show's cast, experience an authentic Dark Knight adventure where strategy matters as much as strength.

title: Battle Engine Aquila
description: Command blazing war machines across epic battlefields in Battle Engine Aquila, where you pilot the legendary Aquila battle walker to defend humanity's last hope. Switch between agile jet mode for aerial combat and devastating walker mode for ground assaults as you lead allied forces against the invading Forseti Empire. Master diverse weaponry from rapid-fire cannons to devastating plasma weapons while commanding tank battalions and air squadrons in massive combined-arms warfare. Navigate varied terrains from scorched deserts to frozen wastelands, adapting your tactics as dynamic weather affects visibility and combat. Experience an intense campaign where your decisions determine which territories to defend and which allies survive the relentless enemy advance.

title: Battlefield 2: Modern Combat
description: Command the battlefield in this intense console-exclusive entry in the legendary Battlefield series. Lead squads across massive maps featuring destructible environments and dynamic weather that changes tactical situations. Master the revolutionary HotSwap system to instantly jump between any soldier on the battlefield, turning the tide of war with strategic body-hopping. Command tanks, helicopters, and armored vehicles in epic 24-player online battles across diverse theaters from frozen tundras to scorching deserts. Experience a gripping single-player campaign spanning global hotspots or dive into addictive multiplayer modes including Conquest and Capture the Flag. With refined console controls and stunning visuals, Modern Combat delivers the ultimate large-scale warfare experience.

title: Battlestar Galactica
description: Based on the 2003 Battlestar Galactica series, this space combat game puts you in the cockpit of a Colonial Viper or Cylon Raider in humanity's desperate fight for survival. Engage in intense dogfights across 16 missions spanning both single-player campaign and multiplayer battles. Master authentic flight controls as you weave through asteroid fields, defend the fleet from Cylon attacks, and execute precision bombing runs on enemy basestars. Switch between multiple fighter craft including the nimble Viper Mark II and heavily-armed Raptor. Experience signature moments from the show while creating your own legend as either human or Cylon pilot. Features full Xbox Live support for 8-player battles across multiple game modes.

title: Beat Down: Fists of Vengeance
description: Beat Down: Fists of Vengeance throws you into a gritty underworld where five fugitives fight for survival against the mafia syndicate that betrayed them. Choose your fighter and unleash brutal combos in this unique blend of beat 'em up action and RPG elements. Recruit gang members to build your crew, customize your appearance to avoid detection, and engage in intense street fights across Las Vegas. The innovative Respect system lets you intimidate enemies or negotiate your way out of trouble. Switch between different fighting styles, wield various weapons, and execute devastating team attacks with your recruited allies. Navigate the seedy underground of casinos, back alleys, and nightclubs as you hunt down the crime bosses who set you up, building your reputation and power along the way.

title: Beyond Good & Evil
description: Take on the role of Jade, an investigative reporter with a camera and a staff, as she uncovers a planet-spanning conspiracy in this beloved action-adventure. Team up with your uncle Pey'j and the resistance group IRIS to expose the truth behind the alien DomZ invasion threatening your home world of Hillys. Seamlessly blend stealth, combat, puzzle-solving and photography as you infiltrate enemy bases, document evidence of corruption, and battle both DomZ creatures and the supposedly protective Alpha Sections military force. Navigate diverse environments from city hubs to underground caverns using your hovercraft. Capture photos of wildlife to earn credits, engage in vehicle races, and explore a rich world filled with anthropomorphic characters and political intrigue.

title: Bicycle Casino
description: Experience the famous Bicycle Casino's card room atmosphere without leaving home. Texas Hold'em, Omaha, Seven Card Stud, and other poker variants feature realistic AI opponents with distinct playing styles and tells. The career mode starts at low-stakes tables, earning your way to high-roller rooms through skillful play. Learn from tutorial modes that teach advanced concepts like pot odds and position play. Blackjack, Pai Gow, and other casino games round out the package. While visually basic, the poker AI is surprisingly competent, making this a solid training ground for aspiring card sharks before online poker's explosion.

title: Big Mutha Truckers
description: Big Mutha Truckers puts you behind the wheel in a wild trucking adventure across America's heartland. Race against time to deliver cargo while building your trucking empire through wheeling and dealing. Choose from four colorful Jackson siblings, each with unique personalities, as you navigate treacherous routes filled with bikers, corrupt cops, and rival truckers. Master the art of supply and demand by buying low and selling high across different cities. Customize and upgrade your massive 18-wheeler with performance parts and defensive equipment. Experience outrageous humor, arcade-style driving physics, and explosive action as you dodge traffic, outrun the law, and complete dangerous delivery missions. From bar room brawls to highway mayhem, prove you've got what it takes to become the ultimate trucker tycoon in this over-the-top racing and trading game that combines business strategy with pedal-to-the-metal action.

title: Big Mutha Truckers 2: Truck Me Harder
description: Haul cargo across America in this outrageous trucking sequel that cranks up the humor and action. Race through diverse environments from dusty deserts to neon-lit cities as you build your trucking empire. Choose from multiple characters, each with unique storylines and special abilities. Master dangerous delivery missions while dodging rival truckers, biker gangs, and corrupt cops. Upgrade your rig with nitrous boosts, armor plating, and custom paint jobs. The dynamic economy system lets you buy low and sell high across different counties. Engage in high-speed chases, ram competitors off the road, and use dirty tricks to stay ahead. With arcade-style physics, outlandish characters, and irreverent humor, this sequel delivers pure trucking mayhem with attitude.

title: Bionicle: The Game
description: Step into the biomechanical world of Mata Nui as six legendary Toa heroes on a quest to defeat the evil Makuta. Master unique elemental powers as you play through each Toa's journey - wield Tahu's fire sword, surf lava with Lewa's air powers, or use Gali's water abilities to solve environmental puzzles. Battle fierce Rahi creatures and overcome challenging platforming sections across diverse environments from volcanic peaks to underwater temples. Switch between Toa to utilize their distinct masks and weapons, collecting power-ups and unlocking new abilities. Experience the epic LEGO Bionicle saga through cinematic cutscenes and explore richly detailed island landscapes in this action-adventure that brings the beloved toy line to life.

title: Black
description: BLACK delivers an explosive first-person shooter experience where destruction is the star. You play as Sergeant Jack Kellar, a black ops soldier on covert missions across Eastern Europe. Every bullet tears through the environment - walls crumble, cars explode, and glass shatters in spectacular fashion. The game treats guns like superpowers, with thunderous sound design and intense visual effects making every shot feel devastating. Urban warfare reaches new heights as you blast through fully destructible environments using an arsenal of real-world weapons. From tense firefights in abandoned factories to all-out assaults on enemy strongholds, BLACK emphasizes pure action over stealth. The Hollywood-style presentation features cinematic camera work and explosive set pieces that rival action movies. This is shooting at its most visceral and satisfying.

title: Black Stone: Magic & Steel
description: Choose your destiny in this action-packed hack-and-slash adventure where four unique warriors battle through hordes of enemies. Play as the swift Thief, powerful Warrior, magical Warlock, or cunning Archer, each with distinct combat styles and special abilities. Team up with three friends for intense cooperative gameplay as you fight through diverse fantasy realms filled with deadly creatures and challenging bosses. Master combo attacks, collect powerful weapons and armor, and unleash devastating magic spells. The game blends classic arcade action with RPG elements, featuring multiple difficulty levels and unlockable content. Experience frantic multiplayer battles where teamwork is essential for survival against overwhelming odds in this underrated Xbox exclusive that delivers pure cooperative fun.

title: Blade II
description: Based on the Marvel Comics vampire hunter, Blade II delivers intense hack-and-slash action as you battle through hordes of bloodthirsty vampires. Wield Blade's signature sword alongside an arsenal of firearms and explosive devices to devastate the undead menace. Master devastating combo attacks and unlock new fighting techniques as you progress through dark urban environments. The game features a unique "rage" system that enhances your combat abilities when activated, allowing for brutal finishing moves. Face off against powerful vampire bosses including members of the deadly Reapers strain. With its gothic atmosphere, fluid combat mechanics, and authentic movie tie-in storyline featuring Wesley Snipes' likeness, Blade II offers a visceral action experience that captures the essence of the film's vampire-hunting thrills.

title: Blinx: The Time Sweeper
description: Control time itself as Blinx, a cat janitor who must save reality from time glitches threatening the fabric of existence. Wield powerful time manipulation abilities including pausing, rewinding, fast-forwarding, slowing, and recording time to solve puzzles and defeat enemies. Navigate through warped dimensions where time runs amok, collecting time crystals to fuel your abilities while vacuuming up trash and monsters with your special sweeper. Each world presents unique temporal challenges requiring creative use of your time powers. Battle through 40 stages across 10 distinct worlds, facing off against time monsters and challenging bosses. Master precision platforming while managing your time energy wisely. This Xbox exclusive pioneered real-time manipulation mechanics in 3D platformers.

title: Blinx 2: Masters of Time and Space
description: Control time and space in this innovative platformer sequel where two rival factions battle across dimensional rifts. Play as both the Time Sweepers and the new Tom Tom Gang, each wielding unique temporal abilities. Rewind mistakes, fast-forward through obstacles, pause enemies mid-attack, and record yourself to create time copies that fight alongside you. The Tom Tom Gang introduces spatial powers - teleport through walls, shift gravity, and manipulate the environment itself. Team up in cooperative multiplayer modes or compete in versus battles where time manipulation meets space-warping chaos. Create custom characters with the deep customization system, choosing appearances, outfits, and ability loadouts. Navigate vibrant worlds filled with time paradoxes, challenging puzzles that blend temporal and spatial mechanics, and bosses requiring mastery of both power sets.

title: BloodRayne
description: BloodRayne follows Rayne, a deadly half-vampire agent hunting Nazis through WWII-era Louisiana and Argentina. Armed with twin arm-mounted blades and devastating vampiric powers, she slices through enemies with visceral combat that blends acrobatic melee attacks with dual-wielded gunplay. Feed on enemies to replenish health and unleash Blood Rage for devastating slow-motion carnage. Navigate atmospheric locations from foggy swamps to secret Nazi compounds while battling mutants, zombies, and occult horrors. Rayne's dhampir abilities include superhuman agility, dilated perception to slow time, and a vampiric vision mode that reveals hidden enemies. The game delivers pure action-horror thrills with its signature mix of stylish combat, gothic atmosphere, and over-the-top violence that defined early 2000s action gaming.

title: BloodRayne 2
description: BloodRayne 2 unleashes supernatural vampire action as the deadly dhampir Rayne hunts her vampiric siblings across a dark modern world. Slice through enemies with twin arm blades while executing brutal combos and acrobatic kills. Feed on victims to replenish health and unleash devastating blood rage attacks. Master Rayne's enhanced vampiric powers including dilated perception to slow time, blood fury for increased damage, and aura vision to track prey. Navigate sprawling Gothic environments from opulent mansions to seedy urban underbellies. Dismember foes with visceral finishing moves using harpoons, kicks, and environmental hazards. Experience cinematic boss battles against Rayne's twisted family members, each with unique abilities. This stylish sequel delivers intense hack-and-slash combat, supernatural powers, and dark atmosphere in a vengeful quest to prevent vampire apocalypse.

title: Bloody Roar Extreme
description: Unleash your inner beast in this explosive 3D fighting game where warriors transform into powerful animal forms mid-combat. Choose from fierce fighters who morph into tigers, wolves, lions, and mythical creatures, each with unique abilities and devastating combos. Master the innovative Beast Drive system to execute spectacular super moves and chain together crushing attacks. The game features intense one-on-one battles across interactive arenas where walls can be broken and opponents launched through barriers. With its fluid combat mechanics, you'll string together punches, kicks, and savage beast attacks in fast-paced matches. Experience multiple game modes including arcade, survival, and versus battles. The strategic depth comes from knowing when to fight as human or beast, as each form offers different strengths. Bloody Roar Extreme delivers visceral fighting action with a wild twist that sets it apart from traditional fighters.

title: BMX XXX
description: BMX XXX pushes extreme sports gaming into controversial territory with its adult-themed BMX action. Race through urban environments performing insane tricks and combos while building your score multiplier. The game features professional BMX riders alongside fictional characters in an arcade-style trick system that rewards creative line building. Unlock new bikes, levels, and video content as you progress through career mode. Multiple game modes include traditional score challenges, races, and objective-based missions across varied locations from construction sites to strip clubs. The physics engine allows for fluid trick combinations mixing grinds, manuals, and aerial stunts. Create custom riders and compete in split-screen multiplayer battles. While notorious for its mature content and provocative unlockables, the core gameplay delivers responsive BMX mechanics with an emphasis on linking tricks for massive scores.

title: Breakdown
description: Trapped in a mysterious underground facility with no memory of your past, you must fight for survival using a revolutionary first-person combat system that seamlessly blends hand-to-hand martial arts with gunplay. As Derrick Cole, unleash devastating combo attacks, counter enemy strikes, and discover superhuman abilities that grow stronger as the conspiracy unfolds. This unique action game from Namco pushes Xbox hardware to deliver intense close-quarters battles where every punch, kick, and block feels visceral. Navigate claustrophobic corridors, solve environmental puzzles, and face off against soldiers and supernatural threats. Your mysterious companion Alex guides you through the facility's secrets while reality itself begins to break down around you. With its innovative melee-focused FPS gameplay, cinematic presentation, and mind-bending story that questions the nature of existence, Breakdown delivers an unforgettable journey through conspiracy, combat, and consciousness.

title: Breeders' Cup World Thoroughbred Championships
description: Experience the ultimate horse racing simulation where you breed, train, and race championship thoroughbreds on tracks worldwide. Create your stable from scratch, carefully selecting bloodlines and breeding pairs to produce the next racing legend. Train your horses using detailed conditioning programs, balancing speed work with stamina building. Race at legendary venues including Churchill Downs, Belmont Park, and international tracks. Master race tactics by choosing the perfect jockey, studying track conditions, and timing your moves through the pack. Features authentic Breeders' Cup races with realistic physics and AI opponents. Build your racing empire through strategic breeding decisions and race earnings. The deep breeding system lets you develop champion bloodlines across generations.

title: Brian Lara International Cricket 2005
description: Step into the crease with cricket legend Brian Lara in this comprehensive cricket simulation. Experience authentic Test matches, One Day Internationals, and thrilling Twenty20 cricket across licensed international teams and real stadiums. Master batting with intuitive shot selection including classic drives, cuts, and innovative stroke play. Bowl with precision using swing, seam, and spin variations. The advanced AI delivers realistic field placements and tactical decisions that adapt to match situations. Create custom tournaments, manage team strategies, and guide your nation to World Cup glory. Features detailed player statistics, dynamic weather conditions affecting pitch behavior, and authentic cricket atmosphere with realistic crowd reactions. Whether you're hitting sixes in a T20 thriller or grinding out a Test match victory, this delivers the complete cricket experience with stunning presentation and deep gameplay mechanics that reward skill and strategy.

title: Brute Force
description: Brute Force delivers explosive squad-based tactical combat in a gritty sci-fi universe. Command an elite team of four specialized operatives, each with unique abilities and devastating weapons. Switch between Tex's dual pistols, Brutus' heavy assault capabilities, Hawk's stealth tactics, and Flint's sniper precision as you battle through alien worlds. The game features dynamic squad AI that lets you issue tactical commands while fighting alongside your team. Environments range from desert wastelands to frozen tundras, each filled with hostile alien species and rival mercenary forces. Master cooperative tactics by combining your squad's abilities - use Hawk's cloaking to scout ahead, then unleash Brutus's berserker rage while Flint provides cover fire. With split-screen multiplayer support, team up with friends for intense co-op missions or compete in deathmatch arenas.

title: Buffy the Vampire Slayer
description: Step into the shoes of Buffy Summers in this Xbox-exclusive action game that perfectly captures the essence of the hit TV series. Battle vampires, demons, and the forces of darkness across Sunnydale using Buffy's signature martial arts moves, acrobatic combos, and slayer powers. Wield an arsenal of weapons from stakes to crossbows, executing devastating finishing moves on your supernatural foes. Experience an original storyline featuring the show's beloved characters, voiced by the actual cast members. Master the innovative combat system that blends hand-to-hand fighting with environmental interactions. Explore familiar locations like Sunnydale High and the Bronze nightclub while uncovering ancient artifacts and mystical secrets.

title: Buffy the Vampire Slayer: Chaos Bleeds
description: Step into the supernatural world of Sunnydale as Buffy and the Scooby Gang face an ancient evil threatening multiple dimensions. This action-packed brawler lets you play as six different characters including Buffy, Willow, Xander, Spike, Faith, and even Sid the Dummy, each with unique fighting styles and special abilities. Battle vampires, demons, and otherworldly creatures through familiar locations from the TV series while uncovering a plot involving the mysterious First Evil. Master devastating combo attacks, wield everything from stakes to crossbows, and unleash powerful slayer moves. Team up with a friend in multiplayer arena battles featuring unlockable characters and arenas. With authentic voice acting and an original story that fits seamlessly into the show's mythology, Chaos Bleeds delivers the ultimate Buffy gaming experience.

title: Burnout
description: Criterion's revolutionary racer rewards dangerous driving over clean racing lines. Thread between traffic at 180mph to fill your boost meter, then burn it for impossible speeds. Risk equals reward - the closer you drive to disaster, the more boost you earn. Crash mode turns pile-ups into puzzles, challenging you to cause maximum monetary damage. The sense of speed remains unmatched with brilliant motion blur conveying velocity. USA and Euro circuits provide variety though the track count is limited. No licensed cars allows for spectacular crashes without manufacturer restrictions. Burnout established the template for arcade racing excellence that the series would perfect in later entries.

title: Burnout 2: Point of Impact
description: Burnout 2: Point of Impact delivers pure arcade racing adrenaline where speed and destruction collide. Race through dense traffic at breakneck speeds, weaving between cars while building your boost meter through dangerous driving. The revolutionary Crash mode turns destruction into an art form - launch your car into busy intersections to cause maximum carnage and chain reaction pile-ups for massive scores. With over 30 vehicles ranging from compact cars to powerful muscle machines, each race becomes a white-knuckle battle for supremacy. The risk-reward gameplay rewards aggressive driving - drift around corners, drive into oncoming traffic, and barely miss collisions to fill your turbo gauge. Stunning visual effects and a blistering sense of speed make every race an intense thrill ride.

title: Burnout 3: Takedown
description: Burnout 3: Takedown redefines arcade racing with its revolutionary crash mechanics and breakneck speed. Race through dense traffic across three continents, using aggressive takedowns to eliminate rivals and trigger spectacular crashes. The groundbreaking Crash Mode turns destruction into an art form, challenging you to create maximum carnage at busy intersections for huge scores. With over 170 events, 70+ cars, and multiple game modes including Race, Road Rage, and Eliminator, every moment delivers pure adrenaline. The risk-reward gameplay rewards dangerous driving with turbo boost, while the Aftertouch system lets you control your car mid-crash to take down opponents. Experience the ultimate arcade racer where speed and destruction collide.

title: Burnout Revenge
description: Experience the ultimate in aggressive arcade racing where revenge is a dish best served at 200mph. Burnout Revenge transforms racing into a demolition derby where traffic becomes your weapon. Ram same-way traffic to clear paths, trigger massive pile-ups, and send rivals spinning into devastating crashes. Master the revolutionary Traffic Attack mode, compete in crash junctions designed for maximum destruction, and unleash explosive takedowns in races across three continents. The groundbreaking Revenge Meter rewards aggressive driving, while Crash mode challenges you to orchestrate the most spectacular multi-million dollar pile-ups. With blazing speed, visceral combat racing, and the series' signature slow-motion crashes, Burnout Revenge delivers pure automotive mayhem where wrecking rivals is just as important as crossing the finish line first.

title: Cabela's Big Game Hunter 2005 Adventures
description: Embark on the ultimate hunting expedition across North America's most breathtaking wilderness areas. Track and hunt over 20 species of big game including elk, moose, grizzly bears, and mountain lions across diverse environments from dense forests to snow-capped mountains. Master realistic hunting mechanics with wind direction, scent masking, and animal behavior patterns that challenge your skills. Choose from an arsenal of authentic firearms and equipment, each with unique characteristics. Complete challenging missions in Career Hunt mode or explore freely in Quick Hunt. Experience dynamic weather conditions and time-of-day changes that affect animal activity. Use calls, scents, and decoys strategically to lure trophy animals within range. The game's realistic ballistics system accounts for distance, wind, and bullet drop for authentic marksmanship.

title: Cabela's Dangerous Hunts
description: Step into the wild as an elite hunter facing nature's deadliest predators in intense survival scenarios. Track and hunt dangerous animals across diverse global locations, from African savannas to Alaskan wilderness. Experience heart-pounding encounters with bears, lions, leopards, and other lethal creatures that stalk you as much as you hunt them. Master an arsenal of authentic weapons and equipment while using strategic hunting techniques to survive. The innovative "Hunter Sense" mechanic lets you detect animal movements and weak points in critical moments. Navigate treacherous terrain, set traps, and make split-second decisions when predators attack. With a gripping story mode and challenging hunting scenarios, every expedition tests your skills against nature's apex predators in this ultimate dangerous game hunting experience.

title: Cabela's Dangerous Hunts 2
description: Track the world's most dangerous game in this intense hunting adventure that takes you across diverse global locations from Alaska to Africa. Face off against aggressive predators including grizzly bears, lions, rhinos, and crocodiles that actively stalk and attack you, turning hunter into hunted. Experience heart-pounding action with the innovative "Action Zone" feature that slows time for precise shots during deadly animal charges. Navigate treacherous terrain while tracking your prey through forests, mountains, and savannas. Use an arsenal of authentic weapons and equipment to survive encounters with nature's fiercest creatures. Complete challenging missions that test your hunting skills, survival instincts, and nerve as you pursue legendary trophy animals while avoiding becoming prey yourself.

title: Cabela's Deer Hunt: 2004 Season
description: Step into the boots of a seasoned hunter in Cabela's Deer Hunt: 2004 Season, where patience and precision determine success. Track trophy bucks across diverse North American hunting grounds, from dense forests to open fields. Master realistic ballistics as wind, distance, and bullet drop affect every shot. Use authentic hunting gear including rifles, bows, calls, and scents to outsmart wary deer with advanced AI behaviors. Hunt through changing seasons and weather conditions that impact animal movement patterns. Complete challenging objectives in Career Mode or jump into Quick Hunt for instant action. Features multiple deer species including whitetail, mule deer, and blacktail across expansive environments. Experience the thrill of the hunt with realistic animal animations and authentic outdoor atmosphere.

title: Cabela's Deer Hunt: 2005 Season
description: Experience the ultimate deer hunting simulation in Cabela's Deer Hunt: 2005 Season. Track trophy bucks across diverse North American environments, from dense forests to open meadows. Master realistic hunting mechanics including scent masking, wind direction, and calling techniques. Choose from an arsenal of authentic firearms and equipment from top hunting brands. Hunt multiple deer species including whitetail, mule deer, and blacktail across challenging terrains. Features include dynamic weather, seasonal changes affecting animal behavior, and a comprehensive trophy room to showcase your achievements. Test your skills in tournament modes or free hunt across expansive maps. With realistic ballistics and animal AI, every hunt demands patience, strategy, and precision for success.

title: Cabela's Outdoor Adventures
description: Join expert hunter Jim Shockey on the ultimate outdoor expedition across North America's most breathtaking wilderness locations. Track and hunt over 30 species of big game including elk, moose, bears, and mountain lions using authentic Cabela's gear and weapons. Master varied hunting techniques from spot-and-stalk to calling strategies as you adapt to changing weather conditions and animal behaviors. Experience heart-pounding encounters in diverse environments from Alaskan tundra to desert canyons. Complete challenging missions, unlock new equipment, and test your skills in arcade shooting galleries. Features realistic animal AI, dynamic weather systems, and multiple difficulty modes for hunters of all experience levels. Whether you're stalking trophy bucks or defending against predator attacks, every hunt delivers authentic outdoor thrills.

title: Call of Cthulhu: Dark Corners of the Earth
description: Immerse yourself in cosmic horror as private investigator Jack Walters uncovers the dark secrets of Innsmouth in this survival horror masterpiece based on H.P. Lovecraft's mythos. Experience true psychological terror with no HUD and no weapons for the first hours - survival depends on stealth, cunning, and maintaining your sanity. The innovative sanity system makes you vulnerable to panic attacks and hallucinations when witnessing horrific events. Solve complex puzzles, engage in desperate chase sequences, and eventually fight otherworldly horrors with period-appropriate weapons. Dynamic injuries affect movement and vision, requiring medical attention to survive. From the shadowy streets of Innsmouth to alien dimensions, every moment builds dread through atmospheric storytelling and disturbing visuals that capture Lovecraft's vision perfectly.

title: Call of Duty: Finest Hour
description: Experience the intensity of World War II's most pivotal battles in Call of Duty: Finest Hour. Fight alongside American, British, and Soviet forces across multiple theaters of war, from the frozen streets of Stalingrad to the scorching deserts of North Africa. Command tanks in epic armored warfare, storm enemy positions with your squad, and engage in fierce close-quarters combat. Each campaign delivers authentic weapons, vehicles, and combat scenarios inspired by real historical battles. The game features immersive single-player missions with varied objectives including sabotage, defense, and all-out assault. Feel the chaos of war through intense sound design and cinematic presentation that puts you in the boots of ordinary soldiers facing extraordinary circumstances.

title: Call of Duty 2: Big Red One
description: Experience the grit and camaraderie of WWII's legendary 1st Infantry Division in Call of Duty 2: Big Red One. Fight through the scorching deserts of North Africa, storm the beaches of Sicily, and liberate war-torn France as you follow one squad's journey through history's greatest conflict. Unlike other Call of Duty titles, Big Red One focuses on the bonds between soldiers, featuring recurring squadmates whose survival depends on your actions. Engage in intense infantry combat, operate tanks and aircraft, and coordinate with your AI companions using authentic WWII weapons. The campaign spans three years of brutal warfare across multiple theaters, from the Kasserine Pass to the liberation of Europe. Immersive voice acting and cinematic presentation bring your squad's personal story to life amidst epic battles.

title: Call of Duty 3
description: Experience the chaos and intensity of WWII's liberation of France in Call of Duty 3. Fight through the Normandy Breakout campaign across multiple perspectives - American, British, Canadian, and Polish forces each bring unique missions and storylines. Engage in visceral close-quarters combat with enhanced melee mechanics and hand-to-hand fighting sequences. Battle through destructible environments from hedgerow country to war-torn villages. Drive tanks, jeeps, and motorcycles in action-packed vehicle sections. The branching mission paths let you choose different routes through battlefields. Multiplayer supports up to 24 players in massive online battles across various game modes. Feel the authentic atmosphere through stunning visuals and immersive sound design that captures the brutal reality of 1944 warfare.

title: Capcom Classics Collection
description: Relive gaming's golden age with Capcom Classics Collection, an essential anthology featuring over 20 arcade masterpieces from the legendary publisher. Battle through Streets of Rage-inspired brawlers like Final Fight and Captain Commando, test your reflexes in shoot-em-ups such as 1942 and Commando, or master the precise combat of Street Fighter II. Each game faithfully recreates the original arcade experience with authentic graphics and sounds, while adding modern conveniences like adjustable difficulty and save states. Unlock bonus content including original artwork, music tracks, and developer interviews that chronicle Capcom's arcade legacy. From Ghosts 'n Goblins' punishing platforming to the puzzle action of Super Puzzle Fighter, this collection spans multiple genres and decades of innovation. Whether you're a veteran seeking nostalgia or a newcomer discovering these classics, experience the titles that defined arcade gaming and influenced generations of developers.

title: Capcom vs. SNK 2 EO
description: The ultimate crossover fighter brings together Street Fighter and King of Fighters rosters in the deepest fighting system ever created. Six different grooves fundamentally change gameplay - from Street Fighter Alpha's custom combos to KOF's running. The ratio system lets you build teams with point values balancing powerful characters against multiple fighters. EO version adds simplified controls making special moves accessible to newcomers. The roster of 44 characters spans both companies' histories with surprising inclusions like Morrigan and Athena. Online play via Xbox Live extended the game's competitive life. Capcom vs. SNK 2 remains many players' favorite 2D fighter for its unmatched variety and balance.

title: Carmen Sandiego: The Secret of the Stolen Drums
description: Join master thief Carmen Sandiego in this rhythmic adventure that combines stealth gameplay with musical challenges! Track Carmen across exotic global locations as you solve puzzles and uncover clues about the mysterious stolen drums. Each mission blends traditional point-and-click detective work with innovative rhythm-based mini-games where timing is everything. Use high-tech ACME gadgets to analyze evidence, interrogate suspects, and decode Carmen's cryptic messages. The game features fully voiced characters, vibrant cel-shaded graphics capturing the animated series' style, and an educational twist that teaches geography and world cultures.
