Race against time to stop Carmen's musical heist before she escapes! Can you outsmart the world's greatest thief?

title: Cars
description: Race through the world of Disney-Pixar's Cars as Lightning McQueen and other beloved characters from Radiator Springs. Experience high-octane racing action across diverse tracks inspired by the movie, from dusty desert roads to the iconic Radiator Springs Speedway. Master power slides, turbo boosts, and spectacular jumps while competing in Championship races and thrilling mini-games. Explore an open-world environment where you can freely cruise around Radiator Springs, discovering hidden areas and collecting bonus items. Challenge friends in split-screen multiplayer races or tackle Piston Cup championships against fierce AI opponents. Customize your favorite characters with new paint jobs and upgrades to enhance speed, acceleration, and handling. With arcade-style racing that's accessible for younger players yet engaging enough for all ages, Cars delivers the charm and humor of the Pixar film in an exciting racing adventure.

title: Carve
description: Make waves on Xbox Live in this jet-ski racer emphasizing tricks and online competition. Perform aerial stunts off massive waves while racing through tropical locations. The trick system links combos for huge scores while building boost. Environmental hazards include sharks, mines, and waterfalls adding danger to races. Create custom riders and watercraft with extensive personalization options. Xbox Live support includes tournaments and downloadable content expanding tracks. The water physics impressively simulate waves affecting racing lines. While lacking depth for solo players, Carve's online focus made it an early Xbox Live showcase. Jet-ski racing never looked better even if content was limited.

title: Castlevania: Curse of Darkness
description: Wield the dark powers of Devil Forging in this gothic action-RPG set three years after Dracula's defeat. As Hector, a Devil Forgemaster seeking vengeance for his murdered love, craft and command Innocent Devils - demonic familiars that evolve based on your weapon choices. Battle through sprawling 3D environments from abandoned castles to cursed forests, mastering weapon combos with swords, spears, and axes. Your Devils fight alongside you, providing unique abilities from healing to devastating attacks. Collect materials to forge powerful weapons and armor while uncovering a conspiracy that threatens to resurrect the Dark Lord. With its deep crafting system, pet-like Devil companions, and strategic real-time combat, Curse of Darkness revolutionizes the Castlevania formula in a dark tale of betrayal and redemption.

title: Catwoman
description: Step into the sleek leather suit of DC's most enigmatic anti-heroine in this action-adventure based on the 2004 film. As Catwoman, prowl through a dark urban landscape using feline-inspired acrobatics and combat moves. Scale walls, leap across rooftops, and pounce on enemies with cat-like agility. The innovative "cat sense" mechanic lets you see in the dark and track scents, while your razor-sharp claws serve as both weapons and climbing tools. Master a unique whip-based combat system to disarm foes and swing across gaps. Uncover a sinister corporate conspiracy involving a deadly beauty product while balancing Patience Phillips' dual identity. With its emphasis on vertical exploration and predatory stealth gameplay, experience the thrill of becoming Gotham's most agile thief.

title: Championship Manager: Season 01/02
description: Take control of your favorite football club in this definitive management simulation. Championship Manager: Season 01/02 puts you in the hot seat with complete tactical control, transfer negotiations, and squad management across multiple leagues worldwide. Scout emerging talents, develop youth prospects, and build dynasties with over 100,000 real players and staff. The game's legendary match engine delivers realistic results based on your tactical decisions, while the intuitive interface lets you handle everything from training schedules to contract talks. Experience the pressure of the transfer window, manage team morale, and make crucial decisions that determine success or failure. With authentic 2001/02 season data and endless replayability, this edition remains a beloved classic that captures the essence of football management at its finest.

title: Championship Manager: Season 02/03
description: Take control of your favorite football club in this comprehensive management simulation that puts you in the hot seat for the 2002/03 season. Scout and sign players from leagues worldwide, craft tactical masterplans, and guide your team through domestic leagues and European competitions. With an extensive database featuring over 100,000 real players and staff across 26 playable leagues, every decision matters as you balance budgets, handle press conferences, and develop youth prospects. The enhanced match engine delivers realistic results while the improved interface streamlines squad management. Whether you're steering giants like Manchester United to glory or taking lower division clubs to unprecedented heights, Championship Manager 02/03 offers unparalleled depth in football management simulation, letting you write your own success story one match at a time.

title: Championship Manager 5
description: Take control of your favorite football club in Championship Manager 5, the beloved management simulation that puts you in the hot seat. Scout and sign talented players from around the globe, develop winning tactics, and guide your team through intense league campaigns and cup competitions. With an extensive database featuring thousands of real players and clubs, every decision matters as you balance budgets, handle media pressure, and manage squad morale. The enhanced match engine delivers realistic gameplay while detailed statistics help you analyze performance and refine your strategies. From lower leagues to continental glory, build your managerial legacy through shrewd transfers, tactical mastery, and inspiring team talks. Experience the thrill of matchday as your carefully crafted plans unfold on the pitch.

title: Charlie and the Chocolate Factory
description: Step into Willy Wonka's magical chocolate factory in this whimsical adventure based on Tim Burton's film. Play as Charlie Bucket and explore fantastical environments filled with Oompa-Loompas, candy gardens, and mysterious machinery. Navigate through iconic locations like the Chocolate Room, Inventing Room, and Television Room while solving puzzles and collecting Wonka Bars. Help rescue the other children from their candy-induced predicaments using special abilities and gadgets. Mix candy combinations to create unique power-ups, command Oompa-Loompas to assist with tasks, and unlock secret areas throughout the factory. Experience the wonder of Wonka's world through colorful graphics, quirky humor, and imaginative gameplay mechanics that bring Roald Dahl's beloved story to life.

title: Chase: Hollywood Stunt Driver
description: Experience the adrenaline-fueled world of Hollywood stunt driving in this unique action-racing game. Take on the role of Chase Corrada, a young stuntwoman making her mark in the movie industry. Perform death-defying stunts across diverse film sets, from explosive action sequences to precision driving challenges. Master handbrake turns, jumps, and crashes while hitting your marks perfectly to impress demanding directors. Each mission presents new vehicular challenges - race through city streets, navigate treacherous mountain roads, and execute spectacular set pieces. The game blends arcade racing with mission-based objectives, requiring both speed and precision. Unlock new vehicles and stunts as you rise from rookie to Hollywood's most sought-after stunt driver.

title: Chessmaster 10th Edition
description: Challenge your mind with the ultimate chess experience in Chessmaster 10th Edition, where centuries of chess mastery meet cutting-edge technology. Master the royal game through comprehensive tutorials from International Master Josh Waitzkin, guiding players from basic moves to advanced strategies. Face off against dozens of AI personalities, each with unique playing styles and skill levels, from beginners to grandmasters. The revolutionary King engine adapts to your skill level, providing the perfect challenge every time. Analyze your games with powerful tools, study famous historical matches, and solve hundreds of chess puzzles. Practice openings, endgames, and tactical combinations in dedicated training modes. With stunning 3D and 2D board designs, online multiplayer support, and a massive database of classic games, this definitive chess simulator offers endless ways to improve your game and discover the beauty of chess.

title: Chicago Enforcer
description: Step into the shoes of Jimmy "Machine Gun" DeMora, a mobster turned enforcer in 1930s Chicago during the height of Prohibition. Chicago Enforcer delivers intense first-person shooter action as you blast your way through the criminal underworld using authentic period weapons like Tommy guns, shotguns, and revolvers. Navigate through speakeasies, warehouses, and city streets while battling rival gangs and corrupt cops. The game features destructible environments, allowing you to shoot through walls and use cover strategically. Experience mob warfare with vehicular combat sequences, including dramatic car chases and drive-by shootings. Each mission advances the gritty storyline of revenge and power in organized crime. With its noir atmosphere, period-accurate settings, and brutal gunplay, Chicago Enforcer captures the violent essence of gangster-era Chicago where loyalty is everything and betrayal means death.

title: Circus Maximus: Chariot Wars
description: Experience the brutal spectacle of ancient Rome's deadliest sport in Circus Maximus: Chariot Wars. Race through the empire's greatest arenas as warrior-charioteers battle for glory and survival. Master your horses while wielding deadly weapons - ram opponents into walls, slash with blades, and unleash devastating special attacks. Choose from multiple factions including Romans, Greeks, and Barbarians, each with unique chariots and combat styles. Navigate treacherous tracks filled with obstacles, shortcuts, and environmental hazards. Build your reputation through the campaign mode or challenge friends in savage multiplayer races. With visceral combat mechanics and authentic Roman atmosphere, every race becomes a fight to the death where speed and strategy collide.

title: Classified: The Sentinel Crisis
description: This budget FPS surprises with competent gameplay despite generic presentation. As soldier Blake, stop the terrorist organization Sentinel from deploying a super weapon. Levels span global locations from jungle compounds to arctic bases with decent variety. The shooting feels solid with responsive controls and satisfying weapon feedback. Gadgets include night vision, thermal imaging, and remote cameras for tactical approaches. Multiplayer includes standard deathmatch and CTF modes for split-screen battles. While everything screams "generic shooter" from character design to plot, the core gameplay loop works. For its budget price, Classified delivers acceptable shooting action when you've exhausted premium options.

title: Close Combat: First to Fight
description: Lead your Marine fire team through the urban battlefields of Beirut in this tactical first-person shooter that emphasizes authentic military tactics and teamwork. Experience combat through the eyes of real Marines, using actual Close Quarters Battle doctrine and the Marine Corps' proven "Ready-Team-Fire-Assist" strategy. Command your AI squadmates with simple orders as you clear buildings, suppress enemies, and advance through hostile territory. Every decision matters as you coordinate flanking maneuvers, call for support, and adapt to dynamic combat situations. Built with input from active-duty Marines, the game delivers an unprecedented level of realism in urban warfare. Face insurgents in intense firefights where cover, suppression, and tactical movement mean the difference between success and failure in this groundbreaking military shooter.

title: Club Football
description: Choose your favorite football club and lead them to glory in this unique sports management simulation. Club Football puts you in complete control of real teams from leagues across Europe, letting you manage everything from tactics and training to transfers and team selection. Experience authentic club atmospheres with official kits, stadiums, and chants that bring match days to life. The innovative training system allows you to develop young talents into superstars while veteran players mentor the next generation. Strategic depth meets accessibility as you balance formations, player morale, and finances to build a dynasty. Whether you're orchestrating attacks from the sideline or negotiating crucial transfers, every decision shapes your club's destiny in this immersive football management experience.

title: Club Football 2005
description: Take control of your favorite football club in this comprehensive management simulation that puts you in the dugout of over 40 officially licensed teams from across Europe's top leagues. Build your dream squad through strategic transfers, develop youth players into superstars, and guide your team to glory across multiple competitions including domestic leagues, cups, and European tournaments. Experience the pressure of matchday with detailed 3D match engine that brings tactical decisions to life, allowing you to make crucial substitutions and formation changes in real-time. Manage every aspect of your club from training schedules and staff appointments to stadium upgrades and financial budgets. Navigate the complexities of player morale, handle press conferences that impact team confidence, and deal with boardroom expectations as you balance short-term success with long-term sustainability. Whether you're rescuing a struggling team from relegation or maintaining dominance with a top club, every decision shapes your legacy as you write your own football story.

title: Cold Fear
description: Cold Fear delivers survival horror on the high seas as you battle grotesque creatures aboard a storm-battered Russian whaler. As Coast Guard officer Tom Hansen, you face infected crew members transformed into zombie-like enemies while the ship pitches violently in massive waves. The dynamic environment becomes your enemy - torrential rain affects visibility, huge swells throw you off balance, and the ship's constant motion impacts your aim. Switch between fixed camera angles reminiscent of classic survival horror and over-the-shoulder aiming for intense combat. Explore claustrophobic corridors, solve environmental puzzles, and uncover the dark conspiracy behind the outbreak. With limited ammunition and relentless enemies, every encounter demands strategy and nerve in this atmospheric maritime nightmare.

title: Cold War
description: Navigate 1986 Moscow as freelance journalist Matthew Carter, framed for attempted assassination and trapped in a deadly conspiracy. This stealth-action thriller emphasizes realistic espionage over acrobatics - you're a civilian reporter, not a super-spy. Master the innovative gadget creation system, turning everyday objects into survival tools and improvised weapons. Evade or eliminate KGB forces using multiple approaches: sneak through shadows, create distractions, or fight when cornered. The branching gameplay lets you choose your path through Soviet political prisons and military installations. Craft ingenious devices from recovered materials while uncovering an international plot to control the USSR. With its unique protagonist, inventive gameplay mechanics, and Cold War atmosphere, this thinking-person's stealth game rewards creativity over brute force.

title: Colin McRae Rally 04
description: Experience the raw intensity of championship rally racing as you tear through 8 countries across mud, gravel, snow and tarmac. Master over 20 licensed vehicles including the Subaru Impreza, Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution and Ford Focus RS. Feel every bump and slide with revolutionary car damage that affects handling - smash your suspension and you'll fight to control your wounded machine. Race through 48 demanding stages in Championship mode or go head-to-head in split-screen multiplayer. Create custom rallies, perfect your technique in the Rally School, and push your skills in extreme weather conditions. With Colin McRae's expertise guiding the authentic physics engine, this delivers the most realistic rally experience on Xbox.

title: Celebrity Deathmatch
description: Step into the ring where pop culture icons settle their scores in brutal clay-animated combat! Celebrity Deathmatch brings MTV's infamous show to life with outrageous fighting action. Choose from dozens of celebrities, each with unique moves and hilarious special attacks inspired by their real-world personas. Battle through multiple game modes including single-player episodes that mirror the show's format, complete with commentary from Mills Lane. The game features destructible environments, over-the-top finishing moves, and weapons ranging from baseball bats to chainsaws. Create custom matches between unlikely opponents or recreate classic feuds from the show. With its distinctive claymation-style graphics, dark humor, and roster of recognizable fighters from musicians to actors to athletes, this brawler delivers satisfying combat with a twisted comedic edge that captures the show's irreverent spirit.

title: Championship Manager 2006
description: Take control of your favorite football club and guide them to glory in Championship Manager 2006. This legendary management simulation puts you in the hot seat, making crucial decisions on tactics, transfers, and team selection. Scout promising talent from around the globe, negotiate shrewd deals in the transfer market, and develop youth prospects into world-class stars. With an extensive database covering leagues worldwide, you'll analyze match statistics, manage player morale, and adapt your tactics to outwit opponents. Experience the pressure of the dugout as you handle press conferences, deal with board expectations, and navigate the complexities of modern football management. Whether you're taking a lower league team to the top or maintaining dominance with giants, every decision shapes your legacy.

title: Chessmaster
description: Challenge your strategic mind in Chessmaster, the ultimate chess experience that transforms the ancient game into a modern masterpiece. Face off against an advanced AI with adjustable difficulty levels ranging from beginner to grandmaster, ensuring perfect matches for players of any skill. Learn from built-in tutorials and chess lessons taught by International Master Josh Waitzkin, while the game's comprehensive analysis tools help you understand every move. Practice with over 900 classic chess puzzles and famous historical matches. The innovative personality-based AI opponents each have unique playing styles, from aggressive attackers to cautious defenders, making every game feel fresh. With multiple board designs, piece sets, and environments, plus online multiplayer support, Chessmaster delivers the definitive digital chess experience for enthusiasts and newcomers alike.

title: Colin McRae Rally 3
description: Colin McRae Rally 3 delivers the ultimate rally racing experience with championship stages across eight countries including Japan, Australia, and the USA. Master over 30 officially licensed cars from top manufacturers like Subaru, Mitsubishi, and Ford as you tackle diverse terrain from snow-covered Finnish forests to dusty Greek mountain roads. The revolutionary damage system affects your car's performance - lose a wheel, smash your windscreen, or wreck your suspension as every impact matters. Face challenging weather conditions with dynamic rain, fog, and changing road surfaces that demand split-second decisions. Compete in Championship, Stage Rally, and 4-player split-screen modes. With Colin McRae as your co-driver calling pace notes, experience the intense concentration and raw speed of professional rallying.

title: Colin McRae Rally 2005
description: Colin McRae Rally 2005 delivers the ultimate rally racing experience with over 30 rally cars spanning 50 years of motorsport history. Race through 9 international locations including Germany, Japan, and the UK across more than 70 challenging stages. The revolutionary damage system affects your car's performance - every crash, scrape and bump impacts handling, making each race uniquely intense. Career mode lets you build your reputation from rookie to champion, managing repairs between stages and making crucial setup decisions. The game features authentic pace notes from Derek Ringer, McRae's actual co-driver, guiding you through treacherous corners and jumps. With 4-player split-screen multiplayer and online leaderboards, you can prove your skills against friends and rivals worldwide. Master different surfaces from gravel to tarmac, each demanding unique driving techniques in this definitive rally simulation.

title: Codename: Kids Next Door – Operation: V.I.D.E.O.G.A.M.E.
description: Join the Kids Next Door in this action-packed adventure based on the hit Cartoon Network series! Play as all five KND operatives - Numbuh 1 through 5 - each with unique abilities and signature weapons. Battle through missions against the Delightful Children, Father, and other adult villains threatening kid-kind. Switch between characters on the fly to solve puzzles and overcome obstacles using teamwork. Explore iconic locations from the show including the KND Treehouse, combining platforming, combat, and stealth gameplay. Collect power-ups, unlock special 2x4 technology weapons, and complete bonus objectives. Features single-player story mode and local co-op multiplayer modes. Defend childhood freedom in this colorful cartoon adventure that captures the show's humor and style!

title: College Hoops 2K6
description: Take the hardwood in College Hoops 2K6, where passion and tradition collide in the ultimate NCAA basketball experience. Build your legacy through the innovative Legacy Mode, recruiting top high school talent and developing them into championship contenders. Experience authentic college atmosphere with fight songs, mascots, and home court advantages that impact gameplay. The deep coaching system lets you call plays, adjust strategies, and manage rotations like a real coach. With over 300 Division I teams, accurate rosters, and signature moves for star players, every game captures the intensity of March Madness. The refined gameplay engine delivers realistic ball physics, improved AI, and smooth animations that bring college basketball's unique style to life.

title: College Hoops 2K7
description: Hit the hardwood with College Hoops 2K7, where March Madness comes alive year-round. Experience the raw intensity of NCAA basketball as you lead over 325 Division I schools to glory. The innovative Legacy Mode lets you build a powerhouse program from the ground up, recruiting top high school talent while managing academic standards and team chemistry. Feel the home court advantage with authentic fight songs, mascots, and student sections that erupt with every clutch shot. The deep playbook system captures each school's unique style, from Princeton's methodical offense to Duke's pressure defense. Create your own baller and take them from freshman walk-on to All-American legend. With ESPN Integration bringing real broadcast presentation and Dick Vitale's energetic commentary, every game feels like a primetime showdown.

title: Combat Elite: WWII Paratroopers
description: Lead your elite squad of WWII paratroopers through intense tactical combat missions across Nazi-occupied Europe. Command a specialized team where each soldier possesses unique skills crucial for survival behind enemy lines. Plan coordinated assaults using authentic WWII weapons and equipment while managing limited resources and ammunition. The innovative squad-based gameplay emphasizes strategic positioning and teamwork over run-and-gun action. Navigate through destructible environments, from French villages to German strongholds, adapting tactics to each battlefield. Experience the brutal reality of airborne operations where every decision impacts your squad's survival. Authentic period atmosphere combines with accessible controls to deliver a compelling WWII tactical experience.

title: Commandos 2: Men of Courage
description: Lead an elite team of Allied commandos behind enemy lines in this tactical stealth masterpiece. Control nine unique specialists including the Green Beret, Sniper, and Spy, each with distinct abilities crucial for mission success. Infiltrate Nazi strongholds across diverse environments from Arctic bases to tropical islands and submarine pens. Master real-time tactical gameplay combining stealth, strategy, and action as you sabotage enemy operations, rescue POWs, and steal vital intelligence. Use disguises, distractions, and synchronized teamwork to overcome overwhelming odds. With multiple approaches to each objective, environmental interactions, and split-screen simultaneous control, every mission demands careful planning and flawless execution in this definitive World War II commando experience.

title: Commandos Strike Force
description: Experience World War II from three unique perspectives in this tactical first-person shooter. Take control of a Green Beret, Sniper, and Spy, each with specialized skills crucial for mission success. The Green Beret excels in close combat and heavy weapons, the Sniper eliminates targets from afar with deadly precision, while the Spy infiltrates enemy lines using disguises and stealth. Navigate through Norway, France, and Russia in authentic WWII environments. Switch between characters mid-mission to adapt your strategy - use the Spy to gather intel, position your Sniper for the perfect shot, then send in the Green Beret for explosive action. Combining tactical planning with intense FPS combat, Commandos Strike Force delivers a unique blend of strategy and action where every decision matters.

title: Conan
description: Enter a savage world of brutal combat and dark sorcery as Conan the Barbarian. Master visceral melee combat with swords, axes, and maces in this action-adventure inspired by Robert E. Howard's legendary tales. Execute devastating combo attacks and gruesome finishing moves as you battle through hordes of enemies across diverse realms. Harness mystical powers and magical artifacts while exploring ancient ruins, frozen wastelands, and exotic kingdoms. Experience Ron Perlman's powerful narration as you uncover the mysteries of Conan's past. Solve environmental puzzles using brute strength or cunning tactics. Face mythical creatures and powerful bosses in epic battles that test your warrior skills. With its mature themes, brutal combat system, and faithful adaptation of the Conan universe, this game delivers an authentic barbarian experience where steel and sorcery collide in spectacular fashion.

title: Conflict: Desert Storm
description: Lead an elite special forces squad through the Gulf War in this intense tactical shooter. Command four specialists - Bradley, Foley, Jones, and Connors - each with unique skills in heavy weapons, demolitions, sniping, and stealth. Switch between squad members on the fly as you infiltrate Iraqi positions, rescue prisoners, and sabotage enemy installations. Experience authentic Desert Storm missions from covert night raids to full-scale urban warfare. Use real military tactics with squad commands for suppressing fire, flanking maneuvers, and coordinated assaults. Arsenal includes M16s, Desert Eagles, C4 explosives, and vehicle-mounted weapons. Features split-screen cooperative play where friends control different squad members simultaneously. Realistic damage system demands careful planning - one wrong move can doom your entire team.

title: Conflict: Desert Storm II: Back to Baghdad
description: Lead your elite squad back into the heart of Iraq in this intense tactical shooter sequel. Command Delta Force or SAS operatives through 10 grueling missions across Baghdad and surrounding territories during the Gulf War. Switch between four specialized soldiers on the fly - sniper, heavy weapons, demolitions, and team leader - each with unique skills crucial for survival. Navigate urban warfare in Baghdad's dangerous streets, infiltrate enemy bases, and engage in fierce firefights using authentic military weapons and tactics. The enhanced AI delivers smarter enemies that use cover and flanking maneuvers, while your squad responds to tactical commands. Experience split-screen cooperative play as you and a friend work together through the entire campaign. From stealth infiltration to explosive combat, every mission demands strategic thinking and precise execution in this authentic military action experience.

title: Conflict: Global Terror
description: Take command of elite special forces in this intense tactical shooter set across global conflict zones. Lead your four-man squad through dangerous missions in Colombia, Kashmir, the Philippines, and Chechnya, battling terrorist organizations and rogue military units. Switch between squad members on the fly, each with unique weapons and specialties - Bradley's heavy weapons, Foley's sniper skills, Connors' demolitions expertise, and Sherman's assault tactics. Issue tactical commands to AI teammates, coordinate flanking maneuvers, and use authentic military equipment. Experience visceral combat with destructible environments, realistic ballistics, and strategic gameplay that rewards careful planning over run-and-gun tactics. From jungle warfare to urban combat, adapt your strategies to diverse battlefields while uncovering a conspiracy that threatens global stability.

title: Conflict: Vietnam
description: Experience the harsh realities of the Vietnam War through the eyes of four soldiers from the 101st Airborne Division. Lead your squad through dense jungles, booby-trapped villages, and underground tunnels in this tactical third-person shooter. Switch between squad members on the fly - Ragman the point man, Hoss the heavy gunner, Cherry the sniper, and Junior the medic - each with unique skills vital for survival. Navigate 14 intense missions spanning the Tet Offensive to the fall of Saigon. Use authentic Vietnam-era weapons, call in napalm strikes, and commandeer vehicles from Huey helicopters to patrol boats. The innovative squad mechanics let you issue tactical commands while managing morale and wounds that affect performance.

title: Conflict Zone
description: Lead your forces in this groundbreaking modern warfare RTS where media coverage shapes the battlefield. Command either the ICP peacekeeping coalition or the GHOST rebel faction across global conflict zones. Your actions generate real-time news reports that influence public opinion and funding - commit war crimes and watch support evaporate, or maintain ethical warfare to boost resources. Deploy tanks, helicopters, infantry and special forces while managing civilian casualties and refugee camps. Revolutionary AI sees enemies adapt tactics based on your strategies. Choose commanders with unique abilities and philosophies that alter gameplay. The innovative media system transforms traditional RTS mechanics, forcing strategic decisions between military effectiveness and public perception in this thought-provoking take on contemporary warfare.

title: Constantine
description: Step into the supernatural world of John Constantine, where demonic forces threaten reality itself. Armed with holy weapons, ancient artifacts, and powerful spells, battle through a dark vision of Los Angeles overrun by demons and half-breeds. Master Constantine's unique True Sight ability to reveal hidden enemies and secrets lurking in the shadow realm. Wield an arsenal including the holy shotgun Crucifier, blessed brass knuckles, and the demon-slaying Holy Water bombs. Experience intense combat mixing gunplay with magic as you perform exorcisms, banish demons back to Hell, and uncover a conspiracy that could unleash Satan upon Earth. Navigate between the mortal world and Hell itself through atmospheric levels inspired by the film. Face off against possessed humans, demonic entities, and powerful half-breed bosses in this action-horror adventure that blends occult detective work with visceral supernatural combat.

title: Corvette
description: Experience the raw power and precision of America's sports car legend in Corvette, where fifty years of automotive excellence comes to life. Race through meticulously recreated tracks from around the world, pushing iconic Corvette models from classic Stingrays to modern Z06s to their limits. Master realistic physics and handling as you compete in intense circuit races, challenging time trials, and thrilling street competitions. Customize your dream Corvette with authentic performance upgrades and visual modifications, fine-tuning everything from suspension to aerodynamics. Feel the evolution of American muscle through five decades of engineering, each car faithfully reproducing its real-world counterpart's unique characteristics. Dynamic weather effects and changing track conditions test your skills as you climb the ranks from amateur to professional racing legend.

title: Counter-Strike
description: Counter-Strike revolutionizes tactical shooters with its intense round-based combat where Terrorists and Counter-Terrorists face off in high-stakes missions. Plant or defuse bombs, rescue or guard hostages in meticulously designed maps that reward strategy and teamwork. Every round starts fresh with earned money to buy weapons and equipment, creating dynamic economic gameplay where smart purchases determine victory. Master the precise gunplay where every bullet counts - no respawns mean one life per round, raising tension to incredible heights. From the iconic AK-47 to flashbangs that blind enemies, each tool serves a tactical purpose. Communication and coordination with teammates become essential as you learn smoke grenade spots, practice precise aim, and develop map knowledge that separates pros from casual players.

title: Crash Bandicoot: The Wrath of Cortex
description: Crash Bandicoot returns in his first multiplatform adventure! Guide the heroic marsupial through 30 action-packed levels across five unique realms as he battles to stop his nemesis Dr. Neo Cortex and the malevolent Crunch Bandicoot from harnessing the destructive power of the Elemental Masks. Master Crash's signature spin attack, body slam, and sliding moves while collecting Wumpa fruit and smashing crates. Experience thrilling vehicle sections including underwater subs, mine carts, and aerial dogfights. Face off against massive elemental bosses representing Earth, Water, Fire, and Air. Unlock bonus levels, time trials, and play as Crash's sister Coco in specific stages. With vibrant graphics, classic platforming gameplay, and the series' trademark humor, The Wrath of Cortex delivers pure Crash mayhem for a new generation.

title: Crash Tag Team Racing
description: Get ready for high-octane kart racing mayhem in Crash Tag Team Racing! Race as Crash Bandicoot and his colorful cast of friends and foes across 15 wild tracks filled with insane jumps, shortcuts, and hazards. The revolutionary "clashing" mechanic lets you merge vehicles with opponents mid-race, transforming into a powerful turret-wielding super-kart where one player drives while the other blasts rivals. Explore the massive theme park hub world on foot, discovering hidden areas, collecting coins, and unlocking new characters and vehicles. With 8 battle arenas, stunt mode challenges, and hilarious Die-O-Rama animations, this racer delivers non-stop action. Master power slides, collect wumpa fruit for turbo boosts, and unleash devastating weapons in this unique blend of platforming and racing chaos!

title: Crash Nitro Kart
description: Crash Nitro Kart brings the beloved bandicoot's racing mayhem to Xbox with explosive kart racing action across the cosmos. Race as Crash, Cortex, and the gang through alien worlds filled with anti-gravity sections, treacherous obstacles, and power-ups galore. Master the power slide boost system to gain crucial speed advantages while collecting Wumpa Fruit to supercharge your weapons. Battle through Adventure mode's intergalactic storyline where Emperor Velo challenges Earth's finest racers, or compete in frantic 4-player split-screen battles. With 16 diverse tracks spanning tropical paradises to mechanical mazes, plus unlockable characters and karts, this racer delivers pure arcade thrills. Experience championship racing with signature Crash humor and chaos!

title: Crash Twinsanity
description: Join Crash Bandicoot and his arch-nemesis Dr. Neo Cortex in an unlikely alliance through a wildly unpredictable adventure! When evil twins from another dimension threaten both their worlds, these sworn enemies must work together using innovative tag-team gameplay. Control both characters cooperatively - roll Cortex into a ball, use him as a hammer, or throw him across gaps to solve puzzles and defeat enemies. Explore vibrant 3D environments from tropical islands to icy wastelands, featuring the series' signature platforming with fresh twists. Experience hilarious slapstick humor, outrageous boss battles, and mind-bending dimensional travel. With its unique dual-character mechanics and comedic chaos, Twinsanity delivers classic Crash gameplay with an entirely new spin on the beloved franchise.

title: Crazy Taxi 3: High Roller
description: Race through the glitzy streets of Las Vegas in the wildest taxi adventure yet! Crazy Taxi 3: High Roller brings the legendary arcade racing series to Sin City with all-new drivers and cabs built for maximum mayhem. Tear through neon-lit casinos, leap off parking garages, and blast through the famous Strip while picking up fares and pulling off insane stunts. Master the Crazy Hop to bounce over traffic and reach secret shortcuts. Chain together Crazy Drifts and Crazy Boosts to rack up massive tips. Choose from classic Arcade mode or tackle challenging Crazy X missions that push your driving skills to the limit. With four unique drivers, each with their own style, and a pumping soundtrack that perfectly captures the Vegas vibe, every ride is a high-stakes thrill ride where speed equals cash!

title: Crimson Skies: High Road to Revenge
description: Take to the skies in this swashbuckling aerial adventure set in an alternate 1930s where air pirates rule fragmented North America. As Nathan Zachary, leader of the Fortune Hunters gang, engage in thrilling dogfights using customizable aircraft armed with rockets, machine guns, and devastating special weapons. Master acrobatic maneuvers like barrel rolls and split-S turns to outfly rival gangs and militia forces. Explore exotic locations from tropical islands to massive zeppelins, completing daring missions that blend combat with aerial stunts. Steal enemy planes mid-flight, discover hidden treasures, and build your reputation as the most feared pirate of the skies. With arcade-style controls and spectacular set pieces, experience the golden age of aviation through a pulp fiction lens.

title: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon
description: Based on the legendary film, Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon delivers breathtaking martial arts action on Xbox. Master the art of wire-fu combat as you play through the intertwining stories of Li Mu Bai, Yu Shu Lien, and Jen Yu. Execute gravity-defying moves, run along walls, and leap across rooftops in beautifully rendered ancient China. The innovative fighting system combines weapon-based combat with acrobatic martial arts, letting you wield the legendary Green Destiny sword alongside other traditional weapons. Each character possesses unique fighting styles and special moves inspired by the film's choreography. Experience intense boss battles, explore atmospheric environments from bustling markets to serene temples, and unlock new combos as you progress. With its cinematic presentation and fluid combat mechanics, this adventure captures the elegance and excitement of wuxia storytelling.

title: CSI: Crime Scene Investigation
description: Step into the shoes of a CSI investigator in this thrilling crime-solving adventure based on the hit TV series. Examine crime scenes across Las Vegas, collecting evidence with authentic forensic tools including fingerprint dusters, UV lights, and casting kits. Interview witnesses and suspects to uncover crucial information, then analyze your findings in the crime lab using DNA sequencers, comparison microscopes, and chemical analysis equipment. Work alongside the show's characters as you piece together clues to solve five interconnected cases. Each investigation challenges your deductive reasoning and observation skills through realistic crime scene recreation. Master evidence collection techniques, interrogation tactics, and lab procedures to crack complex cases ranging from murders to robberies. The game faithfully recreates the CSI experience with authentic dialogue, detailed environments, and challenging puzzles that demand careful attention to detail.

title: Curious George
description: Join Curious George on a delightful adventure filled with puzzles and exploration! Help everyone's favorite monkey navigate through colorful environments inspired by the beloved books and TV series. Use George's curiosity and problem-solving skills to complete fun mini-games and challenges. Interact with familiar characters like The Man with the Yellow Hat while discovering hidden areas and collecting bananas. Each level presents unique puzzles that encourage creative thinking - from painting and building to pattern matching and counting. The game features simple controls perfect for younger players, with helpful hints ensuring no one gets stuck. Bright, cheerful graphics bring George's world to life as you explore the city, countryside, and even outer space. Educational elements seamlessly blend with entertainment, teaching basic concepts through play.

title: Curse: The Eye of Isis
description: Step into the British Museum of 1890 where an ancient Egyptian artifact has unleashed supernatural chaos. As Victoria Sutton or Darien Dane, battle mummies, demons and undead creatures through Victorian London and mystical Egypt. This survival horror adventure blends intense combat with clever puzzles as you wield period weapons and powerful Egyptian artifacts. Navigate atmospheric environments from fog-shrouded streets to cursed tombs, uncovering the mystery behind the Eye of Isis statue. Experience dynamic gameplay that shifts between action-packed battles and tense exploration. With its unique Victorian-Egyptian setting, compelling dual-protagonist story, and mix of gunplay and supernatural abilities, Curse delivers a distinctive horror experience that stands apart from typical survival horror games.

title: Custom Robo Arena
description: Build and battle with customizable robots in this strategic action RPG! Custom Robo Arena puts you in command of miniature fighting machines called robos, which you can equip with hundreds of different parts including bodies, guns, bombs, pods, and legs. Each component drastically changes your robo's fighting style and abilities. Engage in fast-paced 3D battles in confined holographic arenas where strategy matters as much as reflexes. The deep story mode follows your journey through an underground robo battling scene, uncovering conspiracies while climbing the ranks. Master the rock-paper-scissors combat system where different robo types counter each other. Challenge friends in multiplayer battles via DS wireless play, testing your custom builds against theirs. With endless customization possibilities and tactical depth beneath its accessible exterior, every battle offers new strategies to discover.

title: Dai Senryaku VII: Modern Military Tactics
description: Command the battlefield in this deep turn-based strategy masterpiece that brings modern warfare to your fingertips. Deploy over 400 authentic military units including tanks, helicopters, fighter jets, and naval vessels across massive hexagonal battlefields. Master complex supply lines, weather conditions, and terrain advantages as you orchestrate combined arms operations. Choose from multiple nations, each with unique units and capabilities, in campaigns spanning global conflict zones. The sophisticated AI challenges even veteran strategists while the comprehensive scenario editor lets you craft custom battles. With its meticulous attention to military detail, realistic unit stats, and tactical depth, Dai Senryaku VII delivers the ultimate modern warfare simulation for strategy enthusiasts.

title: Dance Dance Revolution Ultramix
description: Get ready to move as Dance Dance Revolution Ultramix brings the ultimate dance party to Xbox! Step onto the dance mat and hit arrows in perfect sync with over 70 energizing tracks spanning pop, techno, house, and classic DDR favorites. This exclusive Xbox edition features online play through Xbox Live, letting you battle dancers worldwide in competitive modes or download new songs and challenges. Create custom step routines with the edit mode, practice with tutorial lessons, or party with up to 4 players simultaneously. Ultramix introduces exclusive remixes and licensed hits you won't find anywhere else, plus EyeToy support for full-body motion tracking. Whether you're a DDR veteran or newcomer, multiple difficulty levels ensure everyone can join the rhythm revolution. With workout mode tracking calories burned, it's fitness disguised as pure fun!

title: Dance Dance Revolution Ultramix 2
description: Dance Dance Revolution Ultramix 2 brings the ultimate dance party to Xbox with over 70 songs spanning genres from pop and techno to hip-hop and R&B. Step to the beat on your dance pad as arrows scroll up the screen, matching your moves to increasingly complex patterns across multiple difficulty levels. This sequel introduces Xbox Live support for online competitions and downloadable song packs, letting you expand your library and challenge dancers worldwide. Create custom step charts with Edit Mode, practice specific sections in Training Mode, or party with up to 4 players simultaneously. Featuring exclusive remixes, licensed hits, and Konami originals, plus new game modes like Quest Mode's RPG-style progression. The enhanced graphics showcase dynamic backgrounds and effects that react to your performance, creating an immersive club atmosphere right in your living room.

title: Dance Dance Revolution Ultramix 3
description: Dance Dance Revolution Ultramix 3 brings the ultimate dance party to Xbox with over 70 songs spanning genres from pop and techno to hip-hop and R&B. Step to the beat using the dance mat controller as arrows scroll up the screen, matching your moves to increasingly complex patterns across multiple difficulty levels. Features exclusive Xbox Live support for downloading new songs and competing in online tournaments against dancers worldwide. Quest Mode offers RPG-style progression through dance battles, while Party Mode includes fun variations like Attack Mode where players sabotage opponents. Create custom step patterns with Edit Mode, practice specific sections in Training, or challenge friends in heated multiplayer battles for up to 4 players. With licensed hits and Konami originals, eye-catching visuals, and addictive gameplay that doubles as a workout, this is the definitive home DDR experience.

title: Dance Dance Revolution Ultramix 4
description: Dance Dance Revolution Ultramix 4 brings the ultimate dance party to Xbox with over 70 songs spanning pop, hip-hop, techno, and classic DDR favorites. Step to the beat using the dance pad controller as arrows scroll up the screen, matching your moves to increasingly complex patterns across multiple difficulty levels. The exclusive Xbox Live support lets you download new songs, compete in online tournaments, and challenge players worldwide. Quest Mode offers RPG-style progression as you unlock new content, while Party Mode features mini-games and special challenges for up to 4 players. Freestyle mode captures your original dance moves with the Xbox Live Vision Camera. With enhanced graphics, responsive controls, and a massive soundtrack including exclusive remixes, Ultramix 4 delivers the definitive home DDR experience that gets everyone moving.

title: Dark Angel: Vampire Apocalypse
description: In a gothic nightmare realm, unleash havoc as Anna, a deadly half-vampire warrior armed with an arsenal of supernatural weapons and dark powers. This intense action RPG blends frantic hack-and-slash combat with RPG progression as you battle through hordes of undead creatures and demonic forces. Master devastating combo attacks, wield everything from dual blades to magical scythes, and harness vampiric abilities to drain enemies' life force. Explore sprawling dark fantasy environments filled with secrets, upgrade your skills through an extensive ability tree, and collect powerful artifacts to enhance your combat prowess. Face off against towering boss monsters in epic battles that test your reflexes and strategy. With its blend of gothic horror atmosphere, visceral combat, and deep customization options, Dark Angel delivers a brutally satisfying vampire power fantasy.

title: Darkwatch
description: In this supernatural Western shooter, you play as Jericho Cross, an outlaw turned vampire who must battle the undead forces he inadvertently unleashed. Darkwatch blends Wild West gunslinging with gothic horror, offering both first-person shooting action and unique vampire powers. Choose your path between good and evil, with your decisions affecting which supernatural abilities you gain. Wield an arsenal of period weapons enhanced with dark technology, from the Redeemer pistol to the Rail Rocket launcher. Fight through haunted frontier towns, cursed mines, and demonic citadels while facing off against zombies, banshees, and other nightmarish creatures. The game features intense vehicle sections where you control steam-powered horses and armored trains. Your vampire curse grants abilities like Blood Shield and Shadow Jump, adding tactical depth to combat. With its distinctive art style mixing Western and horror aesthetics, Darkwatch delivers a unique twist on both genres.

title: Dave Mirra Freestyle BMX 2
description: Pull off insane tricks and combos as you shred through massive freestyle BMX environments with legend Dave Mirra and an all-star roster of pro riders. Master over 1,500 trick combinations across 10 sprawling levels including Woodward Camp, Venice Beach, and the Galloon water park. Create custom parks with the robust Park Editor, then share your designs with friends. Experience multiple game modes from classic Career to intense multiplayer battles. Customize your rider's appearance and bike setup for the ultimate personal style. The refined control system lets you link manuals, grinds, and aerial tricks into jaw-dropping combos. Featuring a killer soundtrack and authentic BMX culture, this sequel delivers the deepest trick system and most creative freedom in extreme sports gaming.

title: David Beckham Soccer
description: Step onto the pitch with one of football's greatest icons in David Beckham Soccer! Experience the beautiful game through the eyes of the legendary midfielder, featuring his signature pinpoint passing, devastating free kicks, and unmatched crossing ability. Master Beckham's trademark bend as you curve shots around walls and deliver inch-perfect crosses to your strikers. The game showcases realistic ball physics that let you replicate Beckham's most famous goals and assists. Build your dream team in career mode, compete in international tournaments, or perfect your skills in training challenges designed around Beckham's techniques. With authentic stadiums, dynamic weather conditions, and commentary that captures the excitement of match day, every game feels like a Premier League showdown. Whether you're scoring from 30 yards out or threading a through ball to split the defense, you'll feel the precision and flair that made Beckham a global superstar.

title: Dead Man's Hand
description: Step into the boots of El Tejon, a gunslinger seeking revenge in this explosive Wild West FPS adventure. Dead Man's Hand delivers intense shootouts across dusty frontier towns, saloons, and desert canyons with its innovative "Dead Eye" targeting system that slows time for precision shots. Duel bandits in quick-draw showdowns, blast through environments with dynamite, and master an arsenal of authentic period weapons including revolvers, rifles, and shotguns. The game blends arcade action with strategic gunplay as you face off against outlaws, corrupt lawmen, and rival gangs. Unique hand-to-hand combat lets you throw devastating punches and use bottles as weapons when bullets run dry. With its cel-shaded visual style, atmospheric Old West soundtrack, and over-the-top action sequences, Dead Man's Hand captures the spirit of classic Western films while delivering non-stop gunslinging thrills.

title: Dead or Alive 3
description: Dead or Alive 3 brings explosive martial arts combat exclusively to Xbox with stunning visual fidelity that showcases the console's power. Master 16 unique fighters, each wielding distinct fighting styles from Muay Thai to Ninjutsu, as you battle across multi-tiered interactive arenas. The revolutionary counter system creates intense mind games where split-second timing determines victory. Environments become weapons as you knock opponents through walls, off cliffs, and down steep slopes for massive damage. Tag Team mode doubles the strategy, letting you swap fighters mid-combo for devastating team attacks. Smooth 60fps gameplay ensures every strike, parry, and throw flows with lifelike precision. From snowy mountain temples to tropical beaches, each stage offers unique hazards and breakable elements that keep fights unpredictable and thrilling.

title: Dead or Alive Ultimate
description: Dead or Alive Ultimate delivers the definitive 3D fighting experience on Xbox, combining enhanced versions of the original Dead or Alive and Dead or Alive 2. Master devastating combos and signature moves across diverse fighters, each with unique martial arts styles. The revolutionary counter system creates intense mind games where perfectly timed reversals can turn the tide of battle instantly. Interactive multi-tiered arenas feature destructible environments - smash opponents through windows, off cliffs, or into explosive danger zones for massive damage. Experience silky-smooth 60fps gameplay with stunning character models and fluid animations. Battle online via Xbox Live in ranked matches or create custom tournaments. Unlock costumes, survival mode, and tag-team battles add incredible replay value to this landmark fighting series.

title: Dead or Alive Xtreme Beach Volleyball
description: Trade intense fighting for sun-soaked competition as the Dead or Alive ladies hit the beach in this unique volleyball spin-off. Master the art of beach volleyball with intuitive controls that blend arcade accessibility with surprising depth. Time your spikes, blocks, and serves perfectly while reading your partner's movements for devastating combos. Between matches, build friendships through gift-giving, explore Zack Island's casino and shops, and collect hundreds of swimsuits and accessories. Each character brings unique stats and playstyles to the sand, demanding different strategies. Stunning graphics showcase paradise beaches while the innovative relationship system affects on-court chemistry. Experience DOA's signature style in an unexpectedly addictive sports package.

title: Dead to Rights
description: Play as Jack Slate, a tough K-9 cop framed for murder in Grant City's criminal underworld. Dead to Rights delivers intense action combining gunplay, hand-to-hand combat, and unique disarm moves that let you steal enemies' weapons mid-fight. Your canine partner Shadow assists in battle, attacking foes and retrieving weapons on command. The game features bullet-time slow-motion diving, allowing stylish John Woo-inspired shootouts. Navigate through prisons, construction sites, and seedy nightclubs while uncovering a conspiracy that goes to the city's highest levels. Mini-games including arm wrestling, exotic dancing, and bomb defusing break up the action. With its gritty noir atmosphere and brutal combat system, Dead to Rights offers a dark revenge tale where survival means fighting dirty.

title: Dead to Rights II
description: Jack Slate returns with his K-9 partner Shadow in this gritty action sequel that cranks up the intensity. Unleash brutal hand-to-hand combat with bone-crushing disarms and human shield tactics while Shadow attacks enemies on command. The innovative targeting system lets you dive through the air in slow-motion, picking off multiple foes with deadly precision. Navigate the criminal underworld of Grant City through explosive shootouts, high-speed chases, and intense brawls. Master an arsenal of weapons from pistols to shotguns, using everything from exploding barrels to thrown objects as improvised weapons. With its signature blend of martial arts, gunplay, and canine partnership, Dead to Rights II delivers raw, unfiltered action where survival means fighting dirty.

title: Deathrow
description: Deathrow blends brutal full-contact sports with intense combat in a dystopian future where winning means survival. Lead your team through the underground Blitz Disc League, combining bone-crushing melee combat with strategic disc-throwing gameplay. Master each team's unique fighting styles and special moves as you battle across dangerous arenas filled with environmental hazards. The innovative combat system lets you pummel opponents with devastating combos before stealing the disc for a goal. Build your squad's skills through the extensive career mode, unlocking new teams and arenas. Experience visceral 4-on-4 matches where violence is encouraged and dirty tactics are essential. With its cel-shaded visuals, hard-hitting soundtrack, and seamless blend of sports and fighting mechanics, Deathrow delivers an adrenaline-fueled competition where only the strongest survive.

title: Def Jam: Fight for NY
description: Def Jam: Fight for NY transforms hip-hop culture into brutal street fighting action. Create your fighter and battle through New York's underground scene alongside rap legends like Snoop Dogg, Method Man, and Busta Rhymes. Master five fighting styles including street fighting, kickboxing, and submission wrestling. The innovative Blazin' moves system lets you unleash devastating signature attacks unique to each character. Build your reputation across five NYC boroughs, earning respect and cash to customize your fighter with authentic streetwear, tattoos, and bling. Environmental hazards turn every venue into a weapon - throw opponents into speakers, through windows, or into crowds. With over 40 playable hip-hop artists and celebrities, deep create-a-fighter options, and an immersive story mode featuring voice acting from the actual artists, this is street fighting at its most stylish and savage.

title: Def Jam Vendetta
description: Step into the underground world where hip-hop meets hardcore wrestling in Def Jam Vendetta. Battle as or against hip-hop icons including DMX, Ludacris, Method Man, and Redman in this revolutionary fighting game that blends street brawling with professional wrestling moves. Master each fighter's unique style, from bone-crushing power moves to lightning-fast strikes. The innovative Blazin' system lets you build momentum to unleash devastating special attacks that can turn the tide of any match. Fight across gritty urban venues from warehouses to nightclubs, each with interactive environments you can use to punish opponents. Create your own fighter and rise through the ranks of the underground circuit, earning respect and cash to customize your appearance. With its hard-hitting soundtrack and authentic street culture, Def Jam Vendetta delivers brutal combat that captures the raw energy of hip-hop's competitive spirit.

title: Demon Stone
description: Hack and slash through a dark fantasy epic inspired by the Forgotten Realms universe. Control three unique warriors - a human fighter, a drow sorcerer, and a half-orc rogue - switching between them instantly to unleash devastating combo attacks. Battle hordes of orcs, dragons, and demons across richly detailed environments as you race to stop the release of two ancient evils. Master each character's distinct abilities: the fighter's brute strength, the sorcerer's powerful magic, and the rogue's stealth and agility. Experience a gripping story penned by bestselling author R.A. Salvatore, featuring the voices of Patrick Stewart and Michael Clarke Duncan. Chain together brutal melee combos, cast spectacular spells, and execute team-based super moves in this cinematic action adventure that brings tabletop fantasy to explosive life.

title: Destroy All Humans!
description: Step into the shoes of Crypto-137, a wise-cracking alien invader bent on harvesting human DNA to save his species from extinction. Unleash chaos across 1950s America with an arsenal of alien weaponry including the Disintegrator Ray, Zap-O-Matic, and the devastating Quantum Deconstructor. Read human thoughts with telepathy, assume their identities with the Holobob disguise system, and toss civilians around with psychokinetic powers. Pilot your flying saucer to rain destruction from above, reducing entire towns to rubble with death rays and sonic booms. Complete probe-happy missions while battling the military, Men in Black, and paranoid suburbanites. This remake features gorgeously updated graphics, refined controls, and all the B-movie humor of the cult classic. Destroy All Humans! delivers pure mayhem wrapped in satirical sci-fi comedy.

title: Destroy All Humans! 2
description: Make way for Crypto-137 as he returns to Earth in the groovy 1960s! This open-world action game lets you unleash alien mayhem across the globe, from Bay City to Tokyo and beyond. Use your flying saucer to rain destruction from above, or get up close with an arsenal of alien weapons including the Dislocator and Meteor Strike. Read human minds, assume their identities with body-snatching abilities, and manipulate objects with psychokinesis. The Cold War setting adds spy thriller elements as you battle Soviet agents and uncover conspiracies. Split-screen co-op lets a friend join as Crypto's deadly companion Natalya. With improved combat mechanics, larger environments, and even more outrageous humor than the original, this sequel delivers pure sci-fi chaos wrapped in 60s counterculture style.

title: Deus Ex: Invisible War
description: Step into a cyberpunk future where every choice reshapes the world. Deus Ex: Invisible War thrusts you into a conspiracy-riddled 2072, twenty years after the original's nano-augmented revolution. As Alex D, navigate the power struggle between competing factions vying for global control. Your decisions determine humanity's fate - will you side with the Templars' totalitarian order, the Omar's post-human vision, or forge your own path? Blend stealth, combat, and diplomacy using biomods that grant superhuman abilities. Hack security systems, engage in philosophical debates, or unleash devastating weapons. Multiple solutions exist for every challenge. This ambitious RPG-shooter hybrid delivers branching storylines, moral complexity, and emergent gameplay where your choices echo across a fractured world teetering between order and chaos.

title: Digimon Rumble Arena 2
description: Battle as your favorite Digimon in this explosive 3D fighting game! Digimon Rumble Arena 2 brings together over 40 playable characters from across the Digital World, including fan favorites from all four TV seasons. Master each Digimon's unique moves and unleash devastating Digivolution transformations mid-battle to turn the tide of combat. Fight across interactive multi-tiered arenas filled with hazards and power-ups that keep matches unpredictable. Challenge friends in frantic 4-player battles or test your skills in single-player mode. With fast-paced combat, screen-filling special attacks, and the ability to Digivolve into more powerful forms during battle, every match delivers intense action. The ultimate Digimon fighting experience awaits!

title: Dino Crisis 3
description: In the year 2548, a massive spaceship reappears after vanishing centuries ago - now overrun with deadly dinosaurs. As elite SORT member Patrick Tyler, navigate zero-gravity environments and face genetically mutated prehistoric creatures in this survival horror sequel. Master the jetpack-based movement system to dodge attacks and explore the labyrinthine Ozymandias vessel. Switch between characters, each with unique abilities and perspectives on the unfolding mystery. Combat evolved dinosaurs using futuristic weapons while managing limited resources. The dynamic camera system heightens tension as threats lurk around every corner. Solve environmental puzzles to unlock new areas and uncover the truth behind the ship's transformation. Experience intense boss battles against massive creatures in spectacular zero-G showdowns.

title: Dinosaur Hunting
description: Time travel to prehistoric eras hunting dinosaurs in this budget Carnivores clone. Armed with period-inappropriate weapons, track everything from Velociraptors to T-Rex across different time periods. The AI creates somewhat believable behavior with herbivores fleeing and carnivores stalking. Trophy collection and scoring system rewards clean kills and dangerous game. Environments from jungles to deserts provide hunting variety. The bullet physics account for wind and distance requiring actual marksmanship. Survival mode pits you against waves of aggressive dinosaurs. While clearly low-budget with dated graphics and limited content, Dinosaur Hunting delivers exactly what the title promises. For dinosaur enthusiasts seeking prehistoric hunting, it scratches that specific itch.

title: Disney's Extreme Skate Adventure
description: Join your favorite Disney characters in an extreme skateboarding adventure! Shred through magical worlds inspired by Toy Story, The Lion King, and Tarzan as you play as Buzz Lightyear, Woody, Simba, Rafiki, Tarzan, and Terk. Pull off incredible tricks and combos across vibrant levels filled with rails, ramps, and halfpipes. Master the intuitive Tony Hawk-style gameplay engine that makes pulling off kickflips, grinds, and aerial stunts accessible for all ages. Complete exciting challenges, unlock new characters and boards, and discover hidden areas in each themed world. Experience the perfect blend of Disney magic and skateboarding action with colorful graphics, authentic character voices, and a rockin' soundtrack. Whether grinding through Andy's Room, skating Pride Rock, or launching off jungle vines, every session delivers pure skateboarding fun with a Disney twist that kids and families will love.

title: Doom 3
description: A terrifying reimagining of the classic shooter, Doom 3 plunges you into the darkest corners of a Mars research facility overrun by demonic forces. As a lone marine, you battle through pitch-black corridors where shadows hide unspeakable horrors. The revolutionary dynamic lighting system transforms every encounter into a heart-pounding experience - your flashlight becomes as vital as your shotgun when choosing between seeing threats or defending yourself. Navigate claustrophobic environments filled with audio logs and PDAs that reveal the facility's gruesome fate. Face grotesque demons emerging from Hell itself, from zombie workers to massive boss creatures. With an arsenal ranging from the trusty shotgun to the devastating BFG 9000, you'll need every weapon to survive. This atmospheric horror-shooter masterpiece blends intense combat with genuine scares, creating an unforgettable journey through sci-fi hell.

title: Doom 3: Resurrection of Evil
description: Return to Mars in this terrifying expansion to Doom 3. As a combat engineer investigating a distress signal from the abandoned UAC facility, you discover an ancient Martian relic that unleashes Hell's forces once again. Battle through eight haunting levels with devastating new weapons including the double-barreled Super Shotgun and the Grabber, a physics-based tool that catches and hurls objects at enemies. Face nightmarish new demons like the lightning-fast Vulgar and the bruising Bruiser while utilizing the Artifact - a mysterious device with time-manipulation powers. Experience enhanced combat with more aggressive enemies and ammunition, shifting the gameplay toward intense action over survival horror. Resurrection of Evil delivers a concentrated dose of demon-slaying mayhem with improved pacing and relentless battles through Hell's darkest corners.

title: Dr. Muto
description: Enter the twisted world of Dr. Muto, a mad scientist whose laboratory mishap destroyed his home planet! Transform into five bizarre creatures to navigate through alien worlds and undo your catastrophic mistake. Morph into a spider to crawl walls, become a gorilla for brute strength, or shift into a mouse to access tiny spaces. Each transformation grants unique abilities essential for solving puzzles and defeating enemies. Explore four distinct planets filled with quirky inhabitants, from the junkyard world of Flotos to the aquatic realm of Aquem. Collect DNA samples and isotopes to power your transformations while battling Dr. Muto's rival, Professor Burnital. This action-platformer blends dark humor with inventive gameplay mechanics, challenging you to master each creature form's strengths. Save the galaxy from your own scientific disaster in this delightfully demented adventure!

title: Dr. Seuss' The Cat in the Hat
description: Join the Cat in the Hat on a whimsical adventure through the pages of Dr. Seuss's beloved book! Play as Conrad or Sally in this colorful 3D platformer as you explore the zany world that materializes when the Cat arrives. Navigate through imaginative levels filled with Seuss-inspired contraptions, bounce on giant springs, slide down twisting tubes, and use the Cat's magical umbrella to glide across gaps. Collect special items to unlock bonus content while avoiding the chaos caused by Thing One and Thing Two. Meet classic characters like the Fish and Mr. Quinn as you solve puzzles and complete mini-games. With vibrant graphics that bring Seuss's illustrations to life, voice acting from the movie cast, and gameplay designed for younger players, this family-friendly adventure captures the playful spirit of the classic tale. Clean up the mess before Mom gets home!

title: Dragon Ball Z: Sagas
description: Experience the legendary Dragon Ball Z saga in this action-packed adventure that lets you relive the anime's most epic battles. Play as Goku, Vegeta, Gohan, and other Z-Warriors as you fight through iconic story arcs from Saiyan to Cell sagas. Unleash devastating combos, signature moves, and screen-filling special attacks in intense 3D combat. Destroy environments, send enemies flying through mountains, and transform into Super Saiyan forms for explosive power-ups. Master each character's unique fighting style while collecting Z-Coins to unlock new abilities and upgrades. Face legendary villains like Frieza, Cell, and the Ginyu Force in massive boss battles. With co-op gameplay, team up with a friend to tackle challenges together and combine attacks for devastating team combos.

title: Dragon's Lair 3D: Return to the Lair
description: Guide the bumbling knight Dirk through a fully 3D reimagining of the classic Dragon's Lair adventure. Navigate treacherous castle corridors, dodge deadly traps, and battle supernatural foes using precise timing and quick reflexes. This action-platformer transforms the original's quick-time events into dynamic gameplay where you directly control Dirk's sword swings, jumps, and evasive maneuvers. Explore Princess Daphne's castle in stunning cel-shaded graphics that capture Don Bluth's iconic animation style. Face off against the evil wizard Mordroc and his minions across diverse environments filled with puzzles and perilous obstacles. Master combo attacks, collect magical essences to unlock new abilities, and relive the legendary quest that defined arcade gaming, now with full 3D exploration and combat.

title: Drake of the 99 Dragons
description: Drake of the 99 Dragons follows undead assassin Drake on his quest for vengeance after his clan's massacre. Wield dual pistols and supernatural powers in this third-person action shooter featuring unique cel-shaded visuals. Master Drake's acrobatic combat system with wall-running, slow-motion gunplay, and devastating spirit powers. Navigate through stylized environments blending modern cityscapes with mystical Asian themes. Collect ancient artifacts to unlock new abilities and uncover the conspiracy behind your clan's destruction. Experience innovative gameplay mechanics including the ability to absorb souls for power-ups and use Drake's immortality to your tactical advantage in intense firefights against rival gangs and supernatural foes.

title: Dreamfall: The Longest Journey
description: Embark on an epic adventure across parallel worlds in this critically acclaimed action-adventure sequel. Play as Zoë Castillo, a student in futuristic Casablanca, April Ryan, the hero from the original game, and Kian, an apostle assassin, as their paths intertwine in a story of dreams and reality. Experience a mature narrative that tackles themes of faith, destiny, and choice while exploring beautifully realized environments from cyberpunk cityscapes to magical realms. Solve puzzles, engage in dialogue-driven gameplay, and make decisions that shape the story. With stunning visuals, an emotional soundtrack, and fully voiced characters, Dreamfall delivers a cinematic experience that blends science fiction with fantasy. Uncover conspiracies, face moral dilemmas, and discover the connection between dreams and the fate of two worlds in this unforgettable journey.

title: Driv3r
description: Take on the role of undercover cop Tanner in this explosive action-driving thriller spanning three iconic cities - Miami, Nice, and Istanbul. Master over 70 vehicles from high-performance sports cars to motorcycles and speedboats as you infiltrate a global car theft ring. Seamlessly blend white-knuckle driving missions with on-foot gunplay, using an arsenal of weapons to survive deadly shootouts. Experience Hollywood-style car chases through destructible environments, perform insane stunts, and explore massive open-world cities packed with side missions. The innovative Film Director mode lets you capture and edit your own action sequences, creating custom movies of your most spectacular moments. With its gritty storyline, diverse gameplay mechanics, and stunning visuals, DRIV3R delivers the ultimate cops-and-robbers experience where every chase could be your last.

title: Driver: Parallel Lines
description: Take control of T.K., a skilled wheelman caught in a web of betrayal spanning two distinct eras of New York City. Experience the gritty streets of 1978 and the modern metropolis of 2006 as you seek revenge against those who wronged you. Master over 80 authentic vehicles from muscle cars to motorcycles, each with unique handling and customization options. Engage in high-speed chases, explosive shootouts, and daring heists across a fully explorable Manhattan. Switch seamlessly between on-foot combat and vehicular mayhem as you build your criminal empire. The revolutionary era-jumping storyline lets you witness how your actions in the past shape the future city. Complete diverse missions ranging from taxi driving to assassination contracts while exploring a living, breathing world filled with dynamic weather and day-night cycles.

title: Dungeons & Dragons: Heroes
description: Venture into the Forgotten Realms in this action-packed hack-and-slash adventure designed exclusively for Xbox. Choose from four distinct heroes - a mighty Fighter, cunning Rogue, powerful Wizard, or divine Cleric - each with unique abilities and playstyles. Battle through dungeons filled with classic D&D monsters like beholders, mind flayers, and dragons while collecting legendary loot and magical artifacts. The game features drop-in/drop-out cooperative gameplay for up to four players, letting friends join your quest at any time. Level up your character, unlock devastating special attacks, and customize your equipment as you fight to stop the evil vampire Kaedin from unleashing an ancient horror upon the world.

title: Dynasty Warriors 3
description: Command the greatest warriors of China's Three Kingdoms era in this epic hack-and-slash battlefield experience. Dynasty Warriors 3 delivers massive-scale warfare where you single-handedly face thousands of enemy soldiers in real-time combat. Choose from over 40 legendary officers, each with unique weapons and devastating Musou attacks that can turn the tide of battle. Experience the complete Romance of the Three Kingdoms saga through multiple character perspectives, with branching storylines that change based on your battlefield performance. Master combo systems, unlock powerful fourth weapons, and dominate strategic points to shift morale in your favor. Two-player split-screen co-op lets you conquer ancient China together, while Free Mode offers endless replayability across historic battlefields. Feel the rush of being an unstoppable one-warrior army.

title: Dynasty Warriors 4
description: Command the battlefield in Dynasty Warriors 4, where ancient China's greatest warriors clash in epic combat. Choose from over 40 legendary officers and carve your path through the chaotic Three Kingdoms era. Master devastating combo attacks and unleash powerful Musou special moves to obliterate hundreds of enemies in spectacular fashion. Experience refined gameplay with the new duel system for intense one-on-one battles against rival generals. Create custom officers, forge weapons, and unlock hidden scenarios across multiple story campaigns. Strategic elements blend with hack-and-slash action as you capture bases, protect allies, and turn the tide of massive battles. With improved graphics, smoother combat, and deeper customization than ever before, Dynasty Warriors 4 delivers the ultimate historical warfare experience.

title: Dynasty Warriors 5
description: Command legendary warriors across ancient China's most pivotal battles in this epic hack-and-slash adventure. Dynasty Warriors 5 delivers massive-scale warfare where you single-handedly turn the tide against thousands of enemies. Choose from 48 unique officers, each with distinct weapons and fighting styles, as you carve through enemy ranks with devastating combos and powerful Musou attacks. Experience the legendary Three Kingdoms saga through multiple story modes, witnessing history unfold from different perspectives. Strategic elements blend with intense action as you capture bases, rescue allies, and duel rival generals.
