Support for up to 12 players via Xbox Live, LAN, or direct connection brings authentic tournament-style paintball competition to your console. With its focus on strategy, teamwork, and precise shooting mechanics, Gotcha! delivers adrenaline-pumping FPS action without the violence.

title: Grabbed by the Ghoulies
description: Explore the spooky halls of Ghoulhaven Hall in this quirky beat-'em-up adventure from Rare. As young Cooper, battle through 50 haunted rooms filled with zombies, skeletons, vampires, and mummies using everything from pool cues to toilet plungers as weapons. The innovative control scheme lets you unleash combos with the right analog stick while moving with the left. Each room presents unique challenges - defeat all enemies, survive time limits, or protect innocent captives. The game's distinctive cel-shaded art style brings a Tim Burton-esque world to life with exaggerated characters and atmospheric lighting. Collect bonus books to unlock artwork and mini-games while rescuing your girlfriend from the mansion's ghoulish inhabitants. With its family-friendly horror theme and arcade-style gameplay, this Xbox exclusive delivers accessible fun with surprising depth.

title: Grand Theft Auto III
description: Experience Liberty City's criminal underworld in this groundbreaking open-world action game that revolutionized gaming. Play as Claude, a betrayed criminal seeking revenge through the city's seedy districts. Hijack any vehicle, from sports cars to ambulances, and explore a living, breathing metropolis with total freedom. Accept missions from mob bosses, corrupt cops, and street gangs, or simply cause mayhem on your own terms. The pioneering 3D sandbox design lets you approach objectives however you choose - guns blazing, stealthy infiltration, or creative chaos. Radio stations provide the perfect soundtrack as you build your criminal empire through robbery, assassination, and destruction. This is the game that defined open-world gaming.

title: Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas
description: Return to the streets of San Andreas, a massive state spanning three cities teeming with gang warfare, corrupt cops, and urban decay. As CJ, fresh back from Liberty City, you're thrust into a web of betrayal and violence that threatens your family and old crew. Build your criminal empire through heists, turf wars, and business ventures. Master everything from street racing to casino robberies, pilot aircraft from jets to jetpacks, and customize CJ's skills, physique, and style. The sprawling open world offers unprecedented freedom - swim, climb, eat, work out, dance, and date across Los Santos, San Fierro, and Las Venturas. With an epic storyline spanning the early 90s gang culture, this groundbreaking sandbox redefined gaming.

title: Grand Theft Auto: Vice City
description: Welcome to 1980s Vice City, a neon-soaked tropical paradise hiding a criminal empire. As Tommy Vercetti, fresh from prison, you'll rise from betrayed foot soldier to kingpin of this Miami-inspired metropolis. Cruise the sun-drenched streets in exotic sports cars, speedboats, and motorcycles while building your criminal empire through drug deals, heists, and hostile takeovers. The city pulses with an authentic '80s soundtrack featuring era-defining hits as you navigate a web of corrupt politicians, drug lords, and rival gangs. From Ocean Beach to Little Haiti, every district offers unique missions and opportunities. Buy properties, eliminate rivals, and experience the dark side of the American Dream in this groundbreaking open-world crime saga that defined a generation.

title: Gravity Games Bike: Street Vert Dirt
description: Ride alongside BMX legends in this extreme sports title featuring 21 pro riders including Jamie Bestwick, Dennis McCoy, and Fuzzy Hall. Shred through 10 massive levels spanning street courses, vert ramps, and dirt tracks, each packed with objectives to unlock new areas. Pull off insane tricks using an accessible control scheme - one button initiates tricks while another modifies them mid-air for endless combo possibilities. Unlike competitors, this game rewards consistent scoring for repeated tricks, letting you perfect your favorite moves without penalty. Challenge friends in multiple multiplayer modes from trick competitions to racing showdowns. While criticized for technical issues including collision detection and graphical glitches, the game's expansive level designs offer plenty of lines to explore. Experience the official Gravity Games competition atmosphere in Midway's only licensed extreme sports entry.

title: The Great Escape
description: Relive the legendary 1963 film in this stealth-action adventure where 76 Allied POWs plot history's most daring breakout from Stalag Luft III. Play as four distinct characters including Steve McQueen's iconic Hilts, experiencing their backstories through flashback missions before orchestrating the main escape. Master stealth mechanics to avoid German guards, perform reconnaissance, steal vital supplies, and execute the tunneling operation that shocked Nazi Germany. The game expands beyond the movie with thrilling sequences: hijack trains, steal fighter planes, aid the French Resistance, and make desperate motorcycle dashes for the Swiss border. Unlike the film's tragic ending, succeed where history failed as all playable characters reach freedom through rooftop chases, aerial escapes, and border crossings. Combining authentic WWII atmosphere with Hollywood drama, this delivers both faithful adaptation and original storytelling.

title: Greg Hastings' Tournament Paintball
description: Experience the intense world of competitive paintball in Greg Hastings' Tournament Paintball. Lead your team through authentic tournament scenarios across 29 real-world fields, mastering strategic gameplay that rewards tactical thinking over run-and-gun action. Execute realistic moves like sliding, diving, and snap-shooting while utilizing authentic paintball gear from top manufacturers. The innovative career mode lets you build and customize your team, recruiting players and upgrading equipment as you compete in tournaments worldwide. With split-screen multiplayer for up to 4 players and Xbox Live support, challenge friends in elimination matches or king of the hill battles. The game's unique breakout editor allows you to plan strategies and perfect your approach to each field, bringing unprecedented depth to console paintball gaming.

title: Greg Hastings' Tournament Paintball MAX'D
description: Lead your team to paintball glory in the ultimate competitive paintball experience! Command a squad through intense tournaments across 29 real-world fields, from indoor arenas to outdoor battlegrounds. Master authentic paintball tactics using genuine gear from top manufacturers like Smart Parts and JT USA. Experience the thrill of tournament play with multiple game modes including Capture the Flag, Elimination, and Center Flag. Build your dream team, customize equipment, and perfect your skills through career mode. Feel the intensity with realistic ballistics, dynamic weather, and strategic gameplay that rewards tactical thinking. Whether playing solo or with friends in split-screen multiplayer, every match delivers heart-pounding action where teamwork and precision determine victory.

title: Grooverider: Slot Car Thunder
description: Experience the ultimate slot car racing revolution in Grooverider: Slot Car Thunder! Race through 20 mind-bending tracks that defy gravity and physics, from living rooms to fantasy realms. Master the unique groove-switching mechanic to overtake rivals and discover shortcuts. Choose from 30+ customizable cars with unique handling and speed characteristics. Battle through Championship mode, take on friends in 4-player split-screen mayhem, or perfect your skills in Time Trial. Unleash devastating power-ups like turbo boosts, oil slicks, and electromagnetic pulses to dominate the competition. With arcade-style gameplay, vibrant graphics, and a pumping soundtrack, Grooverider delivers high-octane slot car action like never before.

title: Group S Challenge
description: Race fully licensed supercars from Ford, Chevrolet, and Ruf in this arcade-focused racing experience. Progress through four vehicle tiers in Championship mode, starting with Group C's entry-level cars and climbing to the elite Group S hypercars. Master unique racing disciplines: Line mode rewards precision driving along the optimal racing line for cash bonuses, while Dual mode challenges you to defeat special locked cars using three different vehicles from your garage to unlock them permanently. Arcade modes deliver classic racing thrills with single-player races against AI, split-screen versus battles, One Make races testing pure skill with identical cars, and Time Attack for chasing perfect lap times. The streamlined career mode focuses purely on racing progression without cutscenes or story elements, letting your driving skills and growing car collection tell the only story that matters.

title: Guilty Gear Isuka
description: Guilty Gear Isuka breaks the mold of traditional 2D fighters with its innovative four-player simultaneous combat system. This spin-off of the acclaimed Guilty Gear series lets you battle across sprawling multi-tiered stages where fighters can face any direction, adding tactical depth to every encounter. Choose from over 20 unique characters, each wielding distinct fighting styles and supernatural abilities. The game features multiple modes including the strategic Boost Mode where you enhance your fighter's abilities, and the addictive Beat 'Em Up style GG Boost that pits you against waves of enemies. With its signature heavy metal soundtrack, stunning hand-drawn sprites, and fast-paced combat that rewards both aggression and precision, Isuka delivers chaotic multiplayer mayhem while maintaining the series' technical depth.

title: Guilty Gear X2 #Reload
description: Unleash devastating combos in this pinnacle of 2D fighting excellence. Guilty Gear X2 #Reload refines the series' signature high-speed combat with an expanded roster of 20 unique fighters, each wielding distinct weapons and supernatural abilities. Master the innovative Roman Cancel system to extend combos and create unpredictable offense. Experience multiple game modes including Mission Mode's 100 challenges that teach advanced techniques. The stunning hand-drawn sprites and metal-inspired soundtrack by Daisuke Ishiwatari create an unforgettable audiovisual assault. Deep mechanics like Instant Kills, Burst Gauge management, and character-specific systems reward dedication while remaining accessible to newcomers. A fighting game masterpiece that balances technical depth with pure adrenaline-fueled action.

title: Gun
description: Saddle up as Colton White in this critically acclaimed Western epic that brings the lawless frontier to life. Navigate an open world where you choose to be righteous gunslinger or feared outlaw, facing resistance fighters, corrupt lawmen, renegade soldiers, and vengeful Apache and Blackfoot warriors. Experience intense third-person gunfights with period-authentic weapons, from six-shooters to rifles, as you hunt buffalo, track bounties, and survive frequent bandit ambushes between towns. The action-RPG gameplay rewards exploration through side missions including poker tournaments, cattle herding, law enforcement duties, and gold mining that earn money for weapon upgrades and stat improvements. Master the quick-draw showdown mechanic, manage your town reputation through the Patience meter, and uncover a revenge story spanning the untamed American West. This Xbox 360 launch title delivered genre-defining Western action that earned GameSpy's Action Game of the Year.

title: Gungriffon Allied Strike
description: Take command of a heavily-armed High Mobility Armored Combat System (High-MACS) and blast through intense mechanized warfare across devastated battlefields. This tactical mech combat simulator puts you in the cockpit of customizable walking tanks, engaging enemy forces with an arsenal of missiles, cannons, and energy weapons. Navigate war-torn environments from scorching deserts to frozen tundra as you complete critical missions for the Allied forces. The game features a branching campaign where your performance affects the war's outcome, realistic physics that make every step and shot count, and multiple difficulty modes to challenge pilots of all skill levels. Master your mech's complex controls, manage ammunition and armor integrity, and coordinate with allied units to survive increasingly desperate battles against overwhelming odds.

title: Gun Metal
description: Defend humanity's colony on planet Helios by piloting the transformable Havoc Suit in this explosive mech combat game. Seamlessly switch between towering humanoid mech and advanced fighter jet at the push of a button, adapting your tactics to overwhelm enemy forces. Command an arsenal of 24 devastating weapons including napalm strikes, pulse cannons, harpoons, and rocket barrages, with 8 weapons loadouts split between your two forms. Battle through 14 missions defending the human settlement from relentless alien invaders determined to exterminate the colony. As Project Gunmetal's ultimate war machine, utilize electronic shields and strategic transformation to dominate both ground and aerial combat. Unlock new weapons throughout the campaign, allowing customized loadouts that encourage experimentation and replay. This ambitious fusion of mech and flight combat delivers intense action as you become humanity's last hope against extinction.

title: Gunvalkyrie
description: In an alternate 1906 where the British Empire spans the stars, elite soldier Kelly O'Lenmey battles massive alien insects threatening humanity's colonial frontier. GunValkyrie delivers explosive aerial combat as you master the revolutionary Gearskin suit, boosting through alien-infested canyons while unleashing devastating weaponry. Chain together acrobatic maneuvers to build combos, launching yourself skyward before raining destruction on swarms below. Each mission demands mastery of the unique boost-jump mechanics that blend platforming with intense shooting action. Navigate treacherous environments from volcanic wastelands to frozen tundras, facing increasingly dangerous Spaceworms and their grotesque mutations. With its distinctive steampunk aesthetic and challenging skill-based gameplay, GunValkyrie rewards players who perfect its demanding but satisfying control scheme. Pure adrenaline-fueled action awaits those brave enough to don the Gearskin.

title: The Haunted Mansion
description: Step into the shoes of Zeke Holloway, a young aspiring ghost hunter, in this spine-tingling action-adventure based on Disney's beloved attraction. Explore the mysterious Gracey Manor, wielding your magical lantern to capture 999 ghosts haunting its twisted halls. Navigate through cleverly designed rooms filled with supernatural puzzles, hidden passages, and ghostly encounters. Your enchanted lantern serves as both weapon and tool - use it to reveal invisible platforms, unlock secret areas, and battle increasingly challenging spirits. Each captured ghost adds to your collection, unlocking new abilities and backstory elements. The mansion transforms as you progress, with rooms shifting between ethereal and physical states. Face off against powerful boss ghosts, each with unique attack patterns and weaknesses. Atmospheric sound design and eerie visuals create genuine tension as you uncover the dark secrets behind Master Gracey's curse and work to free the trapped souls within.

title: Half-Life 2
description: Step into the boots of Gordon Freeman in this revolutionary first-person shooter that redefined gaming physics and storytelling. Navigate through City 17's dystopian landscape, fighting against the oppressive Combine forces with an arsenal of weapons including the iconic Gravity Gun that turns everyday objects into deadly projectiles. Experience groundbreaking physics puzzles, intense vehicle sequences, and unforgettable characters like Alyx Vance who fight alongside you. The Source engine delivers stunning visuals and realistic interactions where every object responds naturally to your actions. From claustrophobic zombie-infested tunnels to epic street battles, Half-Life 2 seamlessly blends combat, exploration, and narrative without a single cutscene interrupting your immersion in this masterfully crafted world.

title: Halo: Combat Evolved
description: Crash-land on the mysterious ringworld Halo as Master Chief, humanity's last hope against the alien Covenant. Experience the revolutionary first-person shooter that redefined console gaming with its perfect blend of on-foot combat and vehicular warfare. Wield an arsenal of human and alien weapons, from the versatile assault rifle to the devastating energy sword. Battle through diverse environments - from lush jungles to snow-covered canyons and ancient alien structures. The adaptive AI creates dynamic firefights where enemies flank, retreat, and coordinate attacks. Seamless co-op lets you tackle the campaign with a friend, while multiplayer delivers intense 16-player battles across iconic maps. With its epic orchestral score, gripping story, and genre-defining gameplay, Halo sets the standard for sci-fi shooters.

title: Halo 2
description: Dual-wield devastating weapon combinations as Master Chief returns to battle the Covenant invasion of Earth and beyond. Experience the legendary campaign that revolutionized console shooters with seamless vehicle combat, epic set pieces, and the shocking cliffhanger that defined a generation. Switch between Master Chief and the Arbiter across two interconnected storylines spanning Earth, mysterious Halo installations, and the Covenant homeworld. Dominate in revolutionary Xbox Live multiplayer with iconic maps like Lockout and Zanzibar, customizable game modes, and clan support that created the blueprint for online console gaming. From the streets of New Mombasa to the ancient halls of Delta Halo, uncover the truth behind the Covenant's Great Journey while humanity fights for survival. Features enhanced graphics, destructible vehicles, boarding mechanics, and the series' most memorable soundtrack.

title: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets
description: Enter the magical world of Hogwarts as Harry Potter returns for his second year at the school of witchcraft and wizardry. Explore the castle's secret passages, hidden rooms, and mysterious corridors while uncovering the dark secret of the Chamber of Secrets. Master new spells including Expelliarmus and Skurge to defeat enemies and solve puzzles. Attend classes to learn magical abilities from professors like Gilderoy Lockhart. Fly on your Nimbus 2000 in exciting Quidditch matches, collect wizard cards and ingredients for potions, and duel rival students in the Dueling Club. Face dangerous creatures including spiders, pixies, and the deadly Basilisk. With action-adventure gameplay combining platforming, puzzle-solving, and spell-casting, experience the enchanting story of Harry's battle against the heir of Slytherin and save Hogwarts from an ancient evil.

title: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire
description: Experience the Triwizard Tournament in this action-packed adventure based on the fourth Harry Potter film. Play as Harry, Ron, or Hermione through exciting challenges including the dangerous tasks of the tournament - face dragons, navigate the treacherous Black Lake, and survive the deadly maze. Master powerful spells using intuitive gesture-based casting, combining magic for devastating effects. Team up with friends in cooperative gameplay to solve puzzles and defeat enemies together. Explore iconic locations from Hogwarts to the Quidditch World Cup campsite. Collect magical Triwizard Shields, unlock character upgrades, and discover hidden areas. With stunning visuals that bring the wizarding world to life, every spell feels impactful as you battle Death Eaters and magical creatures.

title: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
description: Experience the magic of Hogwarts as Harry Potter in his first year at the world's most famous wizarding school. Explore the castle's moving staircases, hidden passages, and enchanted rooms while attending classes to learn spells like Wingardium Leviosa and Flipendo. Master Quidditch on your Nimbus 2000, sneaking past Filch and Mrs. Norris after curfew, and face dangerous creatures from Devil's Snare to trolls. Collect Wizard Cards and Every Flavour Beans while solving puzzles that require both magical skill and clever thinking. Battle through platform challenges, defeat Draco in wizard duels, and ultimately confront the dark forces threatening the Philosopher's Stone. With faithful recreations of iconic locations and John Williams' memorable score, this action-adventure brings J.K. Rowling's beloved world to life.

title: Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban
description: Step into the magical world of Hogwarts as Harry, Ron, and Hermione in their third year adventure. Master powerful new spells including the Patronus Charm to defend against soul-sucking Dementors. Switch between all three characters, each with unique abilities - Harry's flying skills, Ron's strength, and Hermione's spell knowledge. Explore an expanded Hogwarts with secret passages and hidden areas while attending classes to learn new magic. Face challenging boss battles against werewolves and Dementors. Solve puzzles using teamwork and combine different character abilities. Fly Buckbeak the Hippogriff in thrilling aerial sequences. Uncover the truth about Sirius Black while navigating time-turning mysteries in this action-adventure that brings J.K. Rowling's beloved story to life.

title: Harry Potter: Quidditch World Cup
description: Mount your broomstick and experience the magical sport of Quidditch in this action-packed game based on J.K. Rowling's wizarding world. Choose from all four Hogwarts houses or international teams including USA, Bulgaria, and England as you compete for the Quidditch World Cup. Master spectacular moves like the Bludger Pass and Seeker Special Move while dodging dangerous Bludgers and racing to catch the Golden Snitch. Play through the Hogwarts season to unlock the World Cup tournament, featuring authentic stadiums from around the globe. Execute team special moves, perform combos to fill your boost meter, and unleash devastating finishing moves. With fast-paced arcade-style gameplay, multiple difficulty levels, and two-player versus mode, this captures all the excitement of Quidditch battles. Stunning visuals bring the magical sport to life with dynamic camera angles and spectacular spell effects.

title: Headhunter Redemption
description: In this cyberpunk sequel, bounty hunter Jack Wade returns to a dystopian future where corporations rule and humanity teeters on extinction. Navigate the gritty streets of a post-apocalyptic world split between the decaying Above and the subterranean Below. Master intense third-person combat mixing stealth takedowns with explosive firefights. Ride motorcycles through dangerous cityscapes while hunting targets and uncovering a conspiracy that threatens what remains of civilization. Upgrade your arsenal with futuristic weapons and gadgets as you tackle varied missions ranging from infiltration to all-out assault. Experience a dark narrative exploring themes of redemption and survival in a world where technology and humanity collide. Your choices determine whether you save or doom what's left of society.

title: Hello Kitty: Roller Rescue
description: Join Hello Kitty on an action-packed adventure to save Sanrio Town from the mischievous Block-O aliens! This colorful 3D platformer transforms the beloved character into an unlikely hero armed with a magical wand. Navigate through vibrant themed worlds inspired by Sanrio characters, from Badtz-Maru's penguin paradise to Keroppi's pond kingdom. Master platforming challenges, solve environmental puzzles, and defeat quirky enemies using special power-ups. Collect musical notes to unlock bonus content and rescue captured friends including My Melody, Pochacco, and Tuxedosam. With its cheerful soundtrack, accessible gameplay perfect for younger players, and surprising depth in later levels, Hello Kitty: Roller Rescue delivers wholesome fun that appeals to fans of all ages. Experience the magic of friendship and adventure in this delightful journey through the Sanrio universe!

title: Heroes of the Pacific
description: Take to the skies in this intense WWII aerial combat game that puts you in the cockpit of authentic warplanes across the Pacific Theater. Pilot over 35 legendary aircraft including the P-51 Mustang, F4U Corsair, and Japanese Zero as you dogfight through historically-inspired missions from Pearl Harbor to Iwo Jima. Experience massive battles with hundreds of planes filling the sky, unleash devastating bombing runs on enemy carriers, and strafe ground targets in heart-pounding attack missions. The arcade-style controls make it easy to jump into action while offering depth for ace pilots. Engage in thrilling multiplayer dogfights or tackle the expansive campaign that recreates pivotal Pacific battles. Dynamic weather and realistic damage modeling heighten the tension as you weave through flak-filled skies.

title: High Heat Major League Baseball 2004
description: Step up to the plate in High Heat Major League Baseball 2004, where authentic baseball simulation meets arcade excitement. Experience the most realistic pitching and batting mechanics of its era with the innovative 3D batting interface that lets you read pitches like a real hitter. Build dynasties in the deep Franchise mode spanning multiple seasons, or jump into quick Exhibition games featuring all 30 MLB teams and their 2003 rosters. The advanced AI adapts to your playing style while realistic player tendencies and detailed statistics bring America's pastime to life. From perfectly timed stolen bases to dramatic ninth-inning rallies, every game delivers the tension and strategy of real baseball. With comprehensive roster management, two-player showdowns, and authentic ballpark atmospheres, this is baseball gaming at its finest.

title: High Rollers Casino
description: Experience the thrill of Vegas-style gambling without the risk in High Rollers Casino. Step into a luxurious virtual casino featuring authentic recreations of classic games including Texas Hold'em Poker, Blackjack, Roulette, Craps, and Slot Machines. Challenge AI opponents with adjustable difficulty levels or test your skills against friends in multiplayer modes. Build your bankroll through strategic play and unlock exclusive high-stakes tables reserved for true high rollers. The game features realistic casino ambience with detailed 3D environments, professional dealer animations, and immersive sound effects that capture the excitement of a real casino floor. Track your statistics, earn achievements, and customize your avatar as you climb the ranks from amateur to casino legend.

title: Hitman 2: Silent Assassin
description: Step into the shadows as Agent 47, the world's deadliest assassin, in this masterful stealth action game. Travel across the globe from Sicily to Japan, infiltrating heavily guarded locations to eliminate high-profile targets. Master the art of disguise, blending seamlessly with crowds while planning the perfect kill. Choose your approach: go in guns blazing or become a ghost, using poison, accidents, and environmental kills to remain undetected. Every mission offers multiple paths and methods, rewarding creativity and patience. With an arsenal of weapons from fiber wire to sniper rifles, plus improvised tools found in each location, you control how each contract unfolds. The revolutionary ranking system grades your performance, challenging you to achieve the coveted Silent Assassin rating through pure stealth and minimal casualties.

title: Hitman: Blood Money
description: Step into the shoes of Agent 47, the world's deadliest assassin, in this masterpiece of stealth action. Blood Money perfects the art of the perfect kill with its revolutionary accident system - stage elaborate "accidents" to eliminate targets without raising suspicion. Every mission is a sandbox of deadly creativity where you choose your approach: poison a drink, sabotage equipment, or go in guns blazing. The innovative notoriety system tracks your performance - sloppy kills make future missions harder as witnesses recognize you. Customize weapons, collect blood money from contracts, and traverse stunning locations from Las Vegas casinos to Mississippi riverboats. With multiple disguises, diverse tools, and countless assassination methods, no two playthroughs are the same.

title: Hitman: Contracts
description: Enter the dark mind of Agent 47 in this atmospheric stealth thriller. Hitman: Contracts revisits pivotal moments from 47's past through fever-dream flashbacks, presenting reimagined classic missions alongside brutal new contracts. Master the art of the perfect assassination using an arsenal of weapons, poisons, and environmental kills. Each mission offers multiple paths to eliminate your targets - pose as staff, sabotage equipment, or strike from the shadows. The game's noir-inspired visuals and haunting soundtrack create an oppressive atmosphere that reflects 47's deteriorating condition. Plan your approach, exploit AI patterns, and leave no witnesses. Whether you prefer silent takedowns or orchestrated accidents, every kill is a puzzle waiting to be solved.

title: The Hobbit
description: Embark on Bilbo Baggins' legendary journey in this action-adventure adaptation of Tolkien's beloved tale. Explore Middle-earth through vibrant levels spanning the Shire to the Lonely Mountain, battling goblins, spiders, and wolves with Sting, your trusty elven blade. Master stealth mechanics to sneak past enemies or engage in combat using stones, walking stick, and magical Ring powers. Solve environmental puzzles, collect treasures, and interact with iconic characters like Gandalf and Gollum. The game blends platforming with combat and exploration, featuring unique courage points that unlock new abilities. Experience memorable scenes from the book including the riddling contest, barrel escape, and confrontation with Smaug, all brought to life with charming visuals and authentic music that captures the magic of Middle-earth.

title: Hot Wheels: Stunt Track Challenge
description: Race through gravity-defying loops and insane jumps in Hot Wheels: Stunt Track Challenge! Build and customize your own radical tracks using the innovative Track Editor, then tear through them in iconic Hot Wheels cars. Master death-defying stunts across 12 extreme environments, from bedroom floors to backyard adventures. Compete in Championship mode, pull off spectacular tricks in Stunt mode, or challenge friends in multiplayer mayhem. Unlock new vehicles and track pieces as you conquer increasingly wild courses. With arcade-style physics that let you boost off ramps and stick impossible landings, every race becomes a spectacular show. Experience the ultimate Hot Wheels fantasy where imagination meets adrenaline-pumping racing action!

title: Hulk
description: Unleash raw destruction as Marvel's green goliath in this explosive action-adventure epic. Rampage through fully destructible environments, weaponizing cars, lampposts, and even enemies as you battle military forces and supervillains across sprawling cityscapes. Switch between Bruce Banner's stealth segments and Hulk's devastating combat, building rage to unlock increasingly powerful moves and earth-shattering attacks. Experience an original storyline featuring classic foes like Abomination and Leader, brought to life with dynamic comic-book visuals. Chain combos, perform thunderclaps, and execute signature moves like the sonic boom and ground pound. Every building can be climbed, every object weaponized, and every enemy sent flying in this ultimate power fantasy that captures the unstoppable force of the Hulk.

title: Hummer Badlands
description: Conquer extreme off-road terrain behind the wheel of iconic Hummer vehicles in this rugged racing experience. Navigate challenging badlands environments where massive SUVs tackle mud, rocks, and steep inclines across seven distinct race types. Push these military-inspired machines to their limits through desert canyons, mountain trails, and treacherous wilderness courses designed to test your driving skills. Master the unique handling characteristics of heavyweight Hummers as you power through obstacles that would stop ordinary vehicles. Compete in diverse events from checkpoint races to endurance challenges, each demanding different strategies to dominate the unforgiving landscape. While critics noted technical shortcomings, the game offers a distinct take on off-road racing focused on the raw power and capability of Hummer's legendary all-terrain vehicles crushing through environments where only the toughest survive.

title: Hunter: The Reckoning
description: Four chosen hunters battle supernatural evil in this intense action game set in a gothic horror world. Wield unique powers and an arsenal of weapons against vampires, zombies, and demonic creatures threatening humanity. Play as the biker Striker with his mighty strength, the cop Father Cortez channeling divine power, the raver Kassandra with supernatural speed, or the ex-con Deuce wielding spectral abilities. Team up with friends in 4-player cooperative gameplay to cleanse the cursed town of Ashcroft. Combine melee combat, ranged attacks, and special Hunter edges to destroy the undead hordes. Face massive boss battles, explore dark environments, and uncover the sinister plot behind the supernatural outbreak. Fast-paced hack-and-slash action meets survival horror in this thrilling GameCube exclusive.

title: Hunter: The Reckoning – Redeemer
description: Step into the darkness as one of four supernatural Hunters in this intense action-horror beat 'em up. Hunter: The Reckoning – Redeemer unleashes you against hordes of undead monsters threatening humanity's survival. Choose your Hunter - each with unique abilities and devastating special attacks - then wade into brutal combat using an arsenal of melee weapons, firearms, and mystical Edges. Master combos and supernatural powers to obliterate vampires, zombies, and demonic creatures across gothic environments. Team up with friends in cooperative multiplayer mayhem or face the nightmare alone. With relentless action, RPG character progression, and a dark storyline of redemption, this supernatural brawler delivers visceral combat and atmospheric horror in equal measure.

title: I-Ninja
description: Master the way of the ninja in this action-packed platformer that blends martial arts mayhem with quirky humor. As the pint-sized warrior I-Ninja, unleash devastating combos, wall-run across deadly obstacles, and grind rails with your razor-sharp sword. Each level challenges you with unique objectives from stealth missions to intense boss battles. Earn new belt ranks to unlock powerful abilities like the flying shuriken helicopter and the devastating Ninja Berserker rage mode. Pilot giant robots, man anti-aircraft guns, and even surf on spinning shuriken as you battle through diverse environments from bustling dojos to volcanic fortresses. With its cel-shaded art style, responsive controls, and blend of platforming, combat, and mini-games, I-Ninja delivers non-stop ninja action with attitude.

title: Ice Age 2: The Meltdown
description: Join Manny, Sid, Diego and the hilarious Scrat in this action-packed adventure based on the hit animated film! As the ice age ends and their valley floods, guide the prehistoric pals through 10 exciting levels filled with puzzles and platforming challenges. Play as multiple characters, each with unique abilities - Manny's strength breaks barriers, Sid's agility reaches new areas, and Diego's speed helps in chase sequences. Master mini-games including Sid's slippery ice slides and Scrat's acorn-chasing antics. Collect hidden items, solve environmental puzzles, and battle dangerous predators while racing against time to reach safety. With colorful graphics faithful to the movie and hilarious character animations, experience the meltdown mayhem firsthand!

title: IHRA Drag Racing 2004
description: Feel the raw power of nitro-fueled drag racing in IHRA Drag Racing 2004, where quarter-mile glory awaits at the starting line. Master the art of the perfect launch across multiple racing classes including Top Fuel, Funny Car, Pro Stock, and Pro Mod. Fine-tune every component of your dragster from gear ratios to tire pressure, building the ultimate speed machine. Experience authentic IHRA tracks with realistic physics that demand split-second timing on the tree. Challenge legendary drivers or create your own racing legacy in career mode. Weather conditions and track temperatures affect performance, adding strategic depth to each race. With over 70 licensed vehicles and deep customization options, this is pure drag racing simulation at its finest.

title: IHRA Drag Racing: Sportsman Edition
description: Experience the ultimate drag racing simulation with IHRA Drag Racing: Sportsman Edition. Master the art of the perfect launch as you compete in multiple racing classes from Junior Dragsters to Top Sportsman vehicles. Fine-tune your ride with realistic vehicle customization options, adjusting everything from gear ratios to tire pressure for optimal quarter-mile performance. Race on authentic IHRA-sanctioned tracks with accurate physics that reward precision timing and skillful throttle control. Progress through career mode, earning sponsorships and upgrading your vehicles as you climb the ranks. Features split-screen multiplayer for head-to-head competition and time trials to perfect your runs. The ultimate test of reaction time and tuning expertise.

title: IHRA Professional Drag Racing 2005
description: Experience the raw power and precision of professional drag racing in IHRA Professional Drag Racing 2005. Master the art of the perfect launch as you compete in multiple IHRA-sanctioned racing classes including Top Fuel, Funny Car, Pro Stock, and Pro Modified. Fine-tune your ride with extensive customization options, adjusting everything from gear ratios to tire pressure to shave milliseconds off your quarter-mile times. Feel the intensity of staging, watch for the perfect light, and nail your shifts in realistic race simulations. Career mode lets you build your reputation from amateur strips to professional IHRA events. With authentic tracks, licensed vehicles, and true-to-life physics, this is drag racing at its most authentic and thrilling.

title: The Incredible Hulk: Ultimate Destruction
description: Unleash raw power as the Hulk in this explosive open-world rampage through vast cityscapes and badlands. Smash through entire buildings, weaponize vehicles by ripping them apart, and use environmental objects as tools of destruction. The innovative "Weaponization" system lets you transform anything - from buses to steel girders - into devastating weapons. Chain together brutal combos with over 150 unique moves and abilities that grow stronger as your rage builds. Face off against military forces, rival monsters, and the sinister Abomination across story missions and destruction challenges. Sprint up skyscrapers, leap miles in a single bound, and leave a trail of chaos in your wake. Pure destructive sandbox gameplay at its finest.

title: The Incredibles
description: Join the Parr family in this action-packed adventure based on the Pixar film! Play as Mr. Incredible, Elastigirl, Dash, and Violet, each with unique superpowers. Punch through enemies with Mr. Incredible's super strength, stretch across gaps as Elastigirl, speed through levels as Dash, and turn invisible with Violet. Battle Syndrome's deadly Omnidroids across 18 levels spanning exotic locations from the movie and beyond. Experience exclusive storylines that expand the film's universe, including Mr. Incredible's glory days and Frozone's solo missions. Switch between characters to solve puzzles and overcome obstacles using their special abilities. Face off against classic villains like Bomb Voyage while mastering combo attacks and power moves. With vibrant graphics faithful to the movie's style and voice acting from the original cast, The Incredibles delivers superhero action for the whole family.

title: James Bond 007: Everything or Nothing
description: Play as Pierce Brosnan's James Bond in this explosive third-person action adventure. Everything or Nothing delivers an original storyline where 007 must stop villain Nikolai Diavolo from unleashing nanotechnology that threatens global destruction. Experience cinematic combat with hand-to-hand fighting, precision shooting, and stealth takedowns. Race through intense vehicle sequences featuring Aston Martins, motorcycles, and helicopters. Use Q's gadgets including rappel devices, thermovision, and the Q-Spider nano-robot. The co-op mode lets two players tackle exclusive missions together. With Hollywood actors including Willem Dafoe and Heidi Klum, plus locations from Egypt to Peru, this Bond adventure combines espionage, action, and style in true 007 fashion.

title: The Incredibles: Rise of the Underminer
description: Team up as Mr. Incredible and Frozone in this action-packed co-op adventure that picks up where the Pixar film left off. Battle the villainous Underminer through his elaborate underground lair as you punch, freeze, and combo your way through waves of evil robots. Switch between heroes on the fly in single-player or grab a friend for dynamic two-player cooperative gameplay. Upgrade your super powers, from Mr. Incredible's devastating ground pounds to Frozone's ice bridges and projectiles. Solve environmental puzzles using each hero's unique abilities while exploring massive subterranean levels filled with destructible objects. Experience Pixar-quality humor and voice acting as you save Metroville from total destruction in this family-friendly brawler.

title: Indiana Jones and the Emperor's Tomb
description: Wield Indiana Jones' iconic whip and fists in this action-packed adventure spanning the globe from Ceylon jungles to Prague castles. Battle Nazi forces and Chinese gangsters while uncovering the mystical Heart of the Dragon artifact before it falls into evil hands. Master Indy's signature brawling combat with improvised weapons, environmental takedowns, and bone-crunching combos. Navigate treacherous tombs filled with deadly traps, solve ancient puzzles, and swim through flooded passages. Experience ten exotic locations featuring authentic 1935 atmosphere, from Hong Kong's neon streets to the Ottoman Emperor's sunken palace. With Harrison Ford's likeness and John Williams' legendary score, every whip crack and punch feels authentically Indiana Jones.

title: IndyCar Series
description: Experience the ultimate open-wheel racing simulation with IndyCar Series, delivering the full intensity and precision of America's premier racing championship. Master the art of oval and road course racing across authentic tracks including the legendary Indianapolis Motor Speedway. Feel the raw power of 650-horsepower machines reaching speeds over 220 mph as you battle wheel-to-wheel with official IndyCar drivers and teams. The advanced physics engine captures every nuance from aerodynamic drafting to tire wear, demanding perfect racing lines and strategic pit stops. Career mode lets you rise from rookie to champion, managing sponsorships and team relationships. With customizable difficulty settings, dynamic weather conditions, and realistic damage modeling, every race presents unique challenges that test your skill and nerve in the quest for racing glory.

title: IndyCar Series 2005
description: Experience the thrill of America's premier open-wheel racing championship in IndyCar Series 2005. Take control of authentic IndyCar vehicles and compete across 15 real-world tracks including the legendary Indianapolis Motor Speedway. Master the art of high-speed oval racing and technical road courses as you battle against 33 licensed drivers from the 2005 IRL IndyCar Series season. Fine-tune your car's setup with detailed customization options covering aerodynamics, suspension, and gear ratios. Feel the intensity of wheel-to-wheel racing at over 220 mph, where split-second decisions determine victory or defeat. Build your career through multiple seasons, earning sponsorships and improving your team's performance to become IndyCar champion.

title: The Italian Job
description: Based on the 2003 film, The Italian Job puts you behind the wheel in heart-pounding heist missions across LA and Venice. Master the art of the getaway as you race MINI Coopers through narrow alleyways, subway tunnels, and busy streets while evading police pursuit. Plan and execute elaborate robberies using each crew member's unique skills - from safe cracking to demolition expertise. Experience intense chase sequences with responsive arcade-style driving that captures the thrill of the movie's iconic scenes. Navigate through destructible environments, use shortcuts to outsmart opponents, and pull off daring stunts in split-second escapes. With story mode missions following the film's plot plus additional racing challenges, create your own chaos or compete in multiplayer mayhem. The Italian Job delivers accessible yet exciting driving action where every heist becomes an adrenaline-fueled race against time.

title: Intellivision Lives!
description: Experience a treasure trove of gaming history with Intellivision Lives!, featuring over 60 classic games from the golden age of home consoles. Relive the groundbreaking titles that defined a generation, from the strategic depths of Utopia and Sea Battle to the arcade action of Astrosmash and Night Stalker. Navigate dungeons in Advanced Dungeons & Dragons, compete in realistic sports simulations, or blast through space in Star Strike. Each game comes complete with original box art, instruction manuals, and nostalgic overlays that recreate the authentic Intellivision controller experience. Discover fun facts, developer interviews, and historical commercials that transport you back to the early 1980s. Whether you're a veteran who grew up with these classics or a newcomer curious about gaming's roots, this collection delivers timeless gameplay with enhanced presentation for modern systems.

title: International Superstar Soccer 2
description: Experience the ultimate soccer simulation with International Superstar Soccer 2, delivering unparalleled realism and fluid gameplay on Xbox. Master precision ball control with the innovative analog stick system while executing spectacular bicycle kicks, diving headers, and pinpoint through-balls. Choose from 52 international teams featuring authentic player stats and formations. The revolutionary AI adapts to your playing style, creating dynamic matches where no two games feel alike. Weather effects and realistic physics impact every pass and shot. Career mode lets you guide your nation through qualifying campaigns to World Cup glory. With silky-smooth animations, tactical depth, and arcade accessibility perfectly balanced, ISS2 sets the standard for soccer excellence.

title: Jade Empire
description: Step into the mystical world of ancient China as a martial arts master in this stunning action RPG from BioWare. Master dozens of fighting styles including magical arts, weapon techniques, and transformation abilities that let you become powerful demons. Your choices shape the story as you follow the Way of the Open Palm or the brutal Closed Fist philosophy, determining whether you become a noble hero or feared tyrant. Engage in real-time combat that blends martial arts with supernatural powers, switching styles on the fly to exploit enemy weaknesses. Recruit colorful companions who fight alongside you, each with unique abilities and personal quests. Explore breathtaking environments from bamboo forests to imperial palaces, uncovering ancient secrets and confronting mythical creatures. Your decisions affect everything from romance options to the fate of an empire in this epic tale of destiny and martial arts mastery.

title: James Bond 007: Agent Under Fire
description: Step into the shoes of the world's most famous secret agent in this original Bond adventure. Agent Under Fire delivers explosive first-person action across exotic locations from Hong Kong to the Mediterranean. Master Bond's arsenal of high-tech gadgets including the Q-Claw grappling hook, Q-Laser, and remote-controlled devices to outwit enemies and navigate treacherous environments. Drive iconic vehicles like the Aston Martin Vanquish in thrilling chase sequences. The game seamlessly blends stealth infiltration with intense firefights, letting you choose your approach - go in guns blazing or use cunning and gadgets to complete objectives. Featuring split-screen multiplayer with classic modes and unique Bond-themed variations, plus an original storyline with femme fatales and megalomaniac villains true to the 007 legacy.

title: James Bond 007: From Russia with Love
description: Step into the shoes of the legendary 007 in this thrilling third-person action game that brings Sean Connery's iconic Bond to life. Experience an original storyline inspired by the classic 1963 film, featuring Connery's own voice and likeness. Master Bond's lethal combat skills with hand-to-hand takedowns, precision shooting, and explosive gadgets from Q-Branch including the signature Aston Martin DB5 with ejector seat. Navigate through exotic locations from Istanbul to Venice, engaging in intense firefights, high-speed vehicle chases, and stealth infiltration missions. Use Bond Focus mode to target enemies with deadly accuracy and perform spectacular stunts. With its blend of espionage action, cinematic presentation, and authentic 1960s style, From Russia with Love delivers the ultimate classic Bond gaming experience.

title: James Bond 007: Nightfire
description: Step into the world of international espionage as James Bond in this thrilling first-person shooter. Navigate exotic locations from Paris to the South Pacific, utilizing an arsenal of Q-Branch gadgets including laser watches, grappling hooks, and remote-controlled missiles. Drive iconic vehicles like the Aston Martin V12 Vanquish equipped with machine guns and rockets in high-speed chases. Master stealth infiltration or go in guns blazing across diverse missions featuring snow fortress assaults, underwater base infiltrations, and zero-gravity space station battles. Experience original storyline with Pierce Brosnan's likeness, spectacular set pieces, and multiplayer modes including classic GoldenEye-style split-screen combat with customizable scenarios and AI bots.

title: James Cameron's Dark Angel
description: Based on the popular TV series, James Cameron's Dark Angel puts you in the shoes of genetically enhanced super-soldier Max Guevara in post-apocalypse Seattle. Master devastating martial arts combos and stealth tactics as you infiltrate hostile territories and take down enemies with superhuman agility. The game blends intense hand-to-hand combat with acrobatic platforming, letting you wall-run, perform incredible leaps, and execute brutal finishing moves. Use Max's enhanced vision to spot enemies through walls and plan your attacks. Switch between aggressive assault and careful stealth approaches as you uncover conspiracies and fight to protect fellow transgenics. Experience an original storyline that expands the Dark Angel universe with full voice acting from the TV cast, including Jessica Alba. Dynamic combat system rewards skillful timing and combo mastery while environmental puzzles challenge your enhanced abilities.

title: Jaws Unleashed
description: Become the ultimate apex predator in Jaws Unleashed! You are Jaws, the legendary great white shark, terrorizing the waters of Amity Island in this open-world action game. Hunt unsuspecting swimmers, destroy boats, and wreak havoc on beach communities as you explore a massive underwater environment. Execute brutal combo attacks, use your powerful tail to launch enemies, and trigger cinematic slow-motion carnage with the Shark Vision mode. Complete story missions to exact revenge on those who wronged you, or roam freely causing mayhem in side challenges. Upgrade Jaws' abilities including speed, hunger, and health as you progress. From shallow beaches to deep ocean trenches, no one is safe when you're on the hunt. Experience the Jaws universe from the shark's perspective in this visceral underwater adventure where you're the monster everyone fears!

title: Jet Set Radio Future
description: Grind, tag, and groove through Tokyo-to's neon-soaked streets in this stylish cel-shaded skating adventure. As part of the GG gang, you'll battle rival crews for turf supremacy by spraying massive graffiti pieces while evading the authoritarian Rokkaku Police. Chain together incredible tricks on rails, walls, and rooftops to build your boost meter and reach impossible spots. The game's revolutionary cel-shaded visuals pop with vibrant colors and comic book style, while an eclectic soundtrack mixing hip-hop, electronic, and funk keeps your momentum pumping. Recruit new members with unique abilities, customize your tags, and master each district's vertical playground. With its seamless blend of extreme sports, artistic expression, and anti-establishment attitude, Jet Set Radio Future delivers an unforgettable urban rebellion.

title: Jikkyō World Soccer 2002
description: Experience Konami's acclaimed soccer franchise in this international edition released as International Superstar Soccer 2 outside Japan. This arcade-focused football game delivers fast-paced matches with responsive controls and fluid gameplay that made the series a favorite among soccer gaming enthusiasts. Choose from international teams and compete in various tournaments featuring authentic stadiums and atmospheric crowds. The game emphasizes pick-up-and-play accessibility while maintaining tactical depth through formations, strategies, and player positioning. Master precision passing, powerful shots, and skillful dribbling moves as you guide your team to victory. With its balanced gameplay mechanics, smooth animations, and exciting match presentation complete with dynamic commentary, this entry continues Konami's tradition of creating engaging soccer experiences that appeal to both casual players and football fanatics seeking arcade-style action over simulation.

title: Judge Dredd: Dredd vs. Death
description: Step into the boots of Judge Dredd, the ultimate lawman in Mega-City One! Battle through intense FPS action as you dispense instant justice against the undead menace of Judge Death and his Dark Judges. Wield Dredd's iconic Lawgiver pistol with multiple ammo types - from incendiary rounds to ricochet shots. Arrest perps or execute them on the spot using the Justice Meter system that rewards both merciful and lethal approaches. Experience 11 campaign missions featuring vampires, zombies, and city-wide chaos. Face off in multiplayer modes including Deathmatch and unique Judge vs. Perp scenarios. With authentic 2000 AD atmosphere, dark humor, and non-stop action, lay down the law Dredd-style!

title: Juiced
description: Build your reputation in the underground street racing scene of Angel City. Juiced delivers intense arcade racing where respect matters as much as speed. Customize over 50 licensed vehicles with authentic aftermarket parts, then show them off in pink-slip races where you can win or lose cars permanently. Master the unique crew racing system, commanding AI teammates through strategic calls while hitting nitrous-fueled speeds. The innovative Respect system tracks your reputation with rival crews - drive dirty and face the consequences, or race clean to unlock exclusive events. From circuit races to drag strips, each victory earns cash for deeper customization options including body kits, decals, and performance upgrades. Online multiplayer lets you prove your skills against racers worldwide. With its risk-reward pink slip gambling and crew-based gameplay, Juiced stands apart in the street racing genre.

title: Jurassic Park: Operation Genesis
description: Build your own Jurassic Park in this captivating park management simulation where you resurrect dinosaurs and create the ultimate prehistoric attraction. Extract DNA from fossils, breed over 25 species of dinosaurs including T-Rex and Velociraptors, and design elaborate enclosures to showcase your creatures. Balance visitor entertainment with safety as you construct viewing platforms, safari tours, and amenities while maintaining security systems to prevent escapes. When disasters strike, take direct control of rangers in action-packed missions to tranquilize rampaging dinosaurs or rescue trapped guests. Research new technologies, manage park finances, and respond to emergencies ranging from disease outbreaks to severe weather. Create stunning landscapes across multiple islands, each presenting unique challenges and opportunities.

title: Just Cause
description: Take on the role of Rico Rodriguez, a specialist in regime change, as you liberate the tropical island of San Esperito from a corrupt dictator. Just Cause delivers explosive open-world action where creativity meets destruction. Hijack helicopters, boats, and cars across 250,000 acres of diverse terrain. Use your grappling hook and parachute to perform death-defying stunts and create unique combat strategies. Trigger massive explosions, topple government infrastructure, and incite rebellion among the populace. With over 300 missions and side activities, approach each objective your way - go in guns blazing or use guerrilla tactics. The revolutionary physics engine ensures every explosion, vehicle collision, and stunt feels spectacular. Freedom is your weapon in this ultimate sandbox of chaos.

title: Justice League Heroes
description: Unite the world's greatest superheroes in this action-packed adventure where you control the legendary Justice League. Play as Batman, Superman, Wonder Woman, Flash, Green Lantern, Martian Manhunter, and Zatanna as they battle an unprecedented threat orchestrated by Brainiac and Darkseid. Master each hero's unique powers - from Superman's heat vision and super strength to Batman's martial arts and gadgets. Team up in cooperative gameplay, combining abilities for devastating combo attacks. Customize your heroes with unlocked costumes and upgrade their powers through an RPG-style progression system. Battle through iconic DC locations including Metropolis, Gotham City, and Mars. Face off against classic villains like Doomsday, Queen Bee, and The Key in this epic brawler that brings comic book action to life.

title: Kabuki Warriors
description: Step into feudal Japan's theatrical underworld where honor meets spectacle in this unique 3D fighting game. Kabuki Warriors brings the dramatic art of Kabuki theater to life through intense one-on-one combat. Choose from 24 distinct fighters, each wielding authentic Japanese weapons like katanas, naginatas, and war fans. Master the innovative fighting system that blends traditional martial arts with theatrical flair - execute devastating combo attacks, dramatic throws, and signature Kabuki poses that grant special powers. Battle across beautifully rendered stages inspired by classical Japanese settings, from cherry blossom gardens to ancient temples. The game features multiple modes including Story, Versus, and Time Attack. Experience the fusion of Japanese culture and fighting action as warriors perform elaborate victory dances and dramatic entrances true to Kabuki tradition.

title: Kakuto Chojin: Back Alley Brutal
description: Enter the underground world of Kakuto Chojin, where brutal street fighters clash in savage combat across shadowy urban battlegrounds. Master devastating martial arts techniques from 13 unique warriors, each wielding their own lethal fighting style inspired by real-world disciplines. Unleash bone-crushing combos and supernatural special moves as you battle through grimy back alleys, abandoned warehouses, and neon-lit cityscapes. The innovative fighting system blends realistic strikes with mystical powers, while the dark atmosphere and mature themes set this brawler apart from typical fighters. Experience visceral combat with detailed damage modeling and fluid animations that capture every brutal impact. Rise through the ranks of this underground tournament where only the strongest survive.

title: Kao the Kangaroo: Round 2
description: Join Kao, the brave boxing kangaroo, on an epic 3D platforming adventure to rescue his friends from the evil Hunter Barnaba! Master Kao's powerful boxing moves and boomerang attacks as you battle through vibrant worlds filled with dangerous enemies and challenging obstacles. Explore lush jungles, frozen mountains, mysterious temples, and tropical islands while collecting magical crystals to unlock new abilities. Face off against memorable bosses including pirates, Vikings, and mechanical monsters in this action-packed sequel. With colorful cartoon graphics, smooth controls, and a mix of combat and platforming challenges, Kao delivers classic mascot platformer fun. Unleash devastating combo attacks, discover hidden secrets, and save the day in this charming adventure that captures the spirit of classic 3D platformers!

title: Karaoke Revolution
description: Transform your living room into a concert stage with Karaoke Revolution, the groundbreaking rhythm game that brings professional singing to your Xbox. Grab the microphone and belt out hits from top artists across rock, pop, R&B, and country genres. The innovative pitch detection technology scores your vocal performance in real-time, rewarding accurate pitch and timing with points and crowd cheers. Choose from multiple difficulty levels and game modes including Quick Play, Career, and multiplayer Duet mode where friends harmonize together. Build your virtual singing career, unlock new songs and venues, and customize your on-screen avatar. With dozens of chart-topping songs and dynamic visual effects that respond to your performance, Karaoke Revolution delivers the ultimate interactive singing experience for solo artists and party crowds alike.

title: Karaoke Revolution Party
description: Transform your living room into the ultimate karaoke stage! Karaoke Revolution Party brings the excitement of performance gaming to Xbox with over 50 chart-topping hits spanning multiple genres. Grab the microphone and belt out classics from artists like Alicia Keys, Outkast, and The Jackson 5. The game's advanced pitch detection technology scores your vocal accuracy in real-time, rewarding perfect performances with enthusiastic crowds and dazzling stage effects. Challenge friends in multiplayer modes including competitive duets and pass-the-mic battles. Create custom playlists, unlock new venues from intimate clubs to massive arenas, and customize your on-screen avatar with trendy outfits. With party-friendly mini-games and multiple difficulty levels, everyone from shower singers to aspiring stars can join the fun.

title: Kelly Slater's Pro Surfer
description: Ride the world's most legendary waves in Kelly Slater's Pro Surfer, where authentic surfing meets arcade action. Master radical aerial maneuvers, carve massive barrels, and pull off insane trick combos as you compete across exotic beaches from Hawaii to Australia. Choose from Kelly Slater and other pro surfers, each with unique styles and signature moves. The innovative wave physics system creates dynamic, ever-changing swells that challenge your timing and skill. Build your reputation through career mode, unlocking new boards, locations, and secret spots. Execute floaters, cutbacks, and tube rides using intuitive controls that capture the flow of real surfing. With multiplayer competitions and freesurf sessions, experience the ultimate virtual surfing championship.

title: Kill Switch
description: Kill Switch revolutionizes third-person tactical combat with its innovative "Offensive Cover System" that lets you blind-fire around corners and over obstacles while staying protected. Take control of elite operative Nick Bishop as he infiltrates hostile territories across North Africa and the Caspian Sea, uncovering a conspiracy that threatens global security. The game's unique mechanic allows you to remain in cover while precisely targeting enemies, creating intense firefights where positioning is everything. Experience destructible environments, advanced enemy AI that flanks and suppresses, and a gritty military storyline. From war-torn cities to remote military installations, each mission demands tactical thinking and split-second decisions. Master the art of cover-based warfare in this groundbreaking shooter that redefined tactical combat mechanics.

title: King Arthur
description: Lead your knights into epic medieval battles in this tactical action game that brings Arthurian legend to life. Command legendary heroes like Lancelot and Gawain as you forge Excalibur's destiny across mystical Britannia. Master a unique blend of role-playing and real-time strategy, where every decision shapes your kingdom's fate. Recruit and upgrade your Knights of the Round Table, each with distinct abilities and fighting styles. Engage in massive battles featuring hundreds of warriors, magical creatures, and siege warfare. Choose between righteous and tyrant paths that dramatically alter your story and unlock different units. Experience dynamic weather and seasons that affect combat tactics. Conquer territories, manage resources, and make moral choices that test your honor as the Once and Future King.

title: Kingdom Under Fire: The Crusaders
description: Lead massive armies in spectacular real-time battles where strategy meets action combat. Kingdom Under Fire: The Crusaders revolutionizes warfare by seamlessly blending RTS command with hack-and-slash gameplay. Control legendary heroes on the battlefield while directing cavalry charges, archer volleys, and siege weapons against hundreds of on-screen enemies. Switch instantly between tactical overview and brutal melee combat as you carve through enemy ranks. Choose from multiple campaigns featuring unique races and playstyles - from human crusaders to dark elves and orcs. Experience epic castle sieges, dramatic cavalry charges, and massive fantasy battles with unprecedented scale on console. Master both strategic positioning and visceral combat to conquer a war-torn fantasy realm.

title: L.A. Rush
description: L.A. Rush throws you into the illegal street racing scene of Los Angeles, where reputation is everything and pink slips are on the line. Race through a massive open-world recreation of L.A., from Hollywood Hills to Santa Monica Beach, with no load times or boundaries. Build your empire by acquiring garages across the city, customizing rides with licensed parts, and taking on rival crews in high-stakes races. The unique "Retribution" system lets you get revenge on opponents who cross you, while spectacular crash physics turn every collision into a cinematic moment. With West Coast hip-hop legends providing the soundtrack and story, you'll navigate the underground racing hierarchy, earning respect through pure driving skill and strategic territory control.

title: Kingdom Under Fire: Heroes
description: Lead massive armies in spectacular real-time battles where strategy meets action RPG combat. Kingdom Under Fire: Heroes blends tactical warfare with hands-on hero gameplay as you command seven unique leaders across two epic campaigns. Switch seamlessly between directing thousands of troops in strategic formation and diving into the fray for visceral melee combat. Master diverse unit types from cavalry and archers to war machines and flying units, each with distinct strengths against enemy forces. Experience branching storylines spanning 50+ missions where your battlefield decisions shape the fate of nations. Customize your heroes with powerful skills and equipment while managing resources to strengthen your armies between battles.

title: The King of Fighters 2002
description: The King of Fighters 2002 marks the epic return to the series' roots with pure 3-on-3 team battles and no striker system. Choose from 44 fighters spanning the entire KOF universe, including fan favorites and boss characters, in this dream match celebration. Master the devastating MAX Mode system that grants unlimited super moves for explosive combos. Execute bone-crushing Super Desperation Moves when your health runs low, turning the tide of battle in seconds. The refined fighting engine delivers perfectly balanced gameplay with faster combat, improved animations, and responsive controls. Challenge friends in versus mode or conquer the ruthless AI in team play mode. With its massive roster, strategic depth, and refined mechanics, KOF 2002 stands as the definitive classic KOF experience that hardcore fans demanded.

title: The King of Fighters 2003
description: The King of Fighters 2003 marks a pivotal evolution in SNK's legendary fighting series, introducing the revolutionary Tag Team system that transforms combat dynamics. Choose three fighters from a roster of 35 warriors and seamlessly switch between them mid-battle, creating explosive combo opportunities and strategic depth. The new Leader Super Special Move system adds tactical layers - designate your team captain to unleash devastating attacks that can turn the tide instantly. Experience refined gameplay mechanics with improved movement speed and enhanced defensive options. Classic characters like Kyo, Iori, and Terry return alongside mysterious newcomers, each bringing unique fighting styles. The intricate storyline continues the NESTS saga conclusion while setting up future conflicts. Master advanced techniques, discover hidden team combinations, and prove your skills in this fast-paced, combo-heavy fighter that rewards both aggressive rushdown and patient strategy.

title: The King of Fighters Neowave
description: The King of Fighters Neowave brings SNK's legendary fighting series to new heights with refined 2D combat and an extensive 43-character roster. Choose from three distinct fighting modes - Super Cancel for combo masters, Guard Break for defensive strategists, and Max2 for devastating super moves. Team up three warriors from across the KOF universe, including classic favorites like Kyo, Iori, and Terry Bogard, plus hidden bosses Geese Howard and King Lion. The Heat Mode system adds strategic depth as your power gauge transforms based on combat performance. Fluid animation, precise controls, and the series' signature 3-on-3 team battles create intense matches where timing and team synergy determine victory. Master each character's unique fighting style in this ultimate KOF experience.

title: Knight's Apprentice: Memorick's Adventures
description: Embark on an Arthurian quest as Memorick, Merlin's ambitious pupil seeking knighthood, in this budget-priced action-adventure. Battle through eleven levels across eight mystical worlds to save Avalon from the evil Morganna, Mordred, and the imprisoned Queen Mab. Master sword combat and shield defense while collecting orbs to unlock magical leylines that transport you between realms. Explore diverse environments on foot, horseback, griffin-back, or even shield-surfing down water courses. Upgrade your weapons and shields to unlock special powers and shield bash attacks. Search for health potions in treasure chests and use Oracle Stones to reveal hidden objectives across Avalon's map. Despite its simple controls and straightforward gameplay, the adventure offers variety through different traversal methods and platforming challenges as you strive to prevent Mab's dark resurrection and prove yourself worthy of knighthood.

title: Knights of the Temple: Infernal Crusade
description: Step into the boots of Paul de Raque, a medieval Templar knight on a divine mission to rescue the kidnapped Adelle from demonic forces. This action-packed hack-and-slash adventure blends intense combat with sacred purpose as you wield blessed weapons against hordes of undead and demons. Master devastating combo attacks, unlock powerful divine abilities, and collect holy artifacts to strengthen your crusade. Navigate through cursed monasteries, demon-infested dungeons, and hellish realms while solving puzzles that guard ancient secrets. The game's Gothic atmosphere combines religious mythology with dark fantasy, featuring brutal melee combat where faith becomes your greatest weapon against the infernal legions threatening mankind.

title: Knights of the Temple II
description: Embark on an epic crusade as Paul de Raque, a battle-hardened Templar Knight seeking vengeance against dark forces threatening medieval Europe. This action-packed sequel blends intense hack-and-slash combat with exploration across diverse environments from ancient monasteries to demon-infested dungeons. Master devastating combo attacks using swords, axes, and divine powers while solving puzzles to unlock sacred artifacts. Face hordes of undead warriors, demonic creatures, and corrupted knights in visceral battles. Upgrade your abilities through an RPG-style progression system, unlocking new combat techniques and holy magic. Experience improved graphics and refined gameplay mechanics that build upon the original's foundation. Journey through atmospheric medieval locations rendered in stunning detail as you uncover a sinister plot involving ancient evil artifacts and fallen angels bent on destruction.

title: Knockout Kings 2002
description: Step into the ring with Knockout Kings 2002, where boxing legends and rising stars collide in EA Sports' premier fighting simulation. Master the sweet science with an intuitive control system that puts every jab, hook, and uppercut at your fingertips. Create your own fighter and climb from amateur bouts to championship glory in Career Mode, or test your skills against Muhammad Ali, Sugar Ray Leonard, and other all-time greats. The game's advanced damage system shows real-time cuts and bruises as fights intensify. With multiple weight classes, authentic venues, and commentary that captures the drama of each bout, every match feels like a main event. Train hard, study your opponents, and prove you have what it takes to become the undisputed champion in this deep boxing experience.

title: KOF: Maximum Impact: Maniax
description: KOF: Maximum Impact: Maniax brings the legendary King of Fighters series into explosive 3D combat exclusively on Xbox. Choose from over 20 iconic fighters including Terry Bogard, Kyo Kusanagi, and Iori Yagami as you master devastating combos and super moves in fully realized 3D arenas. The game features enhanced Xbox-exclusive content including new characters, additional costumes, and refined gameplay mechanics. Experience classic KOF team battles in Story Mode, test your skills in Mission Mode's unique challenges, or battle friends in versus matches. With its signature three-on-three team system, players strategically build their squad and unleash tag combos for maximum damage. Stunning visual effects and hard-hitting action make every match intense.

title: Kung Fu Chaos
description: Kung Fu Chaos transforms your living room into a wild kung fu movie set where up to four players become stunt fighters competing in outrageous battles. Race through collapsing film sets, dodge rolling boulders, and unleash devastating kung fu moves while the eccentric director shouts instructions from his megaphone. Each of the nine quirky characters brings unique fighting styles inspired by classic martial arts cinema. Battle across 25 movie-themed stages including pirate ships, Wild West towns, and alien invasions - all while the set literally falls apart around you. Mini-games between rounds add variety with challenges like dodging thrown shuriken or breaking boards. The game perfectly captures the campy charm of 1970s kung fu films with its over-the-top action, comedic timing, and frantic multiplayer mayhem that keeps everyone laughing.

title: Land of the Dead: Road to Fiddler's Green
description: Survive the zombie apocalypse in this intense first-person shooter based on George A. Romero's horror universe. Battle through the streets of a city overrun by the undead, using an arsenal of melee weapons and firearms to fight off relentless hordes. Play as farmer Jack or explore the prequel story of outlaw cowboy McWatt in single-player campaigns that blend action and survival horror. Barricade doors, conserve ammunition, and use environmental objects as weapons when overwhelmed. Experience the terror of Romero's vision with shambling zombies that never stop coming, forcing you to balance aggression with resource management. Features both ranged and brutal melee combat systems, atmospheric environments from farmhouses to urban sprawls, and the constant dread of being surrounded by the living dead.

title: Largo Winch: Empire Under Threat
description: Step into the world of high-stakes corporate espionage as Largo Winch, billionaire CEO turned action hero. This thrilling adventure game blends stealth, combat, and puzzle-solving as you uncover a conspiracy threatening your global empire. Navigate exotic locations from New York penthouses to Mayan temples, using martial arts, gadgets, and quick thinking to survive. Switch between third-person action and strategic planning as you manage corporate assets while dodging assassins. Face tough moral choices that impact the story's outcome. With its unique mix of boardroom drama and explosive action sequences, Empire Under Threat delivers a sophisticated spy thriller where brains matter as much as brawn in your fight to save both your company and your life.

title: Legacy of Kain: Defiance
description: Legacy of Kain: Defiance delivers an epic conclusion to the Soul Reaver saga, letting you control both Kain and Raziel in their intertwined destinies. Switch between the vampire lord and his spectral lieutenant as you unravel ancient conspiracies threatening Nosgoth's existence. Wield devastating telekinetic powers as Kain, hurling enemies and objects with brutal force. As Raziel, devour souls and shift between material and spectral realms to solve puzzles and overcome obstacles. Experience refined combat with enhanced combo systems, aerial attacks, and signature weapons - Kain's Soul Reaver blade and Raziel's wraith blade. Navigate gothic environments filled with dark atmosphere, from crumbling temples to otherworldly dimensions. The dual narrative structure reveals different perspectives of the same events, building toward a climactic confrontation that will determine the fate of all existence.

title: The Legend of Spyro: A New Beginning
description: Reborn as a young purple dragon, unleash devastating elemental powers in this action-packed reboot of the beloved Spyro series. Master fire, ice, electricity, and earth attacks through intuitive combat combos as you battle the forces of the Dark Master. Experience Spyro's origin story voiced by Elijah Wood, featuring stunning environments from swamps to volcanic wastelands. Chain together aerial attacks, ground pounds, and fury mode transformations in this darker, more combat-focused reimagining.
