Learn new abilities from dragon elders, solve environmental puzzles, and discover hidden secrets across sprawling levels. With epic boss battles, upgradeable breath weapons, and a sweeping orchestral score, this fresh take delivers intense dragon combat while honoring the franchise's platforming roots.

title: Legends of Wrestling
description: Step into the squared circle with wrestling's greatest legends in this arcade-style brawler that celebrates the golden age of professional wrestling. Choose from over 40 iconic superstars including Hulk Hogan, Bret "The Hitman" Hart, and Andre the Giant, each with authentic signature moves and finishing maneuvers. Battle through an extensive career mode, creating your own legend and earning respect in territories across America. The game features a unique grappling system that emphasizes timing and strategy over button mashing, letting you chain together devastating combos and counters. Compete in various match types including steel cage, tag team, and battle royals. With create-a-legend mode, build your own wrestler from scratch and take them from rookie to champion. Experience the nostalgia of classic wrestling with modernized gameplay mechanics.

title: Legends of Wrestling II
description: Step into the ring with over 65 wrestling legends spanning five decades of sports entertainment! Legends of Wrestling II delivers intense grappling action with an enhanced fighting engine featuring new reversal systems and combo moves. Create your own wrestler with the deep creation suite, then battle through the new Career Mode where your choices shape your path to glory. Experience authentic wrestling atmospheres in classic venues like Madison Square Garden and the ECW Arena. The improved gameplay includes region-specific fighting styles, interactive environments with weapons, and a momentum-based special move system. From Hulk Hogan to Bret Hart, Andre the Giant to Jerry Lawler, control the greatest wrestlers ever in exhibition matches, tag team bouts, cage matches, and more. Relive wrestling's golden eras with realistic movesets and signature finishers.

title: Lego Star Wars: The Video Game
description: Relive the epic Star Wars prequel trilogy in LEGO form! Play through iconic moments from Episodes I-III with beloved characters reimagined as charming LEGO minifigures. Switch between different Jedi, Sith, and heroes, each with unique abilities - use the Force, wield lightsabers, or blast through enemies. Experience the magic of drop-in/drop-out co-op gameplay perfect for all ages. Solve clever puzzles, collect LEGO studs, and unlock over 50 playable characters including Darth Vader and Yoda. The game's signature humor transforms dramatic Star Wars scenes into laugh-out-loud moments without dialogue. Build, destroy, and explore expansive levels from Naboo to Mustafar. This groundbreaking title launched the beloved LEGO game franchise, combining accessible gameplay with authentic Star Wars action.

title: Lego Star Wars II: The Original Trilogy
description: Relive the classic Star Wars trilogy in hilarious LEGO form! Play through iconic moments from Episodes IV-VI with trademark LEGO humor and charm. Control over 50 playable characters including Luke Skywalker, Princess Leia, Han Solo, and Darth Vader, each with unique abilities. Build and ride vehicles like X-wings, speeder bikes, and the Millennium Falcon. Experience drop-in/drop-out co-op gameplay perfect for friends and family. Create custom characters by mixing and matching LEGO parts in the Mos Eisley Cantina hub. Solve puzzles, collect studs, and unlock secrets across 18 action-packed levels spanning Tatooine, Hoth, and the Death Star. The game brilliantly combines classic Star Wars action with LEGO's signature slapstick comedy and creative building mechanics.

title: Leisure Suit Larry: Magna Cum Laude
description: Follow college nobody Larry Lovage as he attempts to win the heart of talk show host Swingles and transform from zero to campus hero in this raunchy comedy adventure. Navigate Walnut Log Community College through a series of outrageous mini-games including quarters, streaking, and conversation battles where choosing the right dialogue options determines your romantic success. Collect Secret Tokens to unlock provocative bonus content while pursuing a diverse cast of college women, each with unique personalities and storylines. This adults-only entry in the legendary franchise ditches point-and-click gameplay for free-roaming 3D exploration filled with crude humor, sexual innuendo, and party game challenges. Experience Larry's misadventures through fully voiced dialogue and cartoon-style graphics that bring the over-the-top campus hijinks to life.

title: Lemony Snicket's A Series of Unfortunate Events
description: Join the Baudelaire orphans in this darkly whimsical adventure based on the hit film and books. Play as Violet, Klaus, and Sunny, each with unique abilities - Violet invents gadgets, Klaus deciphers clues, and baby Sunny bites through obstacles. Navigate through Count Olaf's sinister schemes across multiple environments including his mansion, Uncle Monty's reptile room, and Aunt Josephine's house. Solve puzzles using teamwork, switching between siblings to overcome challenges. Collect puzzle pieces to unlock bonus content and movie clips. The game captures the series' signature gothic humor with Tim Curry reprising his role as narrator. Face off against Count Olaf's theatrical disguises while uncovering secrets and protecting each other from unfortunate events in this clever platformer.

title: Links 2004
description: Hit the links with the most realistic golf simulation on Xbox! Links 2004 delivers an authentic PGA Tour experience featuring real-world courses meticulously recreated down to every bunker and water hazard. Master your swing with the innovative True Swing system that captures the nuance of real golf - from powerful drives to delicate putts. Challenge yourself across legendary courses including Pebble Beach, St Andrews, and Torrey Pines. Create your own golfer and rise through the ranks in Career Mode, or compete against friends in multiplayer tournaments. Advanced ball physics and dynamic weather conditions test your skills as wind, rain, and course conditions affect every shot. With comprehensive course designer tools, build and share your dream courses. Whether you're a seasoned pro or weekend warrior, Links 2004 offers the deepest, most rewarding golf experience with stunning graphics that bring each fairway to life.

title: LMA Manager 2003
description: Take control of your football club's destiny in LMA Manager 2003, the comprehensive football management simulation that puts you in the hot seat. Build your squad from over 30,000 real players across European leagues, negotiate transfers, manage tactics, and guide your team to glory. Experience realistic match engines with detailed commentary, handle press conferences that affect team morale, and develop youth academies to nurture future stars. Balance budgets, upgrade facilities, and keep demanding boards happy while pursuing domestic and European trophies. With in-depth training systems, scout networks spanning the globe, and dynamic player interactions, every decision shapes your club's future. From lower divisions to elite football, prove your managerial prowess across multiple seasons.

title: LMA Manager 2004
description: Take control of your favorite football club and guide them to glory in LMA Manager 2004. Build your dream team through shrewd transfers, develop youth talent, and master tactical formations to outwit opponents. Experience the pressure of matchday with detailed 3D match engine bringing your strategic decisions to life. Navigate the transfer market with over 30,000 real players across leagues worldwide. Handle press conferences, manage club finances, and keep your board happy while chasing silverware. From training ground to trophy cabinet, every decision shapes your legacy. Deal with player morale, injuries, and squad rotation as you balance domestic and European campaigns. The most comprehensive football management simulation on Xbox delivers authentic club management with accessible gameplay that welcomes newcomers while offering depth for veterans.

title: LMA Manager 2005
description: Take control of your football club's destiny in LMA Manager 2005, the comprehensive football management simulation that puts you in the hot seat. Build your squad from over 30 leagues worldwide, scout promising talent, and develop youth academies to nurture future stars. Master tactical formations, make crucial substitutions, and watch matches unfold in the enhanced 3D match engine. Handle press conferences, manage player morale, and balance the books as you navigate the pressures of professional football management. Deal with board expectations, negotiate transfers, and forge your path from lower divisions to continental glory. With detailed player statistics, realistic transfer markets, and dynamic league systems, every decision shapes your legacy. Can you handle the pressure and lead your team to championship success?

title: LMA Manager 2006
description: Take control of your favorite football club in LMA Manager 2006, the comprehensive football management simulation that puts you in the hot seat. Build your squad through shrewd transfers and youth development while managing finances, tactics, and team morale. Experience realistic match engines with detailed 3D highlights showing key moments as your tactical decisions unfold on the pitch. Navigate the pressure of board expectations, handle the media, and develop training regimes to maximize player potential. With extensive databases covering leagues across Europe, scout emerging talent, negotiate contracts, and guide your team from lower divisions to continental glory. Whether you're masterminding formations, rotating squads through grueling fixture lists, or making crucial substitutions, every decision counts in your quest for silverware.

title: Loons: The Fight for Fame
description: Battle for cartoon supremacy in this wacky Xbox exclusive fighter where toon physics meet competitive combat. Choose from a roster of zany animated characters, each with their own slapstick fighting style and outrageous special moves. Master the unique "Toon Time" mechanic that lets you bend reality with cartoon logic - drop anvils, paint fake tunnels, or pull giant mallets from nowhere. Fight across interactive stages filled with comedic hazards and environmental gags. Challenge friends in local multiplayer mayhem or tackle the single-player Fame Tour to become the ultimate toon champion. With cel-shaded graphics that bring Saturday morning cartoons to life, every match delivers unpredictable laughs and strategic depth. Prove you're no second banana in this madcap brawler where anything can happen.

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
description: Step into Middle-earth as Frodo Baggins in this action-adventure epic following Tolkien's beloved tale. Journey from the Shire to Rivendell and beyond, wielding Sting against orcs, trolls, and the fearsome Nazgûl. Play as Aragorn and Gandalf in exclusive levels, each with unique combat styles and abilities. Explore iconic locations like Weathertop and the Mines of Moria while solving puzzles and discovering hidden paths. Master stealth mechanics to avoid detection or engage in sword combat with intuitive controls. Collect lore items that unlock bonus content and deeper Middle-earth mythology. Experience the Fellowship's quest through stunning environments faithful to the books, featuring original music and voice acting that brings the classic story to life.

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
description: Step into Middle-earth's climactic battles as heroes from the epic trilogy. Play as Aragorn, Legolas, Gimli, Gandalf, and more across massive battlefields from Helm's Deep to the Black Gate. Master each character's unique combat moves and devastating special attacks. Slash through hordes of orcs with fluid combo-based melee combat that rewards skillful play. Upgrade weapons and abilities as you progress through the campaign. Experience iconic movie moments with stunning visuals directly from the films. Team up in cooperative multiplayer to defend Minas Tirith or storm Isengard. Every swing of your sword shapes the fate of Middle-earth in this definitive action adaptation of Tolkien's masterpiece.

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Third Age
description: Journey through Middle-earth in this epic turn-based RPG that follows a unique fellowship paralleling the events of the film trilogy. Create your party from diverse characters including a Gondorian soldier, Rohirrim warrior, and elven mage, each with distinct abilities and skill trees. Experience iconic locations from Moria to Pelennor Fields through the eyes of new heroes whose quest intertwines with Frodo's journey. Master the innovative combat system featuring powerful team combos and cinematic special attacks. Collect legendary weapons and armor from fallen foes, craft powerful items, and unlock devastating abilities as you level up. Face off against the Balrog, Witch-king, and other fearsome enemies in strategic battles that reward tactical thinking. With stunning visuals that bring Tolkien's world to life and Howard Shore's magnificent score, this overlooked gem offers a fresh perspective on the War of the Ring.

title: Madden NFL 2004
description: Madden NFL 2004 revolutionizes football gaming with the innovative Playmaker Control system, letting you adjust plays on the fly with the right analog stick. Call audibles, direct receivers, and shift defensive formations in real-time to outsmart opponents. Experience authentic NFL action with all 32 teams, realistic stadiums, and the complete roster of NFL superstars. The new Owner Mode puts you in charge of the entire franchise - set ticket prices, upgrade facilities, and relocate your team to build a dynasty. Enhanced graphics showcase bone-crushing tackles and spectacular catches while Al Michaels and John Madden deliver legendary commentary. Master offensive and defensive playbooks with over 100 formations per team. Create custom players, design unique plays, and dominate online competition.

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers
description: Step into Middle-earth's epic battles as heroes from The Two Towers film. Play as Aragorn, Legolas, or Gimli across intense hack-and-slash combat missions following key movie moments. Battle through Helm's Deep's massive siege, defend the walls of Minas Tirith, and face the fearsome Uruk-hai in visceral melee combat. Each character brings unique fighting styles - Aragorn's balanced swordplay, Legolas's deadly bow skills, and Gimli's devastating axe attacks. Seamlessly blended film footage creates cinematic transitions between levels. Upgrade abilities, unlock devastating combo moves, and earn secret characters including Isildur. Experience Jackson's vision through dynamic third-person action.

title: Lotus Challenge
description: Race through breathtaking environments in this exhilarating arcade racer featuring the legendary Lotus sports cars. Master precision handling as you push iconic vehicles like the Elise, Esprit, and Exige to their limits across diverse tracks spanning sun-drenched coastlines, treacherous mountain passes, and bustling city circuits. Experience intense wheel-to-wheel racing with responsive controls that capture the raw power and agility of Lotus engineering. Challenge yourself through Championship mode, tackle time trials, or compete in thrilling multiplayer races. Dynamic weather conditions and day-night cycles test your skills while stunning visuals showcase each meticulously detailed vehicle. With multiple difficulty levels and unlockable content, Lotus Challenge delivers pure racing excitement that rewards both casual players and driving enthusiasts seeking authentic high-speed thrills.

title: Mace Griffin: Bounty Hunter
description: Become Mace Griffin, a former Ranger turned bounty hunter seeking revenge in this unique sci-fi shooter that seamlessly blends first-person combat with space flight. Hunt dangerous criminals across the galaxy, transitioning from intense firefights in space stations to piloting your ship through asteroid fields without any loading screens. The game's revolutionary seamless gameplay lets you board enemy vessels, engage in corridor shootouts, then jump back in your ship for dogfights - all in one continuous experience. Armed with an arsenal of futuristic weapons and your customizable spacecraft, track bounties through a gritty universe filled with corrupt corporations and alien threats. Experience a noir-inspired story of betrayal and redemption as you uncover the conspiracy that destroyed your life.

title: Mad Dash Racing
description: Mad Dash Racing delivers a wild fusion of kart racing and on-foot combat that sets it apart from typical racing games. Sprint through vibrant cartoon worlds as one of nine zany characters, each with unique abilities and personality. The twist? You're running on your own two feet, not driving vehicles. Bash through opponents with melee attacks, unleash special powers, and grab speed-boosting items while navigating treacherous obstacles and shortcuts. Four-player split-screen multiplayer brings chaotic party game energy as racers sabotage each other with hammers, bombs, and environmental hazards. The game features multiple racing modes across exotic locations from prehistoric jungles to futuristic cities. With its emphasis on combat-heavy footracing, collectible power-ups, and slapstick humor, Mad Dash Racing offers an unconventional take on the mascot racer genre that rewards both speed and strategic aggression.

title: Madagascar
description: Join Alex the Lion, Marty the Zebra, Gloria the Hippo, and Melman the Giraffe in this action-packed adventure based on the DreamWorks animated film! Play as all four zoo animals as they escape from New York's Central Park Zoo and find themselves stranded on the exotic island of Madagascar. Master each character's unique abilities - Alex's powerful roar and claws, Marty's speed and kicks, Gloria's charging attacks, and Melman's helicopter spin and projectiles. Navigate through 11 vibrant levels including the bustling streets of New York, a wild ship voyage, and the lush jungles of Madagascar. Collect power-ups, solve puzzles, and battle against the scheming Foosa enemies. Mini-games like lemur dancing and penguin bowling add variety to the platforming action. Experience the movie's humor through cutscenes featuring the original voice actors.

title: Madden NFL 06
description: Take control of the gridiron in Madden NFL 06, where precision passing meets bone-crushing defense. Experience the revolutionary QB Vision Control that transforms how you read defenses and deliver pinpoint throws. The innovative Superstar Mode puts you in the cleats of a rookie sensation, guiding your career from draft day to Hall of Fame glory. Master the new Precision Passing system for unprecedented control over your aerial attack. Lead your franchise through multiple seasons with enhanced Owner Mode features. Hit Stick 2.0 delivers devastating defensive plays that change momentum instantly. With authentic NFL teams, stadiums, and players, plus refined running mechanics and improved blocking AI, every snap feels authentic. Online leagues let you compete against rivals worldwide in the ultimate test of gridiron strategy and skill.

title: Madden NFL 07
description: Madden NFL 07 revolutionizes football gaming with the innovative Lead Blocker Control, putting you in command of devastating blocks that spring your running back for huge gains. Experience the intensity of NFL Superstar mode where you create a rookie and guide their entire career from the NFL Combine to the Hall of Fame. The new Highlight Stick delivers bone-crushing tackles and acrobatic moves with the right analog stick, while the improved Run to Daylight control lets you find holes in the defense like never before. Team-specific playbooks and authentic stadium atmospheres capture the essence of each franchise. With enhanced graphics showcasing player emotions and realistic weather effects, every game feels like Sunday. Master the new kicking meter for clutch field goals and dominate online leagues.

title: Madden NFL 08
description: Experience the gridiron like never before in Madden NFL 08, where revolutionary gameplay mechanics transform every play into a strategic masterpiece. Master the innovative Hit Stick 2.0 for bone-crushing tackles and game-changing turnovers. The groundbreaking Weapons system identifies elite players with unique abilities - speedsters who break away, possession receivers who dominate traffic, and shutdown corners who erase top threats. Lead your franchise through decades of glory, draft future Hall of Famers, and build dynasties. Superstar mode puts you in the cleats of a single player, living the NFL dream from rookie to legend. With authentic stadiums, realistic weather effects, and commentary that captures every moment's intensity, Madden NFL 08 delivers the ultimate football simulation where strategy meets spectacle.

title: Madden NFL 09
description: Experience the most authentic NFL simulation as Madden NFL 09 delivers unprecedented realism and control. Master the new Virtual Trainer that adapts to your skill level, providing personalized tips and strategies to improve your game. Take command with enhanced play-calling mechanics and the innovative Madden IQ system that tailors difficulty to match your abilities perfectly. Feel the momentum shift with the dynamic Backtrack feature, allowing you to rewind and replay crucial moments. Build your dynasty in Franchise mode with deeper roster management and scouting tools. From bone-crushing tackles to spectacular catches, every play showcases improved animations and physics. Whether competing online or dominating locally, Madden NFL 09 represents the pinnacle of football gaming excellence.

title: Madden NFL 2002
description: Madden NFL 2002 revolutionizes virtual football with enhanced gameplay mechanics and stunning visuals. Experience the intensity of NFL action through improved player animations, realistic tackles, and precise passing controls. The innovative Madden Cards system adds strategic depth, allowing you to boost player abilities and unlock legendary teams. Create your own franchise and guide it through multiple seasons, making crucial draft picks and managing team dynamics. Two-Minute Drill and Tournament modes offer quick competitive thrills, while Practice mode helps perfect your plays. Featuring all 31 NFL teams with updated rosters, authentic stadiums, and John Madden's expert commentary, this edition delivers the most immersive football experience yet. Master the playbook and dominate the gridiron.

title: Madden NFL 2003
description: Madden NFL 2003 revolutionizes virtual football with its groundbreaking gameplay and stunning presentation. Experience the thrill of NFL action as you control all 32 teams with updated rosters and authentic stadiums. The innovative Mini Camp mode lets you hone your skills through challenging drills while unlocking legendary players. Master the new Playmaker Control system to adjust plays on the fly, directing receivers and blockers with precision timing. Lead your franchise through multiple seasons, managing trades, drafts, and contracts to build a dynasty. John Madden's expert commentary brings every play to life with strategic insights. From bone-crushing tackles to spectacular touchdown catches, every moment captures the intensity of professional football.

title: Madden NFL 2005
description: Experience the gridiron like never before in Madden NFL 2005, where defensive play takes center stage with the revolutionary Hit Stick. Time your tackles perfectly to deliver bone-crushing hits that can force fumbles and shift momentum. The new Storyline Central brings drama off the field with dynamic storylines affecting player morale and team chemistry. Create your own superstar in enhanced Franchise Mode, developing skills through mini-games while managing contracts and team dynamics. Precision passing controls let you lead receivers and place balls exactly where needed. Features authentic stadiums, real NFL teams and players, plus Tony Bruno's radio show adding color commentary between games. Online play brings heated rivalries to life.

title: Mafia
description: Step into the shoes of Tommy Angelo, a cab driver thrust into the dangerous world of 1930s organized crime. Navigate the authentic streets of Lost Heaven, a city inspired by Depression-era Chicago and New York. Rise through the Salieri family ranks by completing missions ranging from bootlegging runs to intense shootouts with rival gangs. Experience a gripping narrative that explores loyalty, betrayal, and the price of power. Drive period-accurate vehicles through a living city, engage in visceral gunfights with tommy guns and revolvers, and witness the golden age of the American Mafia. Your choices shape Tommy's fate as you balance survival with morality in this atmospheric open-world crime saga where every decision carries deadly consequences.

title: Magic: The Gathering – Battlegrounds
description: Magic: The Gathering – Battlegrounds transforms the legendary card game into explosive real-time combat. Command powerful wizards across dynamic arenas, summoning creatures and casting devastating spells in fast-paced battles. Master five unique magic colors, each offering distinct playstyles and strategies. Build your spell book from hundreds of authentic Magic cards, then unleash them in intense duels where timing and positioning matter as much as deck composition. Single-player quest mode teaches advanced tactics while multiplayer battles test your skills against opponents worldwide. Experience Magic's deep strategy reimagined for action-packed gameplay where every second counts.

title: Major League Baseball 2K5
description: Step up to the plate in Major League Baseball 2K5, where authentic baseball action meets cutting-edge gameplay. Experience the thrill of America's pastime with all 30 MLB teams and their real rosters from the 2005 season. The innovative K-Zone pitching system gives you pinpoint control over every throw, while the new Slam Zone hitting mechanic lets you time your swings perfectly for devastating home runs. Build dynasties in Franchise mode, create custom players, or jump into quick exhibition matches. Commentary from ESPN's Jon Miller and Joe Morgan brings each game to life with broadcast-quality presentation. From nail-biting pitcher duels to explosive offensive showdowns, every game captures the strategy and excitement of real baseball.

title: Major League Baseball 2K5: World Series Edition
description: Step up to the plate in Major League Baseball 2K5: World Series Edition, where championship dreams come alive. Experience the most authentic baseball simulation with enhanced pitching and batting mechanics that capture every nuance of America's pastime. Command all 30 MLB teams with updated rosters, or create your dynasty in the deep Franchise mode. The innovative K-Zone pitching system gives you pinpoint control over every pitch, while the new Slam Zone hitting lets you target your swings with precision. Relive historic World Series moments in Scenario mode, or build your own legend in Career mode. With ESPN's broadcast presentation, dynamic commentary, and realistic player animations, every game feels like October baseball at its finest.

title: Major League Baseball 2K6
description: Step up to the plate in Major League Baseball 2K6, where authentic baseball action meets cutting-edge gameplay. Experience the thrill of America's pastime with innovative pitching and batting mechanics that put you in complete control. The revolutionary Swing Stick hitting system lets you check swings, foul off pitches, and crush home runs with precision timing. Master the art of pitching with the K-Zone system, painting corners and mixing speeds to dominate batters. Features all 30 MLB teams, authentic stadiums, and real player rosters. Build dynasties in Franchise mode, relive classic moments in Situation mode, or jump online to challenge players worldwide. With dynamic commentary, realistic physics, and ESPN-style presentation, every game feels like a primetime broadcast.

title: Major League Baseball 2K7
description: Step up to the plate in Major League Baseball 2K7, where precision pitching meets explosive batting in the most authentic baseball simulation. Master the innovative Total Control Pitching system using analog stick movements to paint corners and fool batters with devastating breaking balls. Experience the thrill of clutch situations with dynamic player emotions affecting performance under pressure. Build dynasties in deep Franchise mode, featuring full minor league systems and realistic player development. Signature Style technology captures each player's unique batting stances and pitching motions. From diving catches to turning double plays, every moment feels authentic with fluid animations and responsive controls. Features all 30 MLB teams, complete rosters, and classic stadiums rendered in stunning detail.

title: Malice
description: Embark on a whimsical adventure as Malice, a goddess stripped of her powers who must reclaim her strength to defeat the evil Dog God. This action-platformer blends humor with hack-and-slash combat across diverse magical realms. Transform using unique weapons that grant special abilities - wield the Mace of Clubs to smash enemies, use the Clockwork Hammer to slow time, or soar with the Wings of Despair. Navigate floating platforms, solve environmental puzzles, and battle bizarre creatures in vibrant worlds ranging from lush forests to mechanical fortresses. With its distinctive art style, irreverent humor, and creative weapon-based mechanics, Malice delivers a quirky twist on classic 3D platforming that rewards exploration and mastery of each transformative tool in your divine arsenal.

title: Manchester United Manager 2005
description: Take control of Manchester United, one of the world's most iconic football clubs, in this comprehensive management simulation. Build your dream squad through strategic transfers and youth development while managing every aspect of the club from tactics to finances. Experience the pressure of the Premier League, Champions League, and domestic cups as you make crucial decisions on match day. Deploy formations, adjust tactics in real-time, and watch your strategic choices unfold in detailed match engines. Handle press conferences, manage player morale, and navigate board expectations while dealing with injuries and suspensions. Scout emerging talent worldwide, negotiate contracts, and develop training regimes to maximize player potential. From Old Trafford to away grounds across Europe, prove you have what it takes to maintain United's winning tradition.

title: Manhunt
description: Survive a twisted nightmare in Rockstar's most controversial thriller. You are James Earl Cash, a death row inmate forced to participate in a sadistic snuff film directed by a mysterious voice in your earpiece. Navigate through decrepit urban environments using shadows and sound to evade ruthless gangs hunting you down. Execute brutal stealth takedowns with improvised weapons ranging from plastic bags to crowbars - the longer you hold the attack, the more vicious the kill. Each execution is rated for style and captured on CCTV for your captor's sick entertainment. Master three levels of executions, from quick and quiet to grotesquely violent. Use distractions like thrown bottles and bodies to manipulate enemy patrols. The innovative sound detection system makes every footstep matter as hunters track your movements. This psychological horror experience pushes boundaries with its unflinching violence and dark atmosphere.

title: Marc Ecko's Getting Up: Contents Under Pressure
description: Transform into Trane, a young graffiti artist fighting to make his mark in the oppressive city of New Radius. Battle corrupt authorities and rival crews through a unique blend of street art creation and urban combat. Master an innovative graffiti system to tag walls, create massive murals, and bomb the city with your art while evading police. Navigate sprawling urban environments using parkour-inspired movement, scaling buildings and traversing rooftops. Engage in brutal hand-to-hand combat combining street fighting with improvised weapons. Experience a gritty narrative featuring voice work from hip-hop legends like Talib Kweli and RZA. Unlock new artistic styles and techniques as you rise through the underground scene. This groundbreaking title merges graffiti culture with action gameplay in ways never seen before.

title: Marvel: Ultimate Alliance
description: Assemble the ultimate superhero dream team in Marvel: Ultimate Alliance, an action-RPG that puts the fate of the Marvel Universe in your hands. Choose from over 20 iconic heroes including Spider-Man, Captain America, Thor, and Wolverine to form your perfect squad of four. Battle through diverse locations from Atlantis to Asgard as Doctor Doom unleashes his Masters of Evil. Customize your heroes with unique costumes that unlock new abilities, and develop their powers through an extensive upgrade system. Team up with friends in 4-player co-op to execute devastating combo attacks and special team bonuses. Switch between characters on the fly to adapt your strategy against classic villains like Ultron and Galactus. With branching storylines and moral choices that impact the ending, every playthrough offers new possibilities in this epic Marvel adventure.

title: Marvel Nemesis: Rise of the Imperfects
description: Marvel Nemesis: Rise of the Imperfects unleashes an explosive superhero brawler where Marvel icons clash with deadly original characters called the Imperfects. Choose from Spider-Man, Wolverine, Iron Man, and other beloved heroes, or master the dark powers of new villains like Johnny Ohm and Brigade. Battle through destructible environments in intense one-on-one combat featuring devastating super moves and environmental weapons. The innovative fighting system blends traditional controls with easy-to-execute combos, letting you unleash spectacular powers. Story mode reveals how an alien invasion forces heroes and villains into uneasy alliances. With fully interactive arenas that crumble under your might, every fight becomes a cinematic spectacle of superhuman warfare.

title: Marvel vs. Capcom 2
description: Marvel vs. Capcom 2 delivers the ultimate tag-team fighting experience with an unprecedented roster of 56 playable characters from both universes. Choose your three-fighter dream team and unleash devastating aerial combos, hyper combos, and screen-filling special moves in fast-paced 3-on-3 battles. The game's refined assist system lets you call in partners for strategic attacks and defensive saves while mastering the art of snapbacks, delayed hyper combos, and infinite prevention mechanics. From Spider-Man and Wolverine to Ryu and Mega Man, each fighter brings unique playstyles and team synergies to discover. With its vibrant comic book visuals, jazzy soundtrack, and incredibly deep combat system that rewards both newcomers and veterans, this legendary crossover fighter remains the gold standard for versus fighting games.

title: Mashed: Drive to Survive
description: Mashed: Drive to Survive delivers explosive top-down arcade racing where winning means more than crossing the finish line first. Battle through 13 treacherous tracks using missiles, machine guns, and barrel bombs to obliterate rivals while dodging their attacks. The innovative camera system eliminates lagging drivers from the screen, creating intense elimination-style races where survival is everything. Master four distinct racing modes including the chaotic Fully Loaded battles and strategic Air Strike challenges. With 4-player split-screen multiplayer, customizable vehicles, and physics-based crashes that send cars flying off cliffs and into explosive collisions, every race becomes an unpredictable war on wheels where dirty tactics reign supreme.

title: Mashed: Fully Loaded
description: Get ready for explosive top-down racing mayhem in Mashed: Fully Loaded! Battle up to four players in frantic arcade racing where anything goes. Unleash devastating weapons like missiles, machine guns, and air strikes to blast opponents off the track. Master 18 unique tracks across diverse environments from icy tundras to scorching deserts. Choose from 13 distinct vehicles, each with different handling and speed characteristics. The innovative camera system keeps all racers on screen, creating intense close-quarters combat. Compete in multiple game modes including traditional races, elimination battles, and the chaotic Ice Hockey mode. With its pick-up-and-play controls and addictive multiplayer action, Mashed delivers pure arcade racing carnage that'll have you and your friends battling for hours.

title: Mat Hoffman's Pro BMX 2
description: Mat Hoffman's Pro BMX 2 delivers the ultimate BMX experience with legendary rider Mat Hoffman leading an all-star cast of pro riders. Pull off insane tricks across massive environments including Chicago, Las Vegas, and Oklahoma City. Master over 200 tricks and combos while exploring open-world levels packed with secret areas and hidden challenges. The innovative trick modifier system lets you tweak grabs, spins, and flips mid-air for endless creativity. Compete in intense competitions, complete pro challenges, or session freely in the expansive Road Trip mode. Create custom riders and parks with the robust editor tools, then take your skills online for multiplayer mayhem. With its killer soundtrack, smooth controls, and endless replayability, this BMX masterpiece pushes extreme sports gaming to new heights.

title: The Matrix: Path of Neo
description: Step into Neo's journey from Thomas Anderson to The One in this action-packed adaptation of the Matrix trilogy. Master the innovative martial arts combat system featuring Focus abilities that let you dodge bullets in slow motion, run on walls, and perform gravity-defying moves straight from the films. Battle through pivotal scenes including the lobby shootout, rooftop chase, and climactic showdown with Agent Smith. Learn new fighting techniques and combos as Neo's powers evolve, unlocking devastating abilities like the legendary "One" powers. Experience expanded storylines with new scenes created exclusively for the game, offering deeper insight into Neo's path. Face off against familiar foes including Agents, SWAT teams, and deadly programs in both film-accurate and original levels that expand the Matrix universe.

title: Metal Arms: Glitch in the System
description: In a world of mechanical mayhem, you are Glitch, a pint-sized robot with oversized firepower on a mission to save your kind from the tyrannical General Corrosive. Blast through 40+ levels of explosive combat across diverse environments from mines to space stations. Hijack enemy robots and turn their own weapons against them with the innovative Tether Gun. Arsenal includes 17 upgradeable weapons from rivet guns to rocket launchers. Experience clever level design mixing platforming with intense shootouts. Multiplayer modes support 4-player split-screen battles. With sharp humor, destructible environments, and satisfying metal-on-metal combat, Metal Arms delivers a unique twist on third-person action that stands apart from typical mascot shooters.

title: Max Payne
description: Max Payne revolutionizes action gaming with its groundbreaking bullet-time mechanic, letting you slow time to dodge bullets and deliver precise shots in spectacular shootouts. Play as Max Payne, an undercover cop framed for murder, fighting through New York's criminal underworld to uncover a conspiracy and avenge his family. The noir-inspired narrative unfolds through graphic novel panels and Max's hardboiled narration, creating an atmospheric crime thriller. Experience intense gunplay across gritty locations from subway stations to corporate skyscrapers. Master dual-wielding pistols, shotguns, and automatic weapons while diving through the air in slow motion. The revolutionary physics engine makes every shootout cinematic, with destructible environments and realistic bullet impacts. Dark, mature storytelling combines with innovative gameplay to create an unforgettable action experience that defined a genre.

title: Max Payne 2: The Fall of Max Payne
description: Max Payne returns in this noir masterpiece where love is a loaded gun. Experience revolutionary bullet-time gunplay as you dive through the air in slow motion, dodging bullets while unleashing precise devastation. The sequel perfects the formula with enhanced physics, more destructive environments, and seamless narrative integration. Play as both Max and femme fatale Mona Sax through a twisted tale of conspiracy and betrayal. Every shootout becomes a cinematic ballet of violence with ragdoll physics and detailed weapon effects. The haunting soundtrack and graphic novel storytelling create an unforgettable atmosphere. Face impossible odds in spectacular set pieces, from construction sites to fun houses. This is action gaming at its most stylish and brutal.

title: Maximum Chase
description: Experience high-octane vehicular combat as undercover operative Rick Summer in this Xbox-exclusive action racer from Genki. Seamlessly blend intense driving sequences with explosive shooting sections across cinematic missions featuring live-action cutscenes with professional actors. Choose from over 20 licensed car brands including Chevrolet Corvette, Pontiac Firebird, Lexus, and Nissan, each offering distinct handling characteristics reminiscent of Project Gotham Racing's arcade-sim balance. Engage in thrilling pursuits through city streets and highways, switching between precision driving and targeting enemies while maintaining control of your vehicle. The unique gameplay alternates between white-knuckle racing segments and strategic combat phases where timing and accuracy determine survival. With its blend of licensed vehicles, Hollywood-style presentation featuring actors like Chris Hatfield, and innovative dual-mode gameplay, Maximum Chase delivers a distinctive vehicular action experience.

title: MechAssault
description: Command the battlefield in massive BattleMechs as you fight to save the Inner Sphere from the ruthless Word of Blake clan. MechAssault delivers explosive mech combat with streamlined controls that make piloting 40-foot war machines incredibly intuitive. Choose from over a dozen iconic BattleMechs, each with unique weapons and abilities, from the nimble Cougar to the devastating Atlas. Unleash devastating firepower with lasers, missiles, and ballistic weapons while managing your heat levels to avoid shutdown. Battle across destructible environments where buildings crumble and forests burn under your assault. Experience the first BattleTech game designed specifically for console, featuring arcade-style action that captures the essence of mech warfare. Dominate in multiplayer battles via Xbox Live or tackle the campaign to liberate planets from enemy forces.

title: MechAssault 2: Lone Wolf
description: Pilot towering BattleMechs and agile Battle Armor in this explosive sequel that revolutionizes mech combat. MechAssault 2: Lone Wolf puts you in control of massive war machines armed with devastating weapons like pulse lasers, autocannons, and missile barrages. Experience the innovative Neurohacking system to hijack enemy mechs mid-battle, turning their firepower against them. Switch seamlessly between piloting 35-ton mechs and nimble Battle Armor suits that can climb buildings and board enemy vehicles. Fight through a gripping campaign across war-torn planets or challenge friends in intense Xbox Live multiplayer battles supporting up to 12 players. Master vertical combat with the VTOL aircraft and unleash destruction with the new BattleMech configurations. Every battlefield becomes your weapon in this ultimate mech warfare experience.

title: Medal of Honor: European Assault
description: Lead your squad through the most pivotal battles of WWII in Medal of Honor: European Assault. Command Allied forces across four authentic European campaigns, from the Battle of the Bulge to the Soviet advance on Berlin. Experience intense combat with revolutionary squad mechanics - issue tactical orders, call for covering fire, and revive fallen teammates. Each mission offers multiple paths and objectives, rewarding strategic thinking over run-and-gun tactics. Unleash devastating Adrenaline Mode to turn the tide of battle with enhanced accuracy and invincibility. Historic weapons, destructible environments, and cinematic storytelling combine with a gripping multiplayer mode supporting up to 8 players. Your leadership will determine victory.

title: Medal of Honor: Frontline
description: Step into the boots of OSS operative Lt. Jimmy Patterson in this acclaimed World War II shooter that defined console FPS gaming. Storm the beaches of Normandy on D-Day, infiltrate Nazi strongholds, and sabotage the German war machine across six intense campaigns. Experience cinematic battles enhanced by Michael Giacchino's sweeping orchestral score that rivals Hollywood war films. Master authentic WWII weapons from the M1 Garand to the Panzerschreck as you fight through meticulously recreated European battlefields. Each mission blends stealth, action, and strategy - disguise yourself as a German officer, commandeer vehicles, or go guns blazing. With its perfect balance of historical authenticity and pure action, Frontline delivers the definitive WWII shooter experience.

title: Medal of Honor: Rising Sun
description: Experience the Pacific Theater of WWII through the eyes of Marine Corporal Joseph Griffin in this intense first-person shooter. Battle through seven historic campaigns from Pearl Harbor to the Philippines, wielding authentic period weapons including the M1 Garand, Thompson submachine gun, and captured Japanese firearms. Fight alongside AI squadmates through lush jungles, war-torn islands, and enemy strongholds while engaging in fierce firefights against Imperial Japanese forces. Features split-screen cooperative campaign mode where two players can tackle missions together, plus four-player competitive multiplayer battles. Commandeer vehicles like PT boats and elephant mounts for tactical advantages. The orchestral score and realistic sound design immerse you in the chaos of Pacific warfare as you sabotage enemy operations, rescue POWs, and turn the tide of history.

title: Mega Man Anniversary Collection
description: Blast through gaming history with Mega Man Anniversary Collection, featuring eight classic action-platformers that defined a generation. Control the Blue Bomber across the complete original series from Mega Man 1 through 8, plus two arcade fighters. Master precision jumping and shooting as you battle Robot Masters, stealing their unique weapons to exploit enemy weaknesses. Each game delivers increasingly complex level designs, memorable boss patterns, and that signature challenge that made Mega Man legendary. Experience enhanced features including updated controls, save states, and unlockable artwork galleries. From the series' humble NES origins to its PlayStation evolution, witness how Mega Man revolutionized action gaming with tight controls, strategic weapon selection, and some of gaming's most iconic music. Whether you're a veteran or newcomer, this definitive collection offers the ultimate test of skill and reflexes.

title: Melbourne Cup Challenge
description: Experience the thrill of Australia's most prestigious horse racing event in Melbourne Cup Challenge. Take control of champion thoroughbreds and guide them to victory across iconic racecourses including Flemington, Caulfield, and Moonee Valley. Master realistic racing mechanics as you navigate tight pack racing, time your sprint perfectly, and find the ideal racing line. Build your stable from promising yearlings to champion racehorses through strategic training and breeding programs. Compete in over 30 major racing events throughout the season, culminating in the race that stops a nation. Features authentic jockey silks, detailed horse animations, and dynamic weather conditions that affect race strategy. Challenge friends in multiplayer races or build a racing dynasty in career mode.

title: Men of Valor
description: Experience the brutal reality of the Vietnam War in Men of Valor, a gripping first-person shooter that puts you in the boots of Marine Dean Shepard. Fight through historically-inspired battles from 1965 to 1968, including the intense Tet Offensive and siege of Khe Sanh. Navigate dense jungles, booby-trapped tunnels, and war-torn villages while facing an elusive enemy. Command squad tactics, call in artillery strikes, and utilize authentic Vietnam-era weapons from M16 rifles to flamethrowers. The game blends intense firefights with quieter moments that explore the human cost of war through letters home and interactions with fellow Marines. With its gritty realism, atmospheric soundtrack, and unflinching portrayal of combat, Men of Valor delivers one of gaming's most authentic Vietnam experiences.

title: Mercenaries: Playground of Destruction
description: Step into the boots of a ruthless mercenary in this explosive open-world action game set in war-torn North Korea. Choose from three unique operatives and hunt down the infamous "Deck of 52" - high-value targets inspired by the Iraq War's most wanted list. Every structure can be destroyed with an arsenal of weapons ranging from C4 to bunker busters, while you call in devastating airstrikes, artillery barrages, and vehicle drops. Hijack tanks, helicopters, and military vehicles to wreak havoc across a massive battlefield. Accept contracts from rival factions including China, South Korea, the Russian Mafia, and the Allied Nations, playing each side for maximum profit. Your playground of destruction awaits.

title: Metal Dungeon
description: Metal Dungeon thrusts you into a sci-fi dungeon crawler where your team of cyborgs battles through ten massive randomly-generated levels filled with deadly monsters and traps. Choose from five unique cyborg characters, each with distinct abilities and upgrade paths, as you explore the mysterious depths of a research facility gone wrong. The game blends traditional turn-based JRPG combat with roguelike elements - death means starting over, but you keep your experience and unlocked abilities. Customize your cyborgs with over 100 different parts and weapons, from plasma rifles to energy swords. With multiple endings based on your choices and performance, plus a hardcore survival mode that tests your resource management skills, Metal Dungeon offers a challenging fusion of dungeon crawling and mecha customization that rewards both strategic planning and adaptability.

title: Metal Gear Solid 2: Substance
description: Metal Gear Solid 2: Substance delivers the complete tactical espionage experience with enhanced content beyond the original Sons of Liberty. Play as both Solid Snake and newcomer Raiden across a gripping story of deception, conspiracy, and advanced warfare set on a marine tanker and offshore cleanup facility. Master stealth mechanics including first-person aiming, hanging from ledges, and holding up guards. Substance adds over 500 VR missions, alternative missions featuring Snake, and skateboarding mini-games. Experience groundbreaking AI where enemies coordinate attacks, call for backup, and investigate disturbances realistically. The game pushes boundaries with its meta-narrative that questions reality, identity, and the nature of sequels themselves.

title: Metal Slug 3
description: Join Marco, Tarma, Eri, and Fio in the ultimate run-and-gun adventure as Metal Slug 3 delivers the series' most explosive entry yet. Battle through branching mission paths that offer multiple routes and secret areas, ensuring no two playthroughs are the same. Face off against zombies, giant crabs, alien invaders, and the returning rebel army in beautifully animated 2D environments. Transform into a zombie, gain weight from eating too much food, or pilot incredible vehicles including submarines, helicopters, and the iconic Metal Slug tank. The game's legendary difficulty ramps up with massive boss battles and screen-filling bullet patterns that demand quick reflexes and pattern memorization. Two-player cooperative action lets you team up to tackle the chaos together, combining firepower and strategy to overcome seemingly impossible odds.

title: Metal Slug 4
description: Join Marco, Fio, and newcomers Trevor and Nadia as they battle a cyber-terrorist organization threatening the world with a stolen virus! Metal Slug 4 delivers the series' signature run-and-gun action with explosive new features. Blast through beautifully animated stages filled with enemy soldiers, massive mechanical bosses, and screen-filling explosions. Master the new dual-machine gun system and metallish combo scoring to rack up huge points. Commandeer classic vehicles like the Metal Slug tank and new additions including the powerful Bradley and menacing Tokhausen mech. Experience branching pathways that add replay value as you uncover hidden routes and rescue POWs. With its fluid animation, intense cooperative gameplay, and arsenal of devastating weapons from heavy machine guns to rocket launchers, Metal Slug 4 continues the franchise's legacy of frantic arcade action and humor.

title: Metal Slug 5
description: Metal Slug 5 unleashes the most explosive chapter in SNK's legendary run-and-gun series. Battle through seven intense missions as Marco, Tarma, Eri, or Fio, facing a mysterious militant group stealing secret military data. The signature hand-drawn animation delivers stunning detail as you blast through hordes of enemies with an expanded arsenal including the devastating Dual Machine Gun and Enemy Chaser. Commandeer new Slugs like the agile Slug Gunner mech and spider-like Slug Mobile to dominate land and air combat. Master the new slide maneuver to dodge attacks and reach hidden areas packed with POWs and power-ups. From ancient ruins to futuristic bases, each meticulously crafted stage culminates in epic boss battles against mechanical monstrosities. With branching paths, hidden secrets, and relentless action, Metal Slug 5 perfects the series' blend of humor and hardcore gameplay.

title: Metal Wolf Chaos
description: Take control of the President of the United States in a massive mech suit to reclaim America from a military coup! Metal Wolf Chaos delivers over-the-top action as you pilot your presidential power armor across iconic American locations, from the White House to the Golden Gate Bridge. Unleash devastating firepower with over 100 weapons including machine guns, bazookas, and missile launchers. This FromSoftware cult classic features destructible environments, boss battles against giant mechs, and a gloriously patriotic storyline filled with memorable one-liners. Switch between eight weapon slots on the fly, chain massive combos, and save America one explosion at a time in this uniquely Japanese take on American action cinema.

title: Micro Machines
description: Race miniature vehicles through oversized household environments in this frantic top-down racing game. Navigate tiny cars, boats, and helicopters across kitchen tables, garden paths, and desktop battlefields where everyday objects become challenging obstacles. Master tight corners around cereal boxes, jump ramps made from rulers, and dodge hazards like spilled milk and desktop clutter. Features intense 4-player competitive racing with unique catch-up mechanics that keep races nail-bitingly close. Choose from diverse vehicle types including sports cars, tanks, and hovercrafts, each with distinct handling. The innovative share-controller mode lets two players use one gamepad for instant multiplayer mayhem. With dozens of creative tracks set in familiar locations transformed into racing circuits, precise controls, and chaotic weapon pickups, Micro Machines delivers addictive arcade racing where scale is everything and one mistake can cost you the race.

title: Midnight Club II
description: Take on the world's most notorious street racers in this adrenaline-fueled sequel that revolutionizes illegal racing. Tear through the sprawling streets of Los Angeles, Paris, and Tokyo at breakneck speeds, weaving through traffic and launching off ramps in spectacular aerial stunts. Choose from exotic sports cars and motorcycles, each with unique handling and customization options. The innovative Cruise mode lets you explore massive open cities freely, discovering hidden shortcuts and challenging rivals to spontaneous races. With aggressive AI opponents who learn your tactics, every race becomes an intense battle for supremacy. Experience dynamic weather, destructible environments, and a pumping soundtrack that captures the underground racing scene. Race online against players worldwide or dominate the streets solo in this ultimate midnight racing experience.

title: Midnight Club 3: Dub Edition
description: Race through the neon-lit streets of San Diego, Atlanta, and Detroit in the ultimate street racing showdown. Midnight Club 3: Dub Edition delivers heart-pounding arcade racing with unprecedented customization options. Choose from licensed cars and motorcycles, then transform them with thousands of visual and performance upgrades. Master three distinct racing styles - Agro, Balanced, and Trickster - each offering unique abilities like ramming through traffic or pulling off gravity-defying stunts. Challenge rivals in intense races, cruise the open cities, or compete in specialized tournaments. With its revolutionary ROAR engine delivering blazing speeds, dynamic weather, and a thumping hip-hop soundtrack, this racer pushes urban racing to the extreme.

title: Midnight Club 3: Dub Edition Remix
description: Race through the streets of San Diego, Atlanta, and Detroit in the ultimate street racing experience. Midnight Club 3: Dub Edition Remix puts you behind the wheel of over 60 licensed vehicles including tuners, muscle cars, choppers, and luxury rides. Customize your ride with an unprecedented array of visual and performance upgrades, from body kits to hydraulics and nitrous systems. Challenge rivals in intense arcade-style races across sprawling open cities with no set paths - create your own route to victory. The Remix edition adds new vehicles, music tracks, and the explosive Tokyo city to explore. With its pioneering ROAR engine delivering 60fps action, deep customization system, and pumping hip-hop soundtrack, this is street racing at its most stylish and intense.

title: Midtown Madness 3
description: Race through the streets of Paris and Washington D.C. in Midtown Madness 3, the ultimate urban racing experience on Xbox. Choose from over 30 licensed vehicles including sports cars, SUVs, and classic muscle cars, then tear through meticulously recreated city streets filled with shortcuts, jumps, and destructible objects. Master multiple game modes from checkpoint races to capture the flag, or create chaos in free roam mode. Challenge friends in split-screen multiplayer or take the action online via Xbox Live with up to 8 players. Dynamic weather effects and day/night cycles add variety to each race. Smash through outdoor cafes, leap over monuments, and discover hidden routes as you dominate two of the world's most iconic cities in this arcade racing thrill ride.

title: Midway Arcade Treasures
description: Dive into gaming history with Midway Arcade Treasures, the ultimate collection of 24 classic arcade games from the golden age. Experience timeless favorites like Spy Hunter's high-speed espionage action, Defender's frantic alien-blasting gameplay, and Robotron 2084's twin-stick shooting mayhem. Race through the streets in Super Sprint, battle mythological creatures in Gauntlet, or master the martial arts in Mortal Kombat. Each game features authentic arcade-perfect emulation, preserving the original graphics, sounds, and gameplay that defined a generation. Unlock exclusive behind-the-scenes content including vintage commercials, developer interviews, and design documents that reveal the stories behind these legendary titles. From Joust's medieval combat to Rampage's city-crushing chaos, every game delivers pure arcade excitement.

title: Midway Arcade Treasures 2
description: Relive the golden age of arcade gaming with Midway Arcade Treasures 2, featuring over 20 legendary coin-op classics from the '80s and '90s. Battle through the revolutionary Mortal Kombat II and 3, master the brutal combos of Primal Rage, and experience the visceral action of NARC and Total Carnage. Race through championship tracks in Hard Drivin' and Race Drivin', soar through aerial combat in Cyberball 2072, and test your reflexes with Rampage World Tour. This collection preserves arcade history with authentic emulation, original attract modes, and bonus content including developer interviews and concept art. From fighting games to racing simulators, each title delivers the exact arcade experience with customizable controls and display options. Unlock achievements, discover Easter eggs, and compete for high scores across multiple genres in this definitive retro compilation.

title: Midway Arcade Treasures 3
description: Midway Arcade Treasures 3 delivers eight legendary racing games from arcade history in one explosive collection. Burn rubber in Rush 2049's futuristic San Francisco, complete with gravity-defying stunts and hidden shortcuts. Master the original Off Road Thunder and its sequel, conquering dirt tracks in powerful trucks. Experience the visceral thrills of Hydro Thunder's speedboat racing across exotic waterways. Relive S.T.U.N. Runner's high-speed tunnel racing and Race Drivin's pioneering 3D polygonal tracks. San Francisco Rush The Rock brings Alcatraz Island racing, while Badlands offers top-down vehicular combat. Each game features authentic arcade gameplay with enhanced graphics and multiplayer modes. Unlock bonus content including developer interviews and arcade cabinet artwork as you progress through this definitive racing compilation.

title: Mike Tyson Heavyweight Boxing
description: Step into the ring as the baddest man on the planet in Mike Tyson Heavyweight Boxing! Experience bone-crushing power and lightning-fast combinations as you fight your way through a roster of fierce opponents to claim the championship belt. Master Iron Mike's signature peek-a-boo style, devastating uppercuts, and explosive knockouts that made him a legend. Create your own boxer and train them from amateur to heavyweight champion, or play as Tyson himself and relive his greatest fights. Features authentic boxing mechanics, multiple game modes including career and exhibition matches, and intense multiplayer battles. Feel every punch with realistic damage modeling and dynamic knockdowns. The road to glory is brutal - do you have what it takes to become the undisputed champion?

title: Minority Report: Everybody Runs
description: Step into the shoes of John Anderton, Chief of Washington D.C.'s elite PreCrime unit, in this intense action thriller based on the Spielberg film. Framed for a future murder you didn't commit, you're now fugitive from the very system you once upheld. Navigate through futuristic cityscapes using revolutionary ragdoll physics that make every fight unpredictable and visceral. Wield an arsenal of non-lethal weapons including the Concussion Rifle and Riot Shotgun to incapacitate enemies without killing them. Master hand-to-hand combat with context-sensitive attacks that adapt to your environment. Solve puzzles, evade spider-bots, and use your PreCog visions to stay one step ahead of your pursuers. Experience a dark conspiracy that goes deeper than the movie as you fight to clear your name and expose the truth behind PreCrime.

title: Mission: Impossible – Operation Surma
description: Step into the shoes of IMF agent Ethan Hunt in this stealth-action thriller that brings the impossible missions to life. Master the art of espionage as you infiltrate heavily guarded facilities using cutting-edge gadgets, from micro cameras to electronic lockpicks. Execute precision takedowns with hand-to-hand combat moves or utilize an arsenal of high-tech weapons when stealth fails. Navigate through exotic locations across the globe, from ice-covered military bases to Middle Eastern compounds. Employ disguises to bypass enemies, hack security systems to gain tactical advantages, and rappel down skyscrapers in heart-pounding sequences. Face off against the sinister SURMA corporation bent on global domination. Every mission demands strategy and split-second decisions.

title: MotoGP: Ultimate Racing Technology
description: Experience the ultimate motorcycle racing simulation with MotoGP: Ultimate Racing Technology. Take control of authentic MotoGP bikes and riders from the official 2002 season, mastering every circuit on the championship calendar. Feel the intense physics engine that realistically simulates bike handling, tire wear, and weather conditions affecting grip and performance. Challenge yourself across multiple game modes including Championship, Quick Race, and Time Trial. Fine-tune your machine with detailed setup options adjusting suspension, gearing, and brake balance to gain the competitive edge. Race wheel-to-wheel against aggressive AI opponents or test your skills in multiplayer split-screen battles. Every race demands precision as you navigate racing lines, manage tire temperature, and execute perfect overtakes.

title: MLB Slugfest 2003
description: MLB Slugfest 2003 transforms America's pastime into an over-the-top arcade spectacle where baseball meets brutal combat. Forget traditional rules - punch out baserunners, charge the mound, and ignite players on fire with blazing fastballs. This Midway masterpiece features all 30 MLB teams and real players, but throws realism out the window for pure fun. Turbo meters enable superhuman plays, while spectacular catches and impossible home runs defy physics. Commentary from Tim Kitzrow and Jim Shorts adds hilarious play-by-play to the mayhem. Unlock secret teams, big head modes, and outrageous stadiums. Four-player multiplayer turns every game into a chaotic brawl where winning means combining skillful batting with strategic violence.

title: MLB Slugfest 2004
description: Step up to the plate in MLB Slugfest 2004, where baseball gets an adrenaline-fueled makeover! This isn't your typical sim - it's arcade baseball cranked to eleven. Unleash turbo-charged pitches, devastating power swings, and bone-crushing collisions that send players flying. Build up your "On Fire" meter to become an unstoppable force, throwing unhittable blazing fastballs or launching moon shots out of the stadium. Features all 30 MLB teams and real players with exaggerated abilities. The fighting system lets you charge the mound and duke it out when tensions rise. Create custom players with outrageous stats, compete in Home Run Derby mode, or battle through a full season. With over-the-top commentary and spectacular special effects, every at-bat becomes a highlight reel moment.

title: MLB Slugfest 2006
description: Step up to the plate in MLB Slugfest 2006, where baseball meets over-the-top arcade action! This isn't your typical sim - it's baseball with attitude. Charge the mound, throw wild pitches at batters, and ignite your bat on fire with turbo-powered swings. Pull off insane diving catches, execute bone-crushing slides, and watch players literally catch fire when they're on a hot streak. Features all 30 MLB teams and real players with authentic stadiums. The Create-a-Player mode lets you build your ultimate slugger, while multiplayer delivers intense couch competition. With its aggressive gameplay, spectacular animations, and unique combo system that rewards aggressive base-running and batting, Slugfest 2006 transforms America's pastime into an adrenaline-pumping arcade experience where anything goes!

title: MLB Slugfest: Loaded
description: MLB Slugfest: Loaded brings outrageous arcade baseball action to Xbox with over-the-top gameplay that throws realism out the window. Punch, kick, and body-check opponents while rounding the bases in this no-holds-barred sports brawler. Execute spectacular turbo-charged pitches that literally set the ball on fire, and unleash devastating power hits that send fielders flying. Create custom teams and players, then dominate in multiple game modes including the brand-new Home Run Pinball mini-game. With Tim Kitzrow's legendary commentary, unlockable legends, and wild special effects like flaming fastballs and matrix-style slow-motion catches, this isn't your typical baseball sim. Four-player multiplayer battles let you settle scores on and off the diamond in the most chaotic baseball experience ever created.

title: Mojo!
description: Roll your marble through 100 challenging puzzle levels in this addictive physics-based brain teaser. Navigate treacherous mazes filled with colored blocks, deadly traps, and mind-bending obstacles that test your precision and problem-solving skills. Master the marble's momentum and physics to break all colored blocks while avoiding hazards like spikes, moving platforms, and bottomless pits. Race against the clock to earn time bonuses and unlock new challenges across increasingly complex stages. The robust stage editor lets you design and share custom levels, extending gameplay indefinitely. Compete with friends in multiplayer modes that add competitive twists to marble mayhem. While sharing DNA with Super Monkey Ball and Marble Madness, Mojo! distinguishes itself with deeper puzzle elements, strategic block-breaking mechanics, and a vast array of creative obstacles that keep each level fresh and engaging.

title: Monopoly Party
description: Monopoly Party brings the classic board game to life with exciting multiplayer mayhem for up to four players. Race around themed game boards collecting properties, building monopolies, and driving opponents to bankruptcy in this fast-paced digital adaptation. The game features simultaneous play where all players move at once, eliminating downtime and keeping everyone engaged. Choose from multiple themed boards beyond the classic Atlantic City, each with unique visual styles and property sets. Mini-games add variety between turns, letting players compete for extra cash and advantages. Customizable house rules let you tweak gameplay to your preferences, from free parking jackpots to speed die options. With colorful 3D animations, lively sound effects, and Mr. Monopoly himself as your guide, this party edition transforms the traditional real estate empire building into a dynamic social experience perfect for game night.

title: Monster 4x4: World Circuit
description: Take control of massive monster trucks and conquer challenging off-road circuits around the globe in Monster 4x4: World Circuit. Race through diverse environments from dusty deserts to muddy swamps, each demanding different driving strategies. Master realistic physics as your truck bounces, tilts, and crushes obstacles beneath oversized tires. Choose from multiple licensed monster trucks, each with unique handling characteristics and customizable parts. Tackle championship mode across international venues, compete in time trials, or challenge friends in split-screen multiplayer battles. Execute spectacular jumps, navigate treacherous terrain, and perform crowd-pleasing stunts while maintaining speed. With arcade-style accessibility and simulation depth, this racer delivers authentic monster truck thrills.

title: Monster Garage
description: Transform everyday vehicles into outrageous monster machines in this high-octane customization game based on the hit Discovery Channel series! Work alongside Jesse James and his crew to create insane automotive hybrids that defy convention. Take ordinary cars, trucks, and bikes, then rebuild them into wild creations like a PT Cruiser wood chipper or a VW Beetle swamp buggy. Each build challenges you with timed missions where you must select the right parts, manage your budget, and complete modifications before the deadline. Test your creations in action-packed challenges that push your monsters to their limits. With dozens of vehicles to transform, hundreds of parts to choose from, and multiple garage locations, Monster Garage delivers the ultimate automotive fantasy where creativity meets horsepower.

title: Mortal Kombat: Armageddon
description: Mortal Kombat: Armageddon delivers the ultimate fighting experience with the largest roster in MK history - over 60 kombatants including every warrior from the franchise's past. Create your own fighter with the revolutionary Kreate-A-Fighter mode, customizing appearance, fighting style, and special moves. Battle through the all-new Konquest adventure mode featuring Taven's epic journey to prevent Armageddon. Master the deadly Kreate-A-Fatality system that lets you chain together brutal finishing moves on the fly. Race through kombat in the returning Motor Kombat mini-game. With enhanced aerial combat, interactive environments, and devastating super moves, this marks the explosive culmination of the Mortal Kombat saga on sixth-generation consoles.

title: Mortal Kombat: Deadly Alliance
description: Mortal Kombat: Deadly Alliance revolutionizes the legendary fighting franchise with a deadly new 3D combat system. Choose from over 20 warriors, each mastering multiple martial arts styles you can switch between mid-fight for devastating combos. The sinister alliance of Shang Tsung and Quan Chi threatens all realms as they resurrect the Dragon King's undefeatable army. Master each fighter's unique weapons, from Sub-Zero's Kori Blade to Scorpion's Mugai Ryu, unlocking brutal new Fatalities that push the boundaries of kombat. Test your skills in Konquest mode's extensive training or dive into the mysterious Krypt to unlock hidden characters, costumes, and concept art. This dark chapter delivers the deepest, most strategic Mortal Kombat experience yet.

title: Mortal Kombat: Deception
description: Mortal Kombat: Deception unleashes brutal kombat with groundbreaking features that redefine the fighting genre. Master deadly combos across 26 playable warriors, each wielding unique fatalities and hara-kiris. Navigate interactive multi-tiered arenas where death traps add strategic depth to every match. Experience the expansive Konquest mode, an action-RPG adventure spanning six realms where you train as Shujinko and unlock secrets. Test skills in Chess Kombat, a deadly board game fusion, or race through Puzzle Kombat's addictive gem-matching battles. Create custom fighters, master new fighting styles, and discover weapon-based combat systems. With online multiplayer, stage fatalities, and the series' darkest storyline yet, Deception delivers the most complete Mortal Kombat experience ever created.

title: Mortal Kombat: Shaolin Monks
description: Journey through Mortal Kombat's untold saga as Liu Kang and Kung Lao in this explosive action-adventure brawler. Battle through hordes of enemies using devastating combos, environmental kills, and signature fatalities in fully 3D environments. Master each warrior's unique fighting style - Liu Kang's fierce fire attacks or Kung Lao's deadly razor-hat techniques. Explore iconic realms from the Living Forest to Goro's Lair, solving puzzles and uncovering secrets. Team up with a friend in seamless co-op mode to unleash brutal tag-team fatalities and combination attacks. Experience the events following the first tournament through a dark, visceral campaign filled with boss battles against series villains. Unlock classic characters, alternate costumes, and bonus content as you progress.

title: Motocross Mania 3
description: Rev your engines for the ultimate dirt bike experience in Motocross Mania 3! Master over 40 challenging tracks across diverse environments from dusty deserts to muddy forests. Pull off insane stunts with the enhanced trick system featuring backflips, superman grabs, and heart-stopping combinations that rack up massive points. Choose from multiple game modes including Championship, Freestyle, and intense head-to-head races. Customize your rider and bike with unlockable gear and upgrades to dominate the competition. The refined physics engine delivers realistic bike handling while maintaining arcade-style fun. Weather effects and track deformation add strategic depth as conditions change mid-race. Whether you're hitting huge jumps or battling for position in tight corners, every race delivers pure adrenaline-pumping action!

title: MotoGP: Ultimate Racing Technology 2
description: Experience the ultimate motorcycle racing simulation with MotoGP: Ultimate Racing Technology 2. Master authentic MotoGP bikes from the 2002 season across 16 official circuits, feeling every bump and curve through advanced physics modeling. Push your skills to the limit with realistic bike handling that demands precise throttle control, proper racing lines, and strategic braking. Challenge legendary riders like Valentino Rossi in Career mode, climbing from rookie to champion. Fine-tune your machine with extensive customization options affecting performance and handling. Weather conditions and tire wear add strategic depth to every race. Features split-screen multiplayer for intense local competition and time trials to perfect your racing lines.

title: MotoGP: Ultimate Racing Technology 3
description: Experience the ultimate motorcycle racing simulation with MotoGP: Ultimate Racing Technology 3. Master the art of two-wheeled racing across authentic circuits featuring the complete 2005 MotoGP season roster. Feel every bump and curve through advanced physics that demand precise throttle control, strategic braking, and perfect racing lines. Choose from MotoGP, 250cc, and 125cc classes, each offering distinct handling characteristics. The revolutionary Extreme Mode transforms races into adrenaline-fueled arcade battles with boost pads and spectacular stunts. Career mode challenges you to rise from rookie to champion, managing bike development and team relationships. Weather conditions and tire wear add strategic depth to every race.

title: MTV Music Generator 3
description: MTV Music Generator 3: This Is the Remix brings professional music creation to your Xbox. Create original tracks across multiple genres including hip-hop, R&B, rock, and electronica using an extensive library of over 3000 samples, loops, and sound effects. The intuitive interface lets you layer beats, basslines, melodies, and vocals with precision timing. Record your own vocals or instrumental performances using Xbox Live headset or USB devices. Share your musical creations online and collaborate with other producers worldwide. Features music videos you can customize with visual effects synchronized to your beats. Whether you're an aspiring producer or just love making music, this powerful studio puts professional-grade tools at your fingertips. Mix, remix, and master your way to musical greatness.

title: MTX Mototrax
