description: MTX Mototrax revolutionizes motocross gaming with its groundbreaking physics engine and authentic freestyle tricks. Race through massive outdoor environments and indoor supercross arenas, pulling off insane stunts with the innovative dual-analog control system. Master over 100 real tricks from motocross legends like Travis Pastrana and Nate Adams. Create custom tracks with the robust track editor, then challenge friends in split-screen multiplayer mayhem. Career mode lets you rise from amateur to pro, upgrading your bike and gear along the way. With licensed bikes from Honda, Yamaha, and Kawasaki, plus realistic rider animations and ragdoll physics, every race feels intense and unpredictable. The game's signature feature is its fluid trick system that rewards creativity and style over simple button mashing.

title: Murakumo: Renegade Mech Pursuit
description: Pilot advanced mechs through futuristic cityscapes in this high-octane combat racer from FromSoftware. Murakumo blends lightning-fast mech combat with arcade racing as you pursue rogue AIs through sprawling urban environments. Choose from multiple customizable mechs, each with unique weapons and abilities. Dash through destructible environments, leap between buildings, and engage in intense firefights while maintaining breakneck speeds. The innovative lock-on system lets you target enemies while navigating complex 3D spaces at full throttle. Master the art of simultaneous combat and navigation as you chain together combos, dodge incoming fire, and race against time. With branching mission paths, unlockable mechs, and a pumping electronic soundtrack, Murakumo delivers a unique fusion of mech action and racing thrills that pushes your reflexes to the limit.

title: MVP 06: NCAA Baseball
description: Step up to the plate in MVP 06: NCAA Baseball, where college diamond dreams come alive! Experience the intensity of NCAA baseball with over 100 authentic Division I teams, complete with official stadiums, fight songs, and mascots. Master the innovative Load and Fire batting system that puts you in total control of your swing timing and power. Build your own baseball legend in Career Mode, starting as a freshman and working your way to the College World Series in Omaha. The deep recruiting system lets you scout and sign top high school talent to build a dynasty program. With realistic pitching mechanics, dynamic weather effects, and ESPN-style presentation, every game feels like a televised championship matchup. Whether you're turning double plays or launching grand slams, MVP 06 delivers the ultimate college baseball experience.

title: MVP Baseball 2003
description: Step up to the plate in MVP Baseball 2003, EA Sports' acclaimed baseball simulation that delivers the most authentic diamond experience. Choose from all 30 MLB teams and over 1,500 real players, each with accurate stats and signature moves. The innovative Pitcher/Batter Interface puts you in complete control, letting you paint corners with precision pitching or crush mistake pitches into the bleachers. Build dynasties in Franchise Mode spanning multiple seasons, or create your own superstar in the new Player Mode. With fluid animations, realistic ball physics, and dynamic commentary from Duane Kuiper and Mike Krukow, every at-bat feels like the real thing. Whether you're turning double plays, robbing home runs, or managing your bullpen in crucial situations, MVP Baseball 2003 captures the strategy and excitement of America's pastime.

title: MVP Baseball 2004
description: Step up to the plate in MVP Baseball 2004, where authentic Major League Baseball action meets arcade accessibility. Experience the thrill of America's pastime with all 30 MLB teams, complete rosters, and realistic stadiums faithfully recreated. The innovative Pitcher/Batter Interface puts you in control of every pitch and swing, while the Pure Swing System delivers precise batting control. Build dynasties in deep Franchise mode, develop prospects in Owner mode, or jump into quick Exhibition games. Features smooth animations, dynamic commentary from Duane Kuiper and Mike Krukow, and EA Sports' signature presentation. Whether you're turning double plays, stealing bases, or hitting grand slams, MVP Baseball 2004 captures the strategy and excitement of professional baseball with intuitive controls that welcome rookies while rewarding veterans.

title: MVP Baseball 2005
description: Step up to the plate in MVP Baseball 2005, where precision pitching meets strategic batting in the ultimate MLB experience. Take control of all 30 Major League teams with authentic rosters and stadiums from the 2005 season. Master the innovative Hitter's Eye system that reveals pitch types and locations, giving you the edge at bat. Build dynasties in Owner Mode, managing everything from concession prices to player contracts over multiple seasons. The Pure Swing system delivers unprecedented batting control, letting you pull, push, or drive the ball with realistic physics. Create custom players, design unique ballparks, and compete online against rivals worldwide. With broadcast-quality presentation featuring Duane Kuiper and Mike Krukow's commentary, every game feels like a primetime showdown.

title: MX 2002 featuring Ricky Carmichael
description: MX 2002 featuring Ricky Carmichael brings the intensity of professional motocross racing to your console with the sport's biggest star leading the charge. Race as or against Ricky Carmichael himself across authentic outdoor nationals and supercross tracks. Master realistic bike physics that demand precise throttle control and body positioning through rhythm sections, whoops, and massive jumps. Create custom tracks with the robust track editor, then share them with friends. Career mode lets you rise through amateur ranks to pro status, upgrading your bike and gear along the way. Freestyle mode showcases spectacular tricks and combos for maximum points. With responsive controls, dynamic weather effects, and aggressive AI racers, every race delivers heart-pounding motocross action.

title: MX Superfly
description: MX Superfly takes motocross gaming to new heights with its unique focus on freestyle tricks and aerial stunts. Race through diverse environments from urban rooftops to mountain peaks, pulling off insane combos with an intuitive trick system that rewards creativity and style. The game features over 20 customizable bikes and riders, each with distinct handling characteristics. Career mode lets you build your reputation through increasingly challenging events, while multiplayer competitions bring intense trick battles and racing action. Dynamic weather and time-of-day changes add variety to each session. The innovative "Superfly" meter enables gravity-defying special moves when maxed out, letting you chain together impossible stunts. With its blend of racing speed and freestyle expression, MX Superfly delivers an adrenaline-pumping experience that pushes the boundaries of motocross gaming.

title: MX Unleashed
description: MX Unleashed brings the thrill of freestyle motocross racing to life with massive open environments and gravity-defying stunts. Race through diverse tracks spanning supercross stadiums, outdoor nationals, and freestyle arenas, pulling off insane tricks to build your boost meter. The game features an innovative clutch system for precise bike control, allowing you to pre-load jumps and nail perfect landings. Customize your rider and bike with authentic gear from top MX brands, then compete in career mode to unlock new machines and venues. With rhythm sections that reward perfect timing, natural terrain racing across hills and valleys, and freestyle events where you chain combos for huge scores, MX Unleashed delivers the ultimate motocross experience. Master the physics-based handling as you battle aggressive AI riders across 40+ tracks.

title: MX vs. ATV Unleashed
description: Experience the ultimate off-road racing showdown where motocross bikes clash with ATVs across massive free-roaming environments. Race through diverse terrains from supercross stadiums to outdoor nationals, launching off towering jumps and pulling spectacular tricks with the innovative freestyle system. Choose from an extensive roster of licensed MX bikes and ATVs from top manufacturers, each with unique handling characteristics. The revolutionary Rhythm Racing captures authentic motocross flow as you master momentum through berms and whoops. Create custom tracks, compete in multiple disciplines including freestyle competitions, and explore open world environments finding hidden challenges. With intense multiplayer battles and endless customization options, this delivers pure adrenaline-fueled action.

title: MX World Tour Featuring Jamie Little
description: Experience the ultimate motocross championship as you race across diverse global locations in MX World Tour Featuring Jamie Little. Master realistic physics-based gameplay while pulling off spectacular tricks and stunts to earn boost and dominate the competition. Choose from licensed bikes and customize your rider as you progress through an extensive career mode guided by renowned motorsports broadcaster Jamie Little. Battle through challenging weather conditions and dynamic track surfaces that affect your bike's handling. Compete in multiple game modes including freestyle events where style matters as much as speed. Perfect your timing on jumps and landings to chain together combos that wow the crowd and intimidate rivals on your path to becoming world champion.

title: Myst III: Exile
description: Continue your journey through the Ages in this captivating puzzle adventure. As the Stranger, you must pursue a vengeful man named Saavedro who has stolen Atrus's newest Age meant for teaching his sons. Navigate through five stunning worlds - J'nanin, Voltaic, Edanna, Amateria, and Narayan - each filled with intricate mechanical puzzles and breathtaking environments. Piece together Saavedro's tragic past while solving complex challenges that test your observation and logic skills. The game features full 360-degree exploration, allowing you to freely examine every detail of these beautifully crafted realms. With Brad Dourif's compelling performance as Saavedro and an atmospheric soundtrack, immerse yourself in a tale of exile and redemption where every puzzle solved reveals another layer of the mystery.

title: Myst IV: Revelation
description: Journey into surreal worlds where every choice shapes destiny in this stunning fourth chapter of the legendary puzzle adventure series. As the Stranger, you must unravel the dark mystery behind Atrus's daughter Yeesha's disappearance while navigating breathtaking realms filled with intricate mechanical puzzles and ancient secrets. Explore the prison worlds of Spire and Haven, each containing one of Atrus's treacherous sons, as you piece together clues through journals, holographic recordings, and environmental storytelling. Revolutionary real-time 3D graphics bring photorealistic environments to life while Peter Gabriel's haunting soundtrack creates an unforgettable atmosphere. Master complex puzzles that blend logic, observation, and intuition as you manipulate mysterious devices and decode cryptic symbols. Your decisions determine multiple endings in this contemplative adventure where patience and perception unlock the truth.

title: NBA 2K7
description: NBA 2K7 delivers the most authentic basketball simulation with revolutionary gameplay mechanics and stunning visual presentation. Experience the thrill of the NBA with enhanced shooting controls, realistic player movements, and intelligent AI that adapts to your playing style. The innovative 24/7 mode returns, letting you create and develop your own baller through street courts and pro leagues. Challenge legends in the Association mode, build dynasties, or compete online against players worldwide. Featuring comprehensive roster updates, signature player animations, and dynamic commentary from the booth, every game feels like a broadcast event. With precise analog stick controls for dribbling and shooting, you'll pull off ankle-breaking crossovers and clutch shots just like the pros. From the squeaking sneakers to the roaring crowds, NBA 2K7 captures every detail of professional basketball.

title: N.U.D.E.@ Natural Ultimate Digital Experiment
description: Experience groundbreaking voice-controlled life simulation in this Japan-exclusive Xbox title where you educate and interact with P.A.S.S., a female humanoid robot assistant. Using the Xbox Communicator headset, teach your android companion language, tasks, and behaviors through natural voice commands in this innovative AI experiment. Watch your robot evolve from minimal functionality to a sophisticated personal assistant as you guide her development through daily interactions. The game utilizes the Xbox's internal clock for real-time progression, making your robot's growth feel authentic as days and weeks pass. Similar to Seaman's concept but with deeper interaction mechanics, you'll develop a unique relationship with your digital companion through conversation and training. This ambitious simulation pushes the boundaries of voice recognition technology, creating an intimate virtual life experience that was ahead of its time in exploring human-AI relationships.

title: Namco Museum
description: Namco Museum brings arcade history to your Xbox with a treasure trove of classic games that defined the golden age of gaming. Experience timeless titles like Pac-Man, Galaga, Dig Dug, and Pole Position in their original arcade glory. Each game features authentic graphics and sounds that transport you back to the 1980s arcade scene. Master Ms. Pac-Man's maze-running strategy, blast alien invaders in Galaxian, or test your reflexes in Rally-X. The collection includes both well-known hits and hidden gems from Namco's legendary catalog. Unlock artwork galleries, browse historical information, and discover the stories behind these influential games. With customizable display options including classic CRT filters and multiple aspect ratios, you can play these masterpieces exactly as you remember them or with modern enhancements.

title: Namco Museum 50th Anniversary
description: Celebrate five decades of arcade excellence with Namco Museum 50th Anniversary, a treasure trove of gaming history featuring 14 legendary titles that defined generations. Experience the dot-chomping frenzy of Pac-Man and Ms. Pac-Man, blast through alien armadas in Galaga and Galaxian, and race against time in Rally-X. Master the underground adventures of Dig Dug, navigate mazes in Dragon Spirit, and test your reflexes with Pole Position's high-speed racing. This collection preserves the authentic arcade experience with pixel-perfect emulation, original sounds, and responsive controls. Unlock bonus content including vintage artwork and behind-the-scenes materials as you play. Whether you're reliving childhood memories or discovering these classics for the first time, each game delivers pure, addictive gameplay that made Namco an arcade legend.

title: Narc
description: Dive into the gritty underworld of Narc, where you play as Max Force or Hit Man, two narcotics officers waging war against the drug trade. This intense arcade shooter pulls no punches with its controversial depiction of street-level crime and violence. Armed with machine guns and rocket launchers, blast through waves of dealers, junkies, and kingpins across seedy urban environments. Arrest criminals for bonus points or take the lethal approach - the choice is yours. Collect confiscated drugs and money as evidence while dodging syringes, attack dogs, and dumpster-dwelling enemies. The game's graphic violence and anti-drug message made it notorious upon release. Experience raw, unfiltered action as you fight to clean up the streets and take down the mysterious Mr. Big. With its unique arrest mechanic and unapologetically dark tone, Narc delivers a brutal, memorable shooter experience that pushed boundaries and sparked debates about violence in gaming.

title: NASCAR 06: Total Team Control
description: Take complete control of your NASCAR racing destiny in this revolutionary racing experience that puts you in command of an entire team. Master the innovative Team Control system to switch between teammates mid-race, coordinating strategic moves to block rivals and create drafting opportunities. Experience the intensity of NASCAR with authentic tracks, official drivers, and realistic damage modeling that affects your car's performance. Build your reputation through Career Mode, earning contracts with top teams as you prove your skills. Share the Driver mode lets you tag-team with friends, while Voice Recognition technology allows real-time crew communication. From Daytona to Talladega, feel the thunder of 43-car fields battling at 200mph. With dynamic AI that adapts to your style and comprehensive customization options, NASCAR 06 delivers the most strategic and authentic stock car racing experience ever created.

title: NASCAR 07
description: Experience the intensity of NASCAR racing with NASCAR 07, where strategy meets speed on America's most legendary tracks. Master the art of drafting and bump-drafting as you compete in the full Nextel Cup and Busch Series seasons. The innovative Total Team Control feature lets you build and manage your own racing dynasty, hiring crew chiefs and teammates while developing your car's performance. Feel every bump and scrape with enhanced physics that make paint-trading more realistic than ever. Challenge mode tests your skills with specific racing scenarios, while online multiplayer delivers wheel-to-wheel action against rivals worldwide. From Daytona's high banks to Bristol's tight corners, earn respect through aggressive driving or clean racing in your quest for the championship. The dynamic AI adapts to your style, creating unique rivalries that last all season long.

title: NASCAR 2005: Chase for the Cup
description: Experience the thrill of NASCAR's most intense season in NASCAR 2005: Chase for the Cup. Battle through the grueling 36-race schedule before entering the championship-deciding Chase for the Cup, where only the top 10 drivers compete for ultimate glory. Master authentic driving physics as you race wheel-to-wheel at 200mph across meticulously recreated tracks including Daytona, Talladega, and Bristol. Build rivalries through aggressive racing that carries across seasons, affecting how AI drivers race against you. Create your own legacy in Career Mode, starting in the Craftsman Truck Series and climbing to NASCAR's elite. Fine-tune setups, manage tire wear, and draft strategically to gain crucial positions in spectacular 43-car fields.

title: NASCAR Heat 2002
description: Experience the thunder of NASCAR racing in NASCAR Heat 2002, where every race puts you behind the wheel of authentic stock cars on legendary tracks. Master the art of drafting and slingshot passes as you compete against 43 aggressive AI drivers, each with unique racing styles and personalities. The game features all official NASCAR Winston Cup drivers, teams, and tracks from the 2002 season, including Daytona, Talladega, and Bristol Motor Speedway. Feel the intensity through advanced damage modeling that affects your car's handling and performance. Challenge yourself in multiple game modes including Season, Championship, and Beat the Heat challenges that test specific racing skills. Strategic pit stops for fuel and tires become crucial in longer races, while realistic physics demand precise control through high-speed turns. Build your reputation from rookie to champion as you battle for position in heart-pounding pack racing.

title: NASCAR Thunder 2002
description: Race wheel-to-wheel in NASCAR Thunder 2002, where split-second decisions separate champions from the pack. Master the art of drafting, bump drafting, and strategic pit stops across 23 authentic NASCAR tracks including Daytona, Talladega, and Bristol. Feel the intensity as you battle 43 drivers in full season mode, or jump into quick races and multiplayer showdowns. The revolutionary AI creates realistic pack racing with drivers who remember your moves and retaliate accordingly. Fine-tune your setup with detailed car adjustments, manage tire wear through grueling 500-mile races, and fight for position in the closest racing simulation of its era. Experience authentic NASCAR atmosphere with full damage modeling, realistic physics, and commentary that responds to your racing style. Every race demands perfection as you chase the championship.

title: NASCAR Thunder 2003
description: NASCAR Thunder 2003 delivers the ultimate stock car racing experience with an intense 20-year career mode where you battle from rookie to legend. Feel the thrill of 23 authentic NASCAR tracks as you trade paint with 43 licensed drivers in their real-world cars. Master the revolutionary Lightning Challenge mode featuring 36 scenario-based races pulled from actual NASCAR moments. Experience realistic damage modeling that affects performance, dynamic weather conditions, and authentic pit stop strategy. Build rivalries through aggressive driving that carries across seasons, while managing sponsor relationships and team dynamics. The enhanced physics engine captures the raw power of 750-horsepower machines drafting at 200mph. From Daytona to Talladega, every race demands split-second decisions as you fight for position in the most authentic NASCAR simulation of its era.

title: NASCAR Thunder 2004
description: Take the wheel in EA Sports' most intense NASCAR racing experience yet. NASCAR Thunder 2004 delivers authentic stock car action with all 23 official tracks and a full roster of real drivers and teams from the 2003 season. Master the revolutionary new drafting system that lets you slingshot past rivals or work with teammates to dominate the pack. Career mode spans 20 seasons as you build your reputation from rookie to legend, managing rivalries that affect on-track behavior. Experience the thrill of 200mph battles where every bump and scrape matters through realistic damage modeling. Fight for position in 43-car fields with aggressive AI that races hard but fair. Create custom setups, develop alliances, and feel the intensity of restrictor plate racing at Daytona and Talladega.

title: NBA 2K2
description: NBA 2K2 revolutionizes basketball gaming with ultra-realistic gameplay and stunning visual presentation. Experience the complete NBA atmosphere with authentic player movements, signature shots, and defensive strategies that mirror real basketball. The innovative low-post game lets you execute drop steps, hooks, and up-and-unders with precision timing. Create your own franchise dynasty, guide rookies to stardom, or jump into street basketball mode for playground action. Commentary from legendary broadcasters adds courtside authenticity while detailed player models showcase individual playing styles. Master the new defensive stance system to shut down opponents and utilize momentum-based controls for explosive dunks and acrobatic layups. With full rosters, realistic arenas, and smooth gameplay that captures the flow of professional basketball, NBA 2K2 delivers the definitive hoops experience.

title: NBA 2K3
description: NBA 2K3 delivers authentic basketball action with groundbreaking gameplay mechanics and stunning visual presentation. Experience the complete NBA atmosphere featuring all 29 teams, legendary players, and realistic arenas. The revolutionary Isomotion control system puts unprecedented ball-handling moves at your fingertips, allowing crossovers, spins, and hesitation dribbles with analog stick precision. Street mode brings playground basketball to life with unique courts and freestyle rules. Create your own player and guide them through a career from rookie to superstar. Advanced AI ensures every game feels different as players adapt to your strategies. Commentary from Kevin Harlan and Tom Tolbert adds broadcast-quality excitement. With deep franchise mode, online multiplayer support, and countless customization options, NBA 2K3 sets the standard for basketball simulation.

title: NBA 2K6
description: NBA 2K6 brings the complete basketball experience to your Xbox with stunning visuals and refined gameplay that captures the intensity of professional basketball. Execute precision passes, devastating crossovers, and thunderous dunks with the innovative Shot Stick control system that gives you unprecedented command over every offensive move. The groundbreaking 24/7 mode returns, letting you create a baller and take them from street courts to NBA stardom through challenging tournaments and pickup games. Experience the emotion with enhanced player animations and realistic crowd reactions that respond to momentum shifts. Features deep Association mode for full franchise control, online multiplayer battles, and the V.I.P. System that tracks your tendencies to create custom AI profiles. With commentary from Kevin Harlan and Kenny Smith plus authentic NBA presentation, this delivers the most immersive basketball simulation of its generation.

title: NBA Ballers
description: NBA Ballers brings streetball culture to life with intense one-on-one basketball showdowns featuring NBA superstars and legends. Create your own baller and rise through the ranks in rags-to-riches mode, earning cash to trick out your crib with luxury cars, jewelry, and exclusive gear. The game's unique presentation showcases matches in lavish backyard courts complete with DJs, crowds, and authentic street atmosphere. Pull off spectacular moves with the innovative trick stick system, from ankle-breaking crossovers to gravity-defying dunks. Face off against NBA greats like Allen Iverson, Stephon Marbury, and legends like Magic Johnson and Wilt Chamberlain. Each player features signature moves and authentic playing styles. The deep customization system lets you craft your perfect baller's appearance, skills, and attitude while the Phenom mode challenges you to become a streetball legend.

title: NBA Ballers: Phenom
description: NBA Ballers: Phenom takes streetball to the next level with its unique rags-to-riches story mode where you create a custom baller and rise from playing on local courts to competing against NBA legends. The game features intense 1-on-1 and 2-on-2 basketball battles with an emphasis on flashy moves, tricks, and over-the-top dunks that define street basketball culture. Build your player's skills through various challenges, unlock signature moves from real NBA stars, and customize everything from your appearance to your home court. The innovative "Act a Fool" meter lets you pull off spectacular combos and embarrass opponents with style. Build your army by recruiting defeated enemies, evolving Pokemon, and discovering perfect warrior-Pokemon partnerships. Experience multiple storylines featuring different warlords, each offering unique challenges and perspectives on the conflict. This innovative crossover brilliantly merges feudal Japanese warfare with Pokemon battling, creating an addictive strategy experience where every decision shapes the fate of Ransei.

title: NHL 2002
description: NHL 2002 delivers fast-paced hockey action with EA Sports' signature gameplay. Experience the complete NHL with all 30 teams, authentic arenas, and real player rosters from the 2001-02 season. The revolutionary NHL Cards system adds collectible player cards that unlock special abilities and boost team performance. Create custom plays with the PlayMaker Control feature, giving you unprecedented tactical control on the ice. Enhanced deking controls let you pull off spectacular moves to beat defenders and goalies. The game features multiple modes including Season, Playoffs, Tournament, and the deep Franchise mode where you manage every aspect of your team across multiple seasons. Dynamic camera angles and realistic player animations capture the intensity of professional hockey. Jim Hughson and Don Taylor provide authentic play-by-play commentary that reacts to the action. Build your dream team, develop strategies, and battle for the Stanley Cup in this comprehensive hockey simulation that balances arcade excitement with strategic depth.

title: NHL 2003
description: Experience the lightning-fast action of professional hockey in NHL 2003, where EA Sports delivers the most authentic ice hockey simulation of its era. Take control of all 30 NHL teams with complete rosters featuring over 900 real players, each with unique skills and playing styles. The revolutionary GameBreaker feature lets you unleash devastating special moves that can turn the tide of any match. Master the new deking system with the right analog stick for unprecedented puck control and jaw-dropping moves. Create your own dynasty in the deep Franchise Mode, managing everything from trades to the NHL Entry Draft. The game's enhanced AI provides challenging opponents that adapt to your strategies, while the refined checking and fighting mechanics deliver bone-crushing hits and intense rivalries that capture the true spirit of NHL hockey.

title: NHL 2004
description: NHL 2004 brings EA Sports' hockey excellence to Xbox with the revolutionary EA Sports Freestyle Control system, putting unprecedented stick-handling precision at your fingertips. Execute jaw-dropping dekes, saucer passes, and one-timers with intuitive right analog stick controls that mirror real hockey movements. The new Bruise Control fighting engine lets you throw punches and grapple strategically during intense on-ice brawls. Dynasty Mode spans 10 seasons where you manage everything from entry drafts to salary caps while building a championship franchise. Features authentic NHL teams, players, and arenas with commentary from Jim Hughson and Craig Simpson. Online play via Xbox Live lets you challenge opponents worldwide in ranked matches and tournaments. With enhanced graphics showcasing realistic player faces and animations, plus the hard-hitting gameplay hockey fans crave, NHL 2004 delivers the complete NHL experience.

title: NHL 2005
description: NHL 2005 brings the intensity of professional hockey to your console with refined gameplay mechanics and authentic NHL action. Experience the new Open Ice Control system that revolutionizes offensive play, allowing for precision passing and creative playmaking. The innovative Free-4-All fighting engine lets you throw down the gloves in realistic scraps that can shift momentum. Dynasty Mode returns deeper than ever, letting you build a championship franchise through drafts, trades, and salary cap management. All 30 NHL teams feature updated rosters and authentic arenas. The World Cup of Hockey mode adds international competition with national teams. Enhanced graphics showcase detailed player models and realistic ice effects. EA Sports' signature presentation includes dynamic commentary and authentic broadcast-style cameras that capture every bone-crushing check and spectacular goal.

title: NHL 2K3
description: Experience the intensity of professional hockey with NHL 2K3, where lightning-fast gameplay meets broadcast-quality presentation. Take control of all 30 NHL teams featuring authentic rosters and arenas in this acclaimed hockey simulation. The innovative ESPN presentation brings television-style commentary and camera angles that capture every bone-crushing check and spectacular goal. Master the refined control system that puts precision passing, deking, and shooting at your fingertips. Create your own franchise dynasty, trade players, and guide your team through multiple seasons toward Stanley Cup glory. Battle friends in multiplayer modes or test your skills against adaptive AI opponents. With realistic player animations, detailed player faces, and authentic team strategies, NHL 2K3 delivers the complete hockey experience on Xbox.

title: NHL 2K6
description: NHL 2K6 delivers authentic hockey action with innovative ProControl stick handling that puts unprecedented puck control at your fingertips. Experience the intensity of NHL hockey with all 30 teams and their authentic arenas, plus international squads. The revolutionary On-the-Fly Coaching system lets you adjust strategies mid-game while Enforcer Mode unleashes bone-crushing fights when tensions rise. Create your franchise dynasty, develop prospects, and manage salary caps in deep Franchise mode. The game features ESPN presentation with commentary from Bob Cole and Harry Neale, bringing broadcast-quality atmosphere to every match. Quick dekes, precision passing, and crease control mechanics create fluid gameplay that captures hockey's speed and physicality. Challenge friends in multiplayer showdowns or test your skills against aggressive AI that adapts to your play style.

title: NHL 2K7
description: NHL 2K7 brings intense hockey action to Xbox with revolutionary ProStick controls that put every deke, shot, and check at your fingertips. Experience the speed and brutality of professional hockey through enhanced graphics showcasing authentic player models and realistic arena atmospheres. The innovative Cinemotion system captures the drama with dynamic camera angles during crucial plays. Build dynasties in Franchise mode, create custom tournaments, or jump online for competitive multiplayer matches. Features include revamped fighting mechanics, on-the-fly coaching adjustments, and the Crease Control system for precise goaltending. With full NHL and AHL team rosters, authentic commentary, and responsive skating physics that reward skill and strategy, NHL 2K7 delivers the complete hockey experience. Master the ice through practice modes or dive straight into the Stanley Cup playoffs.

title: NHL Hitz 2002
description: NHL Hitz 2002 takes hockey to the extreme with explosive 3-on-3 arcade action that throws the rulebook out the window. This over-the-top sports experience features bone-crushing hits that send players flying into the glass, turbo-charged skating that leaves opponents in the dust, and spectacular goals that defy physics. Create your own franchise and build a dynasty through multiple seasons, unlocking secret teams and legendary players along the way. The game's signature "On Fire" mode rewards aggressive play, granting unlimited turbo and devastating hits when you're hot. With no penalties, no offsides, and no referee to slow down the mayhem, every match becomes a high-scoring slugfest. NHL Hitz 2002 delivers pure adrenaline-pumping hockey fun where fighting is encouraged and every hit counts.

title: NHL Hitz 2003
description: NHL Hitz 2003 brings arcade hockey mayhem to your Xbox with bone-crushing checks, turbo-charged skating, and explosive on-ice action. This isn't your typical simulation - it's 3-on-3 hockey where the rules are bent and the hits are amplified. Execute devastating body checks that send opponents flying into the glass, build up your on-fire meter for unstoppable power plays, and pull off spectacular trick shots that defy physics. Create custom teams and players, then take them through multiple game modes including the deep Franchise mode where you build a dynasty from scratch. With no penalties for aggressive play, simplified controls that anyone can master, and over-the-top commentary that captures every brutal hit, NHL Hitz 2003 delivers pure adrenaline-fueled hockey entertainment. The game features NHL teams and players with exaggerated abilities, turning every match into an unforgettable highlight reel of spectacular goals and punishing hits.

title: NHL Hitz Pro
description: NHL Hitz Pro takes the bone-crushing action of arcade hockey to new heights with its perfect blend of simulation depth and over-the-top gameplay. Experience lightning-fast 3-on-3 battles where massive hits send players flying through glass and spectacular goals light up the scoreboard. The innovative Hockey School mode teaches advanced techniques while Franchise mode lets you build a dynasty through drafts, trades, and salary management. Create custom players, unlock legendary NHL stars, and master the skill stick for precise dekes and shots. With no penalties to slow the action, every match becomes a high-scoring slugfest where timing your hits and turbo boosts means the difference between victory and defeat. The responsive controls and brutal physics engine deliver satisfying collisions that echo through arenas packed with rowdy fans. Whether playing quick exhibition games or pursuing the Stanley Cup, NHL Hitz Pro delivers pure hockey mayhem.

title: Nickelodeon Party Blast
description: Join your favorite Nickelodeon characters in the ultimate party game showdown! Nickelodeon Party Blast brings together stars from SpongeBob SquarePants, Rugrats, Hey Arnold!, The Wild Thornberrys, Rocket Power, and more in a frantic food fight competition. Battle across vibrant arenas inspired by classic Nick shows as you hurl pies, watermelons, and other wacky projectiles at opponents. Master each character's unique abilities - SpongeBob's bubble attacks, Tommy's bottle blasts, or Arnold's slingshot skills. Compete in multiple game modes including last-player-standing battles and team-based tournaments. With simple pick-up-and-play controls perfect for all ages, up to four players can join the chaos in split-screen multiplayer mayhem. Unlock bonus characters and stages as you prove you're the ultimate Nickelodeon champion!

title: NightCaster: Defeat the Darkness
description: Wield devastating magic as Arran, a young wizard on a quest to save the world from eternal darkness. Master over 40 spectacular spells across five schools of magic - Fire, Water, Light, Dark, and Physical - each with unique strengths against different enemy types. Navigate treacherous environments from frozen tundras to volcanic wastelands, solving puzzles and battling hordes of shadow creatures. The innovative dual-analog control system lets you move freely while casting spells in any direction, creating intense magical combat. Collect powerful orbs to enhance your abilities and unlock new spell combinations. Dynamic lighting effects bring your magical attacks to life as you illuminate the darkness. Face massive boss battles that test your mastery of elemental magic. This Xbox exclusive action-adventure blends strategic spellcasting with exploration.

title: NightCaster II: Equinox
description: Wield devastating magic as Arran in this action-RPG sequel that pushes Xbox's power to its limits. Master four schools of elemental magic - Fire, Water, Earth, and Shadow - each with unique spells that interact dynamically with enemies and environments. Battle through diverse realms from frozen wastelands to volcanic dungeons, facing hordes of mythical creatures and towering bosses. The innovative dual-analog spell-casting system lets you unleash combos and chain different elements for spectacular effects. Collect and combine orbs to customize your magical arsenal, unlocking powerful fusion spells. Experience enhanced graphics with real-time lighting that brings your magical attacks to life. Solo campaign offers deep progression while multiplayer modes pit wizards against each other in spell-slinging combat. NightCaster II delivers refined gameplay and darker atmosphere.

title: The Nightmare Before Christmas: Oogie's Revenge
description: Step into Jack Skellington's bones one year after the film in this action-packed adventure that brings Halloween Town to life. Master Jack's Soul Robber whip-arm to perform devastating combos and traverse the twisted landscapes of Tim Burton's beloved world. Transform into Sandy Claws to unleash present-throwing mayhem or become the terrifying Pumpkin King to rain down fiery jack-o'-lanterns on enemies. Battle through musical boss fights against Lock, Shock, Barrel and the villainous Oogie Boogie himself, with original songs expanding the film's legendary soundtrack. Explore faithfully recreated locations from Halloween Town to Christmas Town, solving puzzles and collecting souls to upgrade Jack's ghoulish abilities. This gothic hack-and-slash captures the film's dark whimsy perfectly.

title: Ninja Gaiden
description: Master ninja Ryu Hayabusa embarks on a blood-soaked quest for vengeance in this legendary action masterpiece. Experience lightning-fast combat that demands precision timing and razor-sharp reflexes as you wield an arsenal of deadly ninja weapons including the legendary Dragon Sword, shurikens, and the devastating Flying Swallow technique. Wall-run across ancient temples, execute gravity-defying acrobatic combos, and unleash devastating Ninpo magic against hordes of fiends and towering bosses. Every encounter tests your skill in this notoriously challenging adventure where split-second decisions mean the difference between victory and defeat. From the streets of Tokyo to mystical underworld realms, immerse yourself in a dark tale of honor and supernatural evil rendered in stunning detail.

title: Ninja Gaiden Black
description: Master ninja Ryu Hayabusa embarks on a blood-soaked quest for vengeance in this legendary action masterpiece. Ninja Gaiden Black delivers the most challenging and refined combat system ever created, demanding perfect timing, strategic weapon selection, and flawless execution. Wield legendary weapons including the Dragon Sword, nunchaku, and the mighty Dabilahro as you face demonic forces and rival ninja clans. Every encounter tests your skills with enemies that adapt to your tactics and punish mistakes mercilessly. This definitive edition includes all original content plus new missions, costumes, and difficulty modes. The silky-smooth 60fps gameplay ensures every counter, combo, and decapitation feels perfectly responsive. From Tokyo's neon streets to ancient temples and demon realms, experience the pinnacle of hardcore action gaming.

title: Obscure
description: Survive the nightmare at Leafmore High School where students are mysteriously disappearing. This survival horror adventure puts you in control of five teenagers, each with unique abilities - from Josh's investigative skills to Ashley's quick thinking. Switch between characters on the fly or team up with a friend in drop-in/drop-out co-op mode, a rare feature for the genre. Armed with improvised weapons and flashlights that burn through the darkness-dwelling monsters, you'll explore the sinister school grounds, solve environmental puzzles, and uncover a terrifying conspiracy. The game's light-based combat system adds strategic depth as you combine firearms with portable lamps to weaken creatures before striking. With multiple playable characters whose survival affects the story, branching paths, and unlockable content, Obscure delivers classic teen horror atmosphere reminiscent of 90s slasher films. Face your fears alone or bring a friend as you battle through this atmospheric thriller where teamwork might be your only chance of making it to dawn.

title: Oddworld: Munch's Oddysee
description: Guide Munch, the last of the amphibious Gabbits, and his unlikely ally Abe through a darkly humorous adventure to save their species from extinction. Switch between characters to utilize their unique abilities - Munch swims through underwater passages and uses his sonar to possess enemies, while Abe rescues fellow Mudokons and harnesses mystical powers. Navigate sprawling industrial facilities, lush forests, and ancient temples in this innovative 3D platformer. Solve environmental puzzles, liberate enslaved creatures, and sabotage the villainous Vykkers Labs. With oddball humor, social commentary, and the franchise's signature GameSpeak system for commanding allies, experience a quest where two misfits take on corporate greed to preserve their world's biodiversity.

title: Oddworld: Stranger's Wrath
description: In the dusty frontier of Oddworld, you are Stranger, a mysterious bounty hunter with a secret. Armed with a unique "live ammo" crossbow that fires critters as projectiles - from electric Zappflies to explosive Boombats - hunt down outlaws across sprawling Western-inspired landscapes. Switch seamlessly between third-person platforming and first-person shooting as you track dangerous criminals through ramshackle towns and untamed wilderness. Each captured bounty brings you closer to affording a life-saving operation, but your true nature threatens everything. Combining inventive combat, environmental puzzles, and Oddworld's signature dark humor, this action-adventure delivers a fresh twist on the Wild West. Lasso enemies with Bolamites, unleash swarms of Stingbees, and discover why Stranger fights to keep his identity hidden in this critically acclaimed tale of redemption and survival.

title: Open Season
description: Based on the animated film, Open Season throws you into a hilarious wilderness adventure as Boog the grizzly bear and Elliot the one-antlered mule deer. When hunting season opens, this unlikely duo must rally the forest creatures to defend their home. Switch between characters to use their unique abilities - Boog's strength for combat and puzzles, Elliot's speed for platforming challenges. Battle hunters with improvised weapons, from rabbit-launching to skunk gas attacks. Explore diverse environments from forest trails to dangerous mine shafts. Mini-games add variety including river rapids racing and food-gathering challenges. Team up in co-op mode or compete in multiplayer battles. With cartoon humor, accessible gameplay, and lovable characters, Open Season delivers family-friendly action-adventure that captures the movie's charm while creating its own wild gaming experience.

title: Operation Flashpoint: Elite
description: Experience the intensity of modern warfare in this ultra-realistic military simulation. Command squad tactics across vast battlefields where every decision matters. Switch seamlessly between infantry combat, tank warfare, helicopter piloting, and tactical command roles. Navigate sprawling islands with complete freedom - choose your approach whether stealth infiltration, coordinated assault, or armored blitzkrieg. The revolutionary AI creates dynamic battles where enemies flank, retreat, and call reinforcements. Experience authentic military operations with realistic ballistics, weapon handling, and vehicle physics. Lead your squad through branching campaign missions or create custom scenarios in the powerful mission editor. This is war without compromise.

title: Otogi: Myth of Demons
description: Step into a haunting realm where ancient Japanese mythology collides with supernatural chaos. As Raikoh, an undead warrior bound between worlds, wield mystical weapons and devastating magic to battle demonic forces threatening reality itself. Otogi delivers visceral hack-and-slash combat with a unique twist - every environment is fully destructible, letting you obliterate buildings, trees, and terrain while unleashing spectacular combos. Chain aerial attacks, master elemental spells, and unlock legendary weapons as you face colossal bosses inspired by Japanese folklore. The game's ethereal art style blends traditional aesthetics with dark fantasy, creating an otherworldly atmosphere enhanced by an orchestral score. Experience intense action where your very presence destroys the world around you.

title: Otogi 2: Immortal Warriors
description: Command legendary warriors from Japanese mythology in this stunning action game that pushes the Xbox to its limits. Wield devastating supernatural powers as you battle through ethereal realms where reality and the spirit world collide. Switch between six unique characters including the immortal Raikoh, each with distinct weapons and mystical abilities. Unleash explosive combos that shatter environments in real-time - topple pillars, destroy bridges, and use the debris as weapons. Face massive demons and corrupted spirits in fast-paced combat that rewards skill and timing. The game's distinctive art style blends traditional Japanese aesthetics with dark fantasy, creating haunting battlefields filled with cherry blossoms and ancient ruins. Master each warrior's fighting style and magical attacks to purify the land from an ancient evil threatening to consume both worlds.

title: Outlaw Golf
description: Tee off with attitude in Outlaw Golf, where irreverent humor meets addictive arcade golf gameplay. Choose from ten outrageous characters including strippers, bikers, and ex-cons, each with unique personalities and trash-talking commentary. Master challenging courses filled with creative hazards while building your composure meter - lose your cool and watch your shots go wild. Beat down your caddy to release frustration and regain focus in the innovative "Beat Down" mini-game. Unlock new clubs, balls, and outfits as you progress through tour mode. Features include multiple game modes, character-specific super shots, dynamic camera angles, and Steve Carell's hilarious commentary. This isn't your country club's golf game - it's golf with attitude, combining precise gameplay mechanics with outrageous humor and style.

title: Outlaw Golf 2
description: Tee off with attitude in Outlaw Golf 2, where rebellious characters and outrageous antics meet precision golf gameplay. Choose from ten wild personalities, each with unique abilities and trash-talking commentary that brings irreverent humor to every stroke. Master challenging courses featuring unconventional hazards and creative hole designs that push your skills to the limit. Build your composure meter by nailing perfect shots or blow off steam with the signature beatdown mini-games between holes. Customize your golfer's stats through tour mode progression, unlocking new clubs and gear. With four-player multiplayer, multiple game modes including match play and skins, plus hilarious animations and celebrations, this sequel delivers arcade-style golf action with edgy humor and addictive gameplay that keeps you coming back.

title: Outlaw Golf: 9 Holes of X-Mas
description: Take your golf game to the wild side this holiday season in Outlaw Golf: 9 Holes of X-Mas! This festive expansion delivers outrageous arcade golf action with a rebellious twist. Master nine winter-themed holes featuring snow-covered fairways, icy hazards, and holiday decorations gone wrong. Choose from the series' signature cast of unconventional characters, each bringing unique abilities and attitude to the links. Pull off insane trick shots, unleash devastating power drives, and use the Composure system to maintain your cool or psych out opponents. The game's irreverent humor shines through holiday-themed commentary and animations. Whether playing solo or competing with friends, experience golf like never before with explosive special effects, dynamic camera angles, and gameplay that rewards both skill and style.

title: Outlaw Golf: 9 More Holes of X-Mas
description: Deck the fairways with this festive expansion to Outlaw Golf! Hit the links with the wildest cast of characters ever assembled, from punk rockers to biker chicks, each bringing their own outrageous personality to the course. Master nine brand-new holiday-themed holes featuring snow-covered greens, candy cane obstacles, and Christmas decorations that'll test your skills. The signature Composure system rewards good shots while punishing mistakes with hilarious animations. Beat up your caddy to relieve stress, pull off trick shots for massive points, and unlock crazy outfits and equipment. With its edgy humor, arcade-style gameplay, and seasonal twist on traditional golf, this expansion delivers irreverent sports action that turns country club etiquette on its head. Grab your clubs and get ready for the most unconventional Christmas tournament ever!

title: Outlaw Tennis
description: Serve up attitude and anarchy in Outlaw Tennis, where underground tennis meets over-the-top arcade action. Choose from 16 outrageous characters including strippers, ex-cons, and ninjas, each with unique personalities and special moves. Build momentum to unleash devastating power shots and turbo serves that leave opponents stunned. The innovative momentum system rewards aggressive play - dominate rallies to boost your stats while crushing your rival's confidence. Fight dirty with taunts and distractions between points. Master multiple court surfaces from prison yards to nightclubs, each with distinct physics. Customize characters' skills through training mini-games. Features exhibition matches, tournaments, and multiplayer mayhem for up to 4 players. With hilarious commentary, outrageous animations, and addictive gameplay that balances arcade chaos with strategic depth, Outlaw Tennis transforms the gentleman's sport into pure irreverent entertainment.

title: Outlaw Volleyball
description: Outlaw Volleyball takes beach volleyball to the extreme with outrageous characters, intense arcade action, and a rebellious attitude. Choose from 16 unique personalities including punks, bikers, and summer school rejects, each with special moves and taunts. The innovative momentum system rewards aggressive play - dominate rallies to unleash devastating power shots and humiliate opponents. Battle across exotic courts from tropical beaches to prison yards in multiple game modes including Exhibition, Tour, and Xbox Live multiplayer. Between matches, mini-games like Beat 'Em Up let you literally fight opponents to boost stats. With responsive controls, over-the-top animations, and Steve Carell's hilarious commentary, this isn't your typical volleyball game - it's volleyball with attitude.

title: Pirates: The Legend of Black Kat
description: Set sail as the fierce pirate captain Katarina de Leon in this swashbuckling action-adventure across the mysterious Blue Caribbean. Command your ship the Wind Dancer through naval battles against rival pirates and sinister Rooke's armada. Engage in dynamic sword combat on land using combos and special moves while exploring tropical islands filled with ancient ruins and hidden treasures. Upgrade your vessel with powerful cannons and armor as you plunder enemy ships for gold. Switch seamlessly between ship-to-ship warfare and on-foot exploration as you uncover the secrets of your past and seek vengeance against those who wronged you. With voodoo magic, legendary artifacts, and a crew of colorful pirates at your side, forge your own legend on the high seas.

title: Outlaw Volleyball: Red Hot
description: Serve up attitude and action in this wildly irreverent beach volleyball game that breaks every rule! Outlaw Volleyball: Red Hot brings together a cast of outrageous characters including punk rockers, strippers, and ex-cons for matches that are anything but civilized. Master the unique momentum system where hot streaks unlock devastating power moves and fighting dirty is encouraged. Beat down opponents between points with the fighting mini-game to steal their momentum and dominate the court. Features 16 eccentric playable characters, each with unique abilities and provocative personalities. Multiple exotic venues from tropical beaches to prison yards provide the backdrop for intense 2-on-2 matches. Customizable rules, unlockable costumes, and party modes deliver endless replay value.

title: OutRun 2
description: Race through stunning coastal highways in SEGA's ultimate arcade driving experience. OutRun 2 delivers pure driving euphoria as you drift through 15 breathtaking stages spanning deserts, forests, and cityscapes at breakneck speeds. Master the art of the perfect drift with intuitive controls that reward skillful cornering and heart-stopping overtakes. Choose from eight iconic Ferraris including the F50 and Enzo, each with distinct handling characteristics. Impress your passenger with daring driving techniques in Heart Attack mode, tackle challenging missions, or compete in intense multiplayer races. With its vibrant visuals, branching routes offering multiple endings, and an unforgettable soundtrack mixing classic tunes with modern remixes, OutRun 2 captures the timeless thrill of the open road.

title: OutRun 2006: Coast 2 Coast
description: Experience the ultimate arcade racing thrill as you drift through stunning coastlines and city streets in this definitive version of SEGA's legendary racer. Choose from 15 authentic Ferraris including classics and modern supercars, then hit the accelerator across 30 breathtaking stages spanning the original OutRun 2 and SP tracks. Master the revolutionary drift mechanics to link corners and build massive scores while your passenger reacts to your driving style. Race through multiple game modes including Heart Attack mode with girlfriend challenges, Time Attack, and the expansive Coast 2 Coast mode featuring a full career progression. Feel the rush of the open road with dynamic weather, branching routes, and that signature OutRun soundtrack featuring both classic tunes and new remixes that perfectly capture the sunny, carefree spirit of the ultimate driving fantasy.

title: Over the Hedge
description: Join RJ the raccoon and his woodland friends in this action-packed adventure based on the DreamWorks animated film! Play as multiple characters including RJ, Verne the turtle, Hammy the hyperactive squirrel, and Stella the skunk, each with unique abilities. Sneak through suburban backyards, dodge lasers, outsmart exterminators, and collect food for your forest family. Switch between characters to solve puzzles and overcome obstacles - use Hammy's super speed, Verne's shell spin, or Stella's stink attack. Explore diverse environments from neighborhood homes to the exterminator's headquarters. Team up with a friend in cooperative multiplayer mode for double the mayhem. Features mini-games, unlockable content, and hilarious dialogue straight from the movie. Battle pest control gadgets, navigate treacherous lawns, and pull off daring heists in this family-friendly platformer that captures all the humor and heart of Over the Hedge!

title: Pac-Man World 2
description: Join Pac-Man on a 3D platforming adventure to save Pac-Land from the evil ghost Orson! Navigate through six unique worlds filled with challenging obstacles, hidden secrets, and classic arcade callbacks. Master Pac-Man's new moves including the Rev Roll, Butt Bounce, and Flip Kick to overcome enemies and traverse treacherous terrain. Collect fruit, rescue your kidnapped friends, and unlock bonus mazes that pay homage to the original arcade classic. Each world features distinct themes from haunted forests to volcanic mountains, with boss battles against familiar ghosts like Blinky and Clyde. Experience smooth controls, vibrant graphics, and a perfect blend of modern platforming with retro Pac-Man charm. Whether you're chomping through dots in classic mazes or exploring expansive 3D levels, Pac-Man World 2 delivers nostalgic fun with fresh gameplay mechanics that both newcomers and longtime fans will enjoy.

title: Pac-Man World 3
description: In Pac-Man World 3, the iconic yellow hero faces his greatest challenge yet as ghosts from the Spectral Realm threaten both worlds. This 3D platformer transforms Pac-Man into an acrobatic powerhouse with new moves like butt-bouncing, wall-jumping, and powerful punches. Battle through vibrant worlds filled with challenging puzzles and platforming sections while collecting pac-dots and power pellets. The game introduces an innovative twist - team up with former enemies Pinky and Clyde, each offering unique abilities to overcome obstacles. Unleash devastating special attacks, pilot giant robots, and navigate between the real world and ghostly Spectral Realm. With its blend of classic arcade elements and modern platforming mechanics, Pac-Man World 3 delivers an action-packed adventure featuring witty dialogue, varied gameplay, and epic boss battles that reimagine the Pac-Man universe.

title: Painkiller: Hell Wars
description: Unleash pure mayhem in Painkiller: Hell Wars, where you battle through the depths of Purgatory as Daniel Garner, a man trapped between Heaven and Hell. Wield devastating weapons like the iconic Painkiller spinning blade launcher and the Stake Gun that pins demons to walls. Face massive hordes of nightmarish creatures across gothic environments ranging from medieval castles to hellish realms. Collect souls from fallen enemies to transform into an invincible demon form, turning the tables on your tormentors. Experience frantic old-school FPS action with no cover mechanics or regenerating health - just pure skill and relentless combat. Master unique weapon combos, discover secret areas filled with holy artifacts, and challenge colossal boss battles that test your reflexes. Fast-paced arena combat meets dark fantasy in this adrenaline-fueled shooter that rewards aggressive play and precision aim.

title: Panzer Dragoon Orta
description: Soar through a dying world atop your armored dragon in this breathtaking rail shooter that pushes the boundaries of aerial combat. As Orta, a mysterious girl with a forgotten past, you'll unleash devastating lock-on laser attacks against waves of bio-engineered monsters and imperial forces across ten visually stunning episodes. Master three distinct dragon forms - Base, Heavy, and Glide - each offering unique combat strategies and movement speeds. Navigate through ancient ruins, vast deserts, and floating cities while your dragon evolves in real-time based on your playstyle. The game features multiple routes through levels, unlockable content including the entire original Panzer Dragoon, and a deep scoring system that rewards aggressive play and perfect runs.

title: Panzer Elite Action: Fields of Glory
description: Command massive WWII tanks across authentic European battlefields in this explosive combat experience. Choose your allegiance between American, German, or Soviet forces, each featuring unique armored divisions with distinct strengths and tactical advantages. Engage in fierce 18-mission campaigns spanning historic locations from the Normandy beaches to the frozen Eastern Front. Master realistic tank warfare with strategic crew management, precise targeting systems, and devastating artillery strikes. Experience intense multiplayer battles supporting up to 32 players online, or challenge friends in split-screen combat. Customize your tanks with authentic paint schemes and tactical upgrades. Feel the power of authentically modeled Sherman, Tiger, and T-34 tanks with realistic physics and damage modeling.

title: Pariah
description: In a war-torn future where Earth's prisoners are exiled to hostile planets, you are Jack Mason - a disgraced doctor whose routine prisoner transport mission spirals into chaos when your ship crashes. Armed with an upgradable healing tool that doubles as a weapon, survive brutal firefights across desolate wastelands and decaying urban ruins. Pariah's innovative weapon upgrade system lets you modify guns on the fly with Weapon Energy Cores, transforming basic firearms into devastating instruments of destruction. Experience visceral combat enhanced by the Havok physics engine, creating dynamic battlefield chaos where every explosion and impact feels real. Navigate treacherous environments using vehicles ranging from speedy buggies to heavily armed assault craft. Uncover a dark conspiracy as you protect Karina, a mysterious prisoner whose secrets could reshape humanity's future. Master both single-player campaign and intense multiplayer battles.

title: Peter Jackson's King Kong
description: Step into the colossal footsteps of the legendary King Kong in this cinematic action-adventure from Peter Jackson. Experience the epic story from both perspectives - play as Jack Driscoll fighting for survival on mysterious Skull Island, then unleash primal fury as Kong himself. Battle prehistoric creatures using improvised weapons and environmental tactics as Jack, switching between first and third-person combat. As Kong, rampage through intense brawls with T-Rexes and other massive beasts while protecting Ann Darrow. The game seamlessly blends survival horror, puzzle-solving, and spectacular beast battles. Stunning visuals bring 1930s New York and the dangerous island to vivid life, while an orchestral score heightens every encounter.

title: Petit Copter
description: Master the delicate art of remote-control helicopter piloting in this charming simulation that brings miniature aviation to life. Navigate tiny helicopters through detailed indoor and outdoor environments, from living rooms to backyards, where everyday objects become challenging obstacles. The game features three distinct gameplay modes that test different piloting skills: precision takeoffs and landings on designated pads, using a suction cup attachment to carefully pick up and transport objects, and target practice with puffs of air to knock down objectives. Each challenge requires mastering the sensitive controls that realistically simulate RC helicopter physics, including managing rotor speed, maintaining balance, and compensating for momentum. With its unique perspective that shrinks you down to toy size, peaceful atmosphere, and focus on skill-based challenges rather than combat, Petit Copter offers a refreshing take on flight simulation.

title: Phantasy Star Online Episode I & II
description: Enter the groundbreaking online RPG that revolutionized console multiplayer gaming. Create your hero from four unique classes - Hunter, Ranger, or Force magic users - and embark on thrilling cooperative adventures across the mysterious planet Ragol. Team up with three other players locally or via Xbox Live to battle through randomly generated dungeons filled with dangerous creatures and valuable loot. Master real-time combat combining melee weapons, ranged attacks, and devastating Technique spells. Collect and trade rare items, customize your character with hundreds of weapons and armor pieces, and tackle challenging boss battles that demand teamwork. Experience two complete episodes with distinct storylines, environments, and enemies. Join a persistent online world where your actions shape your legend.

title: Phantom Crash
description: Phantom Crash plunges you into Tokyo's underground mech combat scene, where customizable Scoobees - nimble battle mechs - clash in high-stakes arena battles. Choose from three distinct mech types, each with unique handling and combat styles, then dive deep into extensive customization options. Install optical camouflage for stealth strikes, equip devastating weapons ranging from rifles to energy swords, and fine-tune your mech's AI chip for autonomous combat support. The game's innovative day-night cycle affects both combat visibility and the bustling Shinjuku hub where you shop for parts, take on missions, and interact with rival pilots. Blending tactical mech combat with RPG elements, Phantom Crash rewards strategic loadout planning as much as reflexes. Master the art of vanishing with optical camo, then reappear to unleash destruction in this unique fusion of Japanese cyberpunk atmosphere and intense mechanical warfare.

title: Phantom Dust
description: Phantom Dust blends action, strategy, and card-battling in a post-apocalyptic world where humanity lives underground after a mysterious dust destroyed civilization. You play as an amnesiac warrior with psychic powers, building arsenals from over 300 unique skills that act as your attacks, defenses, and special abilities. Combat unfolds in real-time arenas where you collect skill orbs scattered across destructible environments, then unleash devastating combos mixing melee strikes, projectiles, shields, and environmental manipulation. The deep deck-building system lets you craft specialized loadouts for different playstyles - rush down opponents with aggressive close-range builds or control the battlefield with defensive strategies. Single-player missions reveal the dark mystery behind humanity's downfall while multiplayer battles test your tactical prowess against other psychic warriors.

title: Pinball Hall of Fame
description: Pinball Hall of Fame brings seven classic Williams pinball tables to life with stunning accuracy and physics. Experience legendary machines like Black Knight, Firepower, and Funhouse, each lovingly recreated with authentic sound effects, music, and table art. Master the nuances of each table's unique mechanics - from multiball mayhem to skill shots and bonus rounds. The game features multiple camera angles to follow the action, detailed ball physics that capture the feel of real pinball, and a progression system that unlocks new tables and challenges. Tournament mode lets you compete for high scores across all tables, while multiplayer supports up to four players taking turns. Whether you're a pinball wizard or newcomer, this collection preserves the golden age of arcade pinball with tables that defined generations of players.

title: Pirates of the Caribbean
description: Set sail for adventure in this swashbuckling action game based on the hit film! Play as Captain Jack Sparrow, wielding sword and pistol through Caribbean islands teeming with danger. Master fluid sword combat with combos, blocks, and special moves while battling cursed pirates and the Royal Navy. Explore lush tropical environments from Port Royal to mysterious caves, discovering hidden treasures and secret paths. The game features ship-to-ship naval battles where you command the Black Pearl, firing cannons and outmaneuvering enemy vessels. Upgrade Jack's abilities, unlock new combos, and collect legendary pirate artifacts. With its cinematic presentation, authentic movie locations, and Johnny Depp's likeness, this adventure captures the film's supernatural thrills and humor while delivering engaging hack-and-slash gameplay.

title: Pitfall: The Lost Expedition
description: Join fearless explorer Pitfall Harry on his most ambitious adventure yet in this thrilling 3D platformer that reinvents the classic franchise. Swing across treacherous chasms with your trusty vine, battle fierce jungle creatures, and navigate ancient temple traps as you search for the legendary Lost Expedition. Master Harry's acrobatic moves including wall-running, rolling attacks, and spectacular vine-swinging combos. Explore vast interconnected environments from lush rainforests to mysterious underground caverns, each filled with hidden treasures and secret paths. Collect ancient artifacts, unlock new abilities, and face off against massive boss creatures. With its blend of exploration, puzzle-solving, and heart-pounding action, this expedition delivers classic adventure gaming with modern polish.

title: Playboy: The Mansion
description: Build the Playboy empire from the ground up in this unique lifestyle simulation game. As Hugh Hefner himself, you manage the iconic Playboy Mansion, throwing lavish parties to attract celebrities, models, and journalists. Develop relationships through conversation mini-games, discovering what makes each character tick. Publish your magazine by securing exclusive content, arranging photo shoots, and interviewing stars. Design and furnish your mansion with hundreds of items while managing staff and facilities. Balance business with pleasure as you network, romance, and negotiate deals. Mix strategy with social simulation as you cultivate the Playboy brand, unlock centerfold models, and create the ultimate bachelor pad. Every decision shapes your empire's success and reputation.

title: PocketBike Racer
description: Tear up the track in this quirky arcade racer featuring miniature motorcycles and outrageous speed! PocketBike Racer delivers hilarious high-octane action as you race souped-up pocket bikes through unconventional environments including grocery stores, construction sites, and backyard BBQs. Choose from multiple riders and customize your tiny ride for maximum performance. Master powerslides around shopping aisles, jump over lawn furniture, and dodge everyday obstacles while battling for first place. With arcade-style controls, split-screen multiplayer, and a unique Burger King tie-in that made this Xbox exclusive a cult classic, this bite-sized racer serves up surprisingly addictive gameplay that proves big thrills come in small packages.

title: Pool Shark 2
description: Experience the ultimate billiards simulation in Pool Shark 2, where precision meets competition. Master the art of cue sports across multiple game modes including 8-ball, 9-ball, and straight pool. The advanced physics engine delivers realistic ball movement and authentic table dynamics, making every shot count. Challenge yourself in career mode, climbing from local pool halls to championship tournaments, or test your skills against friends in multiplayer matches. Customize your cue stick, unlock new venues from dingy bars to prestigious clubs, and perfect your technique with intuitive aiming controls. Whether you're banking shots off the rails or setting up complex combinations, Pool Shark 2 captures the strategy and excitement of real pool with stunning 3D graphics and smooth gameplay that rewards both casual players and serious enthusiasts.

title: Powerdrome
description: Blast through futuristic circuits at breakneck speeds in this high-octane remake of the 1988 classic racing game. Powerdrome delivers intense hover-racing action where gravity-defying blade runners tear through neon-lit tracks filled with deadly obstacles and aggressive competitors. Master the art of high-speed combat as you deploy weapons and defensive shields while navigating treacherous courses that twist through industrial complexes and alien landscapes. Choose from multiple racing crafts, each with unique handling characteristics and upgrade potential. Experience single-player championships, split-screen multiplayer mayhem, and online competition via Xbox Live (now playable through Insignia servers). The game's distinctive visual style combines sleek vehicle designs with atmospheric environments that blur past at incredible velocities. With its blend of pure racing skill and tactical combat, Powerdrome resurrects a retro-futuristic vision of competitive racing.

title: Predator: Concrete Jungle
description: In Predator: Concrete Jungle, you become the ultimate alien hunter in a dark cyberpunk future. After a failed hunt in 1930s New Concrete City, you return 100 years later to a dystopian metropolis ruled by warring mob families who've weaponized your own technology. Master the Predator's legendary arsenal including plasma cannons, wrist blades, smart discs, and cloaking technology as you reclaim your honor through brutal melee combat and stealth kills. Leap across rooftops, use thermal and alien vision modes to track prey, and unleash devastating combos in visceral third-person action. Upgrade your weapons and abilities while hunting both human gangs and deadly Xenomorphs. Experience an original storyline that expands Predator lore as you face off against crime bosses, cyborg enemies, and even other Predators in your quest for redemption and revenge.

title: Prince of Persia: The Sands of Time
description: Wield the power of time itself in this legendary action-adventure that redefined the Prince of Persia series. As the Prince, navigate treacherous palace environments filled with deadly traps, rotating blades, and crumbling platforms. Master acrobatic wall-running, death-defying leaps, and fluid combat against sand creatures that threaten ancient Persia. The revolutionary Dagger of Time lets you rewind mistakes, slow down reality, and freeze enemies in their tracks. Partner with the mysterious princess Farah to solve intricate puzzles and overcome impossible odds. With its groundbreaking parkour movement system, cinematic storytelling, and innovative time manipulation mechanics, The Sands of Time delivers an unforgettable journey through mystical Arabian landscapes where every second counts.

title: Prince of Persia: The Two Thrones
description: Return to Babylon as the Prince faces his darkest chapter yet. After preventing the Sands of Time catastrophe, the Prince discovers his kingdom conquered and must battle through war-torn streets using two distinct personas. Master the acrobatic Prince's fluid combat and platforming alongside his savage Dark Prince alter-ego, who wields deadly chain-whip attacks and feeds on the Sands to survive. Experience revolutionary speed kill mechanics that reward precise timing with instant stealth takedowns. Navigate crumbling palaces, deadly traps, and vertical cityscapes while managing the internal struggle between light and dark. The climactic finale of the Sands trilogy delivers intense chariot races, massive boss battles, and a deeply personal story of redemption as the Prince confronts both external enemies and his inner demons.

title: Prince of Persia: Warrior Within
description: The Prince returns in this darker, grittier sequel that transforms the fairy-tale hero into a hardened warrior. Hunted by the unstoppable Dahaka for disrupting time's flow, you must journey to the Island of Time to prevent the Sands' creation. Master an evolved free-form fighting system combining devastating combos, dual-wielding, and environmental kills. Wall-run across crumbling fortresses, swing from ledges, and navigate deadly traps in stunning acrobatic sequences. The revolutionary time-manipulation powers let you rewind mistakes, slow combat, and create tactical advantages. Face fierce enemies including sand creatures and the relentless Dahaka itself. Choose between multiple endings based on your actions. With its mature tone, brutal combat, heavy metal soundtrack, and complex level design mixing past and present timelines, Warrior Within delivers an intense action-adventure experience.

title: Prisoner of War
description: Step into the boots of Captain Lewis Stone, an American pilot shot down and captured during WWII. Prisoner of War delivers a unique stealth-escape experience where cunning beats combat. Plan daring breakouts from authentic German POW camps including Colditz Castle. Study guard patterns, forge documents, steal uniforms, and coordinate with fellow prisoners to execute complex escape plans. The game emphasizes strategy over action - you'll need to maintain your cover, attend roll calls, and avoid suspicion while secretly gathering tools and intelligence. Each camp presents increasingly challenging security measures and layouts based on real historical locations. Multiple escape routes reward creative thinking and careful observation. Experience the tension of living under constant surveillance while plotting your freedom in this atmospheric WWII thriller that captures the ingenuity and determination of real POWs.

title: Pro Evolution Soccer 4
description: Pro Evolution Soccer 4 revolutionizes football gaming with its refined gameplay engine and unparalleled ball physics. Experience the beautiful game through fluid player animations and intelligent AI that adapts to your tactics. Master the expanded Master League mode, guide your team from obscurity to glory, and negotiate transfers in the enhanced market system. The game features officially licensed teams and stadiums, bringing authentic atmosphere to every match. Revolutionary free kick and penalty systems demand precision and skill, while improved dribbling mechanics let you weave through defenses with style. Weather conditions and pitch deterioration affect gameplay, adding strategic depth. With responsive controls that reward timing and technique over button mashing, PES 4 delivers the most realistic football simulation of its generation, capturing the sport's tactical nuance and dramatic moments.

title: Pro Evolution Soccer 5
