Experience intense third-person combat as you battle through apocalyptic wastelands and war-torn cities, wielding devastating weapons from shotguns to plasma rifles. Commandeer vehicles including motorcycles, trucks, and even futuristic Hunter-Killers in explosive chase sequences. The game seamlessly blends on-foot action with vehicular combat across diverse environments spanning present-day Los Angeles to the nightmare future of 2032. Upgrade your combat systems, unleash brutal hand-to-hand takedowns, and use your enhanced targeting to eliminate threats. Face off against iconic enemies including the deadly T-X and armies of Skynet machines in this action-packed adaptation that expands beyond the film's storyline.

title: Test Drive
description: Test Drive puts you behind the wheel of the world's most exotic supercars for the ultimate high-stakes racing experience. Choose from legendary machines like the Ferrari Testarossa, Lamborghini Countach, and Porsche 911 Turbo, then push them to their limits on treacherous mountain roads. This isn't just about speed - it's about survival. Police patrol these winding highways, ready to pull you over for reckless driving. Navigate hairpin turns, dodge oncoming traffic, and outrun the law while maintaining breakneck speeds. The revolutionary cockpit view places you directly in the driver's seat, complete with functional dashboard gauges and realistic handling physics that capture each car's unique personality. Risk it all in this groundbreaking racer that defined the exotic car genre.

title: Test Drive: Eve of Destruction
description: Test Drive: Eve of Destruction unleashes pure vehicular mayhem with its intense demolition derby action. Smash, crash, and obliterate your way through over 25 heart-pounding events including figure-8 races, suicide races, and brutal demolition derbies. Choose from 30+ customizable vehicles ranging from hearses to school buses, each with unique handling and destruction physics. The revolutionary damage modeling ensures every impact counts as parts fly off and cars crumple realistically. Race through diverse environments from county fairgrounds to industrial complexes while dodging obstacles and rival drivers hell-bent on your destruction. With split-screen multiplayer, you and friends can experience the chaos together in this ultimate festival of automotive annihilation.

title: Test Drive: Off-Road Wide Open
description: Test Drive: Off-Road Wide Open unleashes pure off-road racing chaos across massive open environments. Tear through deserts, forests, and snow-covered mountains in licensed trucks, SUVs, and dune buggies from Hummer, Dodge, Jeep, and more. Master diverse terrain with realistic vehicle physics as you compete in checkpoint races, circuit challenges, and freestyle events. The completely open world design lets you carve your own path between objectives, discovering shortcuts and hidden areas. Multiplayer split-screen action brings competitive thrills as you battle friends across sprawling landscapes. Dynamic weather and day/night cycles transform racing conditions on the fly. With extensive vehicle customization, brutal crashes, and freedom to explore wherever you want, this delivers the ultimate off-road experience.

title: Tetris Worlds
description: Tetris Worlds revolutionizes the classic puzzle phenomenon with six unique variations across exotic alien worlds. Master traditional Marathon mode or explore new twists like Sticky Tetris, where blocks fuse together, and Hot-Line Tetris, rewarding only high-altitude line clears. Square Tetris introduces a challenging 4x4 block while Cascade mode lets pieces fall naturally after line clears, creating explosive chain reactions. Journey through story mode to help the Minos evacuate their doomed planet by completing Tetris challenges. Each world features distinct visual themes and atmospheric music that evolves with your performance. Supporting up to four players in competitive multiplayer battles, the game offers infinite replay value with adjustable difficulty and speed settings. Experience the addictive block-dropping action that started it all, now enhanced with smooth controls, ghost pieces for precision placement, and the revolutionary infinite spin feature.

title: Thief: Deadly Shadows
description: Master thief Garrett returns in this atmospheric stealth adventure that revolutionized the genre with its groundbreaking light and shadow mechanics. Slip through the City's twisted streets, picking pockets and infiltrating heavily guarded mansions while avoiding detection. Use water arrows to douse torches, moss arrows to silence footsteps, and an arsenal of clever tools to outwit guards and supernatural foes. The revolutionary third-person perspective lets you peek around corners and climb walls with newfound agility. Navigate between warring factions while uncovering an ancient conspiracy that threatens the balance of power. Every shadow becomes your ally as you choose between ghosting past enemies unseen or striking from darkness with lethal precision.

title: The Thing
description: Based on John Carpenter's terrifying film, The Thing plunges you into Antarctic paranoia where trust becomes your deadliest enemy. As U.S. Special Forces captain Blake, investigate Outpost 31's horrific aftermath while battling shape-shifting alien organisms that perfectly mimic human form. Revolutionary squad-based mechanics demand careful team management - any soldier could be infected. Use flamethrowers and blood tests to expose hidden threats while fear and mistrust tear your team apart. Dynamic trust/fear system affects NPC behavior as paranoia spreads through your ranks. Combine strategic combat with psychological horror as you face grotesque boss transformations. Atmospheric environments recreate the film's claustrophobic dread. Every ally is a potential enemy in this masterful blend of action and survival horror.

title: Thrillville
description: Build and manage the ultimate theme park in Thrillville, where you're both the architect and the star attraction! Design thrilling roller coasters, place exciting rides, and customize every aspect of your park to keep visitors happy. But running a park isn't just about construction - jump into the action by playing your own midway games, racing go-karts, and even riding the coasters you create. Complete missions, manage staff, and keep guests entertained while fending off rival park owners trying to sabotage your success. With over 100 customizable attractions, 34 playable minigames, and the ability to interact directly with guests, Thrillville blends tycoon-style management with hands-on fun. Whether you're designing death-defying coasters or chatting with visitors to boost happiness ratings, every decision shapes your park's destiny.

title: Tiger Woods PGA Tour 06
description: Master the links with Tiger Woods PGA Tour 06, where precision meets power in the ultimate golf simulation. Create your golfer and rise through the ranks using the innovative Game Face technology for unprecedented customization. Perfect your swing with the analog stick control system that captures every nuance of real golf, from draws and fades to punch shots and flops. Compete across legendary courses including Pebble Beach, St Andrews, and TPC Sawgrass in stunning detail. Challenge Tiger Woods himself or take on rivals in online tournaments. The new Rival Mode pits you against golf's greatest in intense one-on-one battles throughout history. With improved ball physics, dynamic weather conditions, and the pressure-packed Tiger Challenge, every round demands strategy and skill.

title: Tiger Woods PGA Tour 07
description: Take your golf game to the next level with Tiger Woods PGA Tour 07, featuring the revolutionary True Aiming system that delivers authentic ball physics and shot shaping control. Master 21 championship courses including TPC Boston and Carnoustie, competing against 50 PGA Tour pros and LPGA stars. The innovative Team Tour mode lets you build and manage your own four-player squad through season-long competitions. Shape every shot with enhanced analog swing mechanics, adjusting draw, fade, and trajectory with precision. Experience dynamic weather conditions and course deterioration that affect gameplay throughout tournaments. From arcade-style mini-games to simulation depth, this edition offers the most comprehensive golf experience with improved graphics, realistic crowd reactions, and Tiger's signature championship moments.

title: Tiger Woods PGA Tour 2003
description: Step onto the tee box with Tiger Woods PGA Tour 2003 and experience the most realistic golf simulation of its era. Master your swing with the innovative analog stick control system that lets you shape every shot with precision. Battle through 13 meticulously recreated PGA Tour courses including Pebble Beach and St Andrews, each presenting unique challenges and stunning visuals. Create your golfer and rise through the ranks in Career Mode, earning sponsorships and unlocking equipment as you compete against Tiger and other pros. Test your skills in multiple game modes from traditional stroke play to intense skins matches. With enhanced ball physics, dynamic weather conditions, and the pressure of tournament golf, every round demands strategy and skill.

title: Tiger Woods PGA Tour 2004
description: Step onto the tee box in Tiger Woods PGA Tour 2004, where precision meets power in the ultimate golf simulation. Master the revolutionary Total Precision Swing system that puts complete control over your shots - from drives to delicate putts. Create your golfer and rise through the ranks in Career Mode, competing against Tiger and 16 other PGA Tour pros across 20 stunning courses including Pebble Beach and St Andrews. Experience Game Face technology for unprecedented character customization, while Real-Time Events deliver dynamic weather and course conditions that challenge every round. Unlock legendary golfers, earn sponsorships, and perfect your skills in practice modes. With refined analog stick controls and authentic broadcast presentation, this delivers the most immersive golf experience on Xbox.

title: Tiger Woods PGA Tour 2005
description: Experience the pinnacle of golf simulation with Tiger Woods PGA Tour 2005, featuring the revolutionary Tiger Proofing course design system that lets you reshape legendary courses to your vision. Master the all-new TigerZone where time slows for perfect shot execution, and feel every swing with the innovative analog stick Total Precision Swing. Challenge Tiger Woods himself through his entire career in the deep Legend Tour mode, or compete online against players worldwide. With 15 championship courses including Pebble Beach and St Andrews, plus Create-a-Golfer with unprecedented customization options, this delivers the most authentic PGA Tour experience. Real-time weather effects and dynamic crowds react to every shot as you battle through tournaments.

title: TimeSplitters 2
description: TimeSplitters 2 delivers chaotic first-person shooting across multiple time periods in this beloved cult classic. Battle through ten distinct eras from the Wild West to cyberpunk futures, each with unique weapons and challenges. The game's signature arcade-style action emphasizes pure fun over realism, featuring frantic firefights, creative weaponry, and the series' trademark humor. Create custom maps and game modes with the robust MapMaker, then test them in split-screen multiplayer supporting up to four players. Challenge friends across diverse modes including Deathmatch, Capture the Bag, and bizarre mini-games like Monkey Curling. With over 120 playable characters ranging from robots to zombies, plus unlockable cheats and arcade leagues, TimeSplitters 2 offers endless replayability and remains a pinnacle of couch co-op gaming.

title: TimeSplitters: Future Perfect
description: TimeSplitters: Future Perfect delivers chaotic first-person shooting across multiple time periods as Sergeant Cortez battles through history to prevent humanity's extinction. Team up in split-screen co-op through the entire campaign, blasting through gothic castles, Cold War bases, and futuristic cities. Create custom maps with the robust MapMaker, then battle friends in 4-player split-screen across 16 multiplayer modes including Capture the Bag and Virus. Play as over 150 bizarre characters from robots to zombies to monkeys. The signature arcade-style gameplay features dual-wielding weapons, temporal uplinks that let you fight alongside your future self, and humor-filled cutscenes. With challenge modes, arcade league tournaments, and endless customization options, this time-traveling adventure offers limitless replay value.

title: TMNT: Mutant Melee
description: Battle through chaotic 3D arenas in this cel-shaded Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles fighting game that brings the heroes in a half shell to life with vibrant comic book visuals. Choose from Leonardo, Donatello, Michelangelo, Raphael, and unlockable characters including Casey Jones, Splinter, and Shredder across multiple game modes. Master each fighter's unique moves and combos in the story-driven Adventure mode, or dive into intense multiplayer mayhem supporting up to four players simultaneously. Destroy interactive environments, use weapons scattered throughout levels, and unleash devastating special attacks. Features include Last Man Standing battles, King of the Hill matches, and tournament modes that test your ninja skills to the limit.

title: TOCA Race Driver
description: TOCA Race Driver revolutionizes racing games with its groundbreaking story-driven career mode. You play as Ryan McKane, a rising driver seeking glory while uncovering the truth behind your father's fatal crash. Experience intense wheel-to-wheel racing across 42 real-world circuits in 13 global championships, from DTM to V8 Supercars. Master over 40 licensed vehicles including touring cars, GT sportscars, and open-wheelers. The innovative damage system affects handling and performance, forcing tactical decisions about pit stops. Rivalries with AI drivers persist across races, creating personal vendettas on track. Dynamic weather and authentic physics deliver unmatched realism. Build your reputation through 35 story chapters featuring professional voice acting and cinematic cutscenes that blur the line between racing and drama.

title: TOCA Race Driver 2
description: TOCA Race Driver 2 delivers the ultimate racing career experience with an immersive story mode that puts you in the driver's seat of professional motorsport. Race across 15 different motorsport disciplines including rallying, GT, touring cars, street racing, and open-wheel championships. Master over 35 meticulously detailed tracks from famous circuits like Brands Hatch to street courses in cities worldwide. The innovative narrative-driven career mode follows your rise from rookie to racing legend, complete with rivalries, team politics, and high-stakes championship battles. With over 40 licensed cars from manufacturers like Ford, Alfa Romeo, and Nissan, each vehicle handles distinctively with realistic physics. Online multiplayer supports up to 12 players for intense wheel-to-wheel competition.

title: TOCA Race Driver 3
description: TOCA Race Driver 3 delivers the ultimate motorsport experience with over 35 different racing styles packed into one massive game. From DTM and V8 Supercars to rallying, GT racing, and open-wheel championships, master diverse disciplines across 80 licensed circuits worldwide. The innovative World Tour mode takes you on a globe-trotting career through professional motorsport, while Pro Career mode lets you specialize in your favorite racing series. With 70 licensed cars, realistic damage modeling, and dynamic weather conditions, every race demands different skills and strategies. Online multiplayer for up to 12 players extends the competition beyond the single-player campaigns. This is motorsport variety at its finest.

title: ToeJam & Earl III: Mission to Earth
description: The funkiest aliens in the galaxy return for their grooviest adventure yet! ToeJam & Earl III brings the beloved duo back to Earth in a hilarious 3D platformer packed with outrageous humor and funky beats. Play as ToeJam, Earl, or newcomer Latisha as you explore twelve massive levels filled with crazy Earthlings, from possessed cows to deranged dentists. Collect presents containing wild power-ups like rocket skates and spring shoes while searching for the stolen Sacred Albums of Funk. Team up with a friend in split-screen co-op to double the chaos! Master each character's unique abilities - ToeJam's speed, Earl's strength, or Latisha's special moves. With randomly generated levels ensuring every playthrough feels fresh, funky mini-games, and a soundtrack that'll have you grooving, this interstellar adventure delivers pure comedic mayhem. Get ready to funk up Earth and save the universe with style!

title: Tom and Jerry in War of the Whiskers
description: Unleash cartoon chaos in this wild 3D fighting game featuring everyone's favorite cat-and-mouse duo! Choose from Tom, Jerry, and a roster of classic MGM cartoon characters including Spike, Tyke, and Butch. Battle across interactive environments pulled straight from the animated series - from the familiar house kitchen to a haunted castle and even outer space. Master each character's unique moves and signature weapons like mallets, dynamite, and frying pans. Destructible environments let you use everything as a weapon while dodging falling anvils and explosive surprises. With 4-player multiplayer mayhem, unlockable characters and costumes, plus multiple game modes including single-player challenges, this brawler captures the slapstick spirit of the timeless cartoons in frantic, fun-filled fights.

title: Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon
description: Lead an elite squad of Green Berets through intense tactical combat in Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon. Command your fireteam across vast open battlefields where one bullet means death. Plan your approach carefully - use stealth, suppressing fire, and flanking maneuvers to outmaneuver enemy forces. Switch between squad members on the fly, each with specialized weapons and skills. Experience realistic military tactics where patience and planning triumph over run-and-gun action. From dense jungles to urban warzones, every mission demands precise coordination and split-second decisions. With permadeath for fallen soldiers and dynamic AI that adapts to your tactics, Ghost Recon delivers unforgiving strategic warfare where every choice matters.

title: Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon 2
description: Lead the elite Ghosts special forces unit through intense tactical combat in this military shooter sequel. Set in 2011 North Korea, you command your squad using advanced battlefield technology and authentic weaponry. The innovative lone wolf mode lets you break from your team for solo infiltration missions, while the revamped command system gives you unprecedented control over squad tactics and positioning. Experience visceral third-person action with over-the-shoulder aiming that brings you closer to the firefights. Coordinate strikes, call in air support, and utilize cutting-edge military gear including drones and satellite intel. Multiplayer modes deliver strategic team-based warfare across diverse maps. With its blend of tactical planning and explosive combat, Ghost Recon 2 revolutionizes squad-based military action.

title: Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon 2: Summit Strike
description: Step into the boots of elite Ghost soldier Scott Mitchell in this tactical military shooter set in Kazakhstan's volatile borderlands. Summit Strike delivers intense squad-based combat where strategy trumps firepower. Command your Ghost team through 11 challenging missions, utilizing advanced weaponry and cutting-edge military tech to neutralize rogue Pakistani forces threatening regional stability. The innovative Cross-Com system lets you coordinate strikes, mark targets, and share intel in real-time. Choose your approach - go loud with overwhelming force or infiltrate silently using night vision and suppressed weapons. Dynamic weather and terrain affect tactics, while robust multiplayer modes offer cooperative campaigns and competitive battles. Master the art of modern warfare where every decision counts and teamwork ensures survival.

title: Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon Advanced Warfighter
description: Lead an elite squad of Ghost soldiers through the war-torn streets of Mexico City in this tactical shooter that redefined modern warfare gaming. As Captain Scott Mitchell, command your team using cutting-edge technology including the Cross-Com system that provides real-time battlefield intelligence and drone reconnaissance. Execute precision strikes, coordinate squad movements, and adapt tactics on the fly as you face a rebel uprising threatening North American security. The innovative cover system and squad command interface let you orchestrate complex firefights while managing multiple objectives. Experience intense urban combat across destructible environments where every decision matters. With its blend of strategic planning and visceral action, Advanced Warfighter delivers the ultimate special forces experience that rewards tactical thinking over run-and-gun gameplay.

title: Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon: Island Thunder
description: Step into the boots of an elite U.S. Army Green Beret in this tactical shooter expansion that takes the Ghost Recon squad to Cuba in 2010. Lead your specialized team through eight intense missions as you work to stabilize a nation on the brink of chaos after Castro's death. Command your squad with precise tactical controls, switching between soldiers to leverage their unique skills. Experience realistic combat where one bullet can be fatal, demanding careful planning and stealth over run-and-gun tactics. Navigate diverse Cuban environments from urban streets to dense jungles, using advanced military technology including night vision and thermal imaging. Coordinate synchronized attacks, set up ambushes, and adapt your strategy on the fly. With enhanced multiplayer modes and the innovative voice command system on Xbox, Island Thunder delivers authentic special forces action where tactics triumph over firepower.

title: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six 3
description: Lead Team Rainbow through intense counter-terrorism operations in Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six 3. Command an elite squad of operatives as you infiltrate enemy strongholds, rescue hostages, and neutralize global threats. Experience revolutionary tactical gameplay where planning and precision matter more than firepower. Use voice commands to direct your AI teammates through coordinated breaches, flanking maneuvers, and synchronized assaults. Every mission demands strategic thinking as you choose equipment, plan entry points, and adapt to dynamic situations. With realistic damage modeling, one bullet can be fatal, making stealth and tactics essential. Navigate through diverse environments from oil rigs to penthouse suites, using thermal vision and heartbeat sensors to gain the edge. The acclaimed Xbox Live multiplayer delivers intense competitive matches where teamwork determines victory.

title: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six 3: Black Arrow
description: Deploy with Team Rainbow in this tactical expansion to Rainbow Six 3. Lead elite counter-terrorism operatives through ten intense new missions across Mediterranean and Eastern European theaters. Master split-second decision-making as you breach doors, clear rooms, and neutralize threats with precise coordination. Command your AI squad with enhanced voice controls, issuing complex tactical orders on the fly. Experience refined gameplay mechanics including new weapons, equipment, and improved enemy AI that adapts to your strategies. Engage in explosive multiplayer battles across exclusive maps designed for competitive play. Every mission demands perfect planning and flawless execution as you combat global terrorism. Black Arrow delivers the ultimate tactical shooter experience where teamwork, strategy, and precision determine success.

title: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six: Critical Hour
description: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six: Critical Hour delivers intense tactical counter-terrorism action as you lead Team Rainbow through seven pulse-pounding missions spanning the unit's storied history. Experience the evolution of Rainbow Six through recreated classic operations from previous games alongside new scenarios. Command your squad through meticulously planned assaults, coordinating breach points, flashbangs, and synchronized takedowns. The innovative motion-captured combat system brings unprecedented realism to close-quarters battles. Choose from 18 elite operators, each with specialized skills and equipment. Master both single-player campaigns and split-screen cooperative modes where teamwork determines survival. Every decision matters as you neutralize threats across diverse environments from urban centers to remote compounds.

title: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six: Lockdown
description: Lead Team Rainbow through intense tactical counter-terrorism operations in this gripping squad-based shooter. Command elite operatives across global hotspots from Algeria to the Caribbean, executing precision strikes against a deadly terrorist network. Experience refined gameplay with the new Persistent Elite Creation system, allowing you to develop and customize your operative's skills and equipment loadout. Master advanced tactical mechanics including fluid cover systems, breaching charges, and coordinated team movements. Deploy cutting-edge gadgets like motion sensors and snake cameras to gain the tactical edge. Engage in explosive multiplayer battles across multiple game modes, or tackle the challenging story campaign featuring fully voiced cinematics and branching mission paths.

title: Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell
description: Master the art of stealth as Sam Fisher, an elite NSA operative armed with cutting-edge gadgets and lethal skills. Infiltrate terrorist strongholds using revolutionary light and shadow mechanics that redefined stealth gaming. Split jump between walls, rappel from ceilings, and strike from darkness with precision. Your night vision goggles pierce the shadows while thermal imaging reveals hidden enemies. Choose your approach: slip past guards undetected, interrogate enemies for intel, or eliminate threats with silent takedowns. Every mission demands tactical thinking as you hack computers, pick locks, and use sticky cameras to scout ahead. With dynamic AI that reacts to sound and movement, one mistake could blow your cover. Experience the tension of operating behind enemy lines where patience and planning triumph over firepower. Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell delivers unmatched stealth action.

title: Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell: Chaos Theory
description: Master the art of stealth as elite agent Sam Fisher in the most refined entry of the Splinter Cell series. Execute missions across global hotspots using revolutionary gameplay mechanics including the knife for close-quarters combat, enhanced athletic moves for navigation, and the iconic multi-vision goggles. Choose your approach: ghost through levels undetected, use non-lethal takedowns, or eliminate threats with precision. The dynamic sound meter and light detection system create unparalleled tactical depth. Experience the critically acclaimed co-op campaign featuring unique missions designed for two operatives. With multiple paths through each level, customizable loadouts, and the series' best multiplayer mode Spies vs Mercs, Chaos Theory delivers the ultimate stealth action experience where every shadow matters.

title: Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell: Double Agent
description: Live the ultimate double life as elite operative Sam Fisher, infiltrating a terrorist organization from within. Navigate the razor's edge between maintaining your cover and completing NSA objectives in this revolutionary stealth thriller. Every choice carries weight - save innocent lives or preserve your alias, use lethal force or stay in the shadows. Experience two interconnected campaigns with branching storylines shaped by your decisions. Master innovative gameplay mechanics including ice climbing, underwater infiltration, and high-tech gadgets. Tension peaks as you balance trust meters between the NSA and terrorists, where one wrong move exposes your true identity. Featuring stunning environments from Shanghai skyscrapers to frozen wastelands, Double Agent redefines espionage gaming with moral complexity and consequences that ripple through every mission.

title: Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell: Pandora Tomorrow
description: Return to the shadows as Sam Fisher in this stealth masterpiece sequel. Master the art of espionage across exotic locations from Indonesia to Jerusalem as you hunt a deadly virus threatening millions. Pandora Tomorrow revolutionizes stealth action with dynamic lighting that makes every shadow your ally or enemy. Use split jumps, SWAT turns, and whistle lures to outsmart guards. Deploy sticky cameras, shockers, and your iconic multi-vision goggles to gather intel undetected. The groundbreaking multiplayer pits nimble spies against heavily-armed mercenaries in tense cat-and-mouse battles. Choose your path through each mission - ghost through unseen, use non-lethal takedowns, or eliminate threats with precision. Your choices shape the outcome as global tensions escalate.

title: Tomb Raider: Legend
description: Lara Croft returns in a breathtaking adventure that redefines the Tomb Raider legacy. Explore exotic locations from Bolivia to Japan as you uncover the truth behind Lara's past and the mysterious artifact that killed her mother. Master acrobatic moves with fluid controls that let you swing across chasms, scale sheer cliffs, and engage in thrilling combat. Use Lara's magnetic grapple to manipulate environments and solve intricate physics-based puzzles. Experience stunning visuals across ancient ruins, modern cities, and forgotten tombs. The game features intense motorcycle sequences, challenging boss battles, and a gripping story that weaves mythology with personal drama. Legend marks Lara's triumphant return with refined gameplay mechanics and cinematic presentation.

title: Tony Hawk's American Wasteland
description: Tony Hawk's American Wasteland revolutionizes skateboarding with the first truly open world in the series. Explore a massive, living Los Angeles without loading screens, from Hollywood to Santa Monica. Create your own skate punk legend as you build the ultimate skate park in Beverly Hills. The innovative BMX mode lets you switch between skateboard and bike on the fly, opening new trick possibilities and exploration options. Master the new Bert slides, Natas spins, and expanded manual combinations. The deep story mode follows your journey from nobody to skating legend, while Classic mode delivers pure arcade action. Customize everything from your character's look to the tricks themselves. Experience the raw energy of punk culture with an authentic soundtrack featuring punk legends and underground bands.

title: Tony Hawk's Project 8
description: Tony Hawk's Project 8 revolutionizes skateboarding with its groundbreaking Nail the Trick system, letting you control your board with analog sticks mid-air for unprecedented trick customization. As an amateur skater, prove yourself worthy of joining Tony Hawk's elite Project 8 team by conquering challenges across a massive, fully connected city. Experience seamless gameplay as you skate from suburbs to downtown without loading screens. Master classic and all-new tricks, build custom skate parks, and compete in intense competitions. The enhanced physics engine delivers the most realistic skating experience yet, while motion capture from pro skaters ensures authentic animations. Rise through the ranks from nobody to skating legend in this ambitious entry that pushes the boundaries of what's possible on a skateboard.

title: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 2x
description: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 2x delivers the ultimate skateboarding experience exclusively on Xbox. Combining levels from both THPS1 and THPS2 plus five massive exclusive environments, this enhanced collection features improved graphics and smoother gameplay. Pull off insane combos with the revolutionary manual system, linking tricks across entire levels. Create custom skaters and design your own skate parks with the robust editor. Master over 100 tricks with responsive controls while skating as Tony Hawk or other pro legends. Explore sprawling levels hunting for secret tapes, hitting high scores, and completing challenging objectives. The killer soundtrack featuring punk, hip-hop and rock perfectly complements the rebellious skating culture. Xbox-exclusive content and enhanced visuals make this the definitive Tony Hawk experience.

title: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 3
description: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 3 revolutionizes skateboarding gaming with the introduction of the revert, allowing seamless combo linking between vert and street tricks. Create your own skater or play as Tony Hawk and other pro legends across massive levels including Los Angeles, Canada, and Tokyo. The Create-A-Park editor lets you build custom skateparks with endless possibilities. Master over 100 tricks, from kickflips to 900s, while exploring secret areas and completing challenging objectives. Online multiplayer brings competitive modes like Trick Attack and Graffiti. The stellar soundtrack featuring hip-hop, punk, and rock perfectly captures skateboarding culture. With improved graphics, tighter controls, and addictive gameplay that rewards creativity and skill, THPS3 stands as the definitive skateboarding experience that defined a generation of extreme sports gaming.

title: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 4
description: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 4 revolutionizes skateboarding with open-ended career mode gameplay. Explore massive levels at your own pace without time limits, completing goals and challenges when you choose. Create devastating combos linking manuals, reverts, and spine transfers across interconnected areas. Master the enhanced trick system featuring flatland tricks, skitching behind vehicles, and the ability to dismount your board. Compete in mini-games like tennis and baseball using your skateboard. Design custom skaters and parks with the deepest editor yet. Experience unique pro-specific challenges for legends like Tony Hawk, Bob Burnquist, and Bam Margera. The refined physics engine delivers the most realistic skateboarding experience, rewarding creativity and skill in equal measure.

title: Tony Hawk's Underground
description: Tony Hawk's Underground revolutionizes skateboarding with its story-driven campaign where you rise from street amateur to pro legend. Create your custom skater and explore massive open-world levels from New Jersey to Moscow, seamlessly transitioning between skating and walking to discover hidden areas. The game introduces groundbreaking off-board exploration, letting you climb ladders, drive vehicles, and interact with the environment like never before. Master the new wallplant moves and spine transfers while building your trick arsenal. Design custom goals, share created parks online, and experience the most authentic skateboarding journey with real pro skaters. Choose your path to fame through sponsors, contests, and video parts in this genre-defining extreme sports adventure.

title: Tony Hawk's Underground 2
description: Tony Hawk's Underground 2 unleashes skateboarding mayhem as you join Tony Hawk and Bam Margera on the ultimate road trip - the World Destruction Tour. Create chaos across seven massive levels spanning the globe from Barcelona to New Orleans. The revolutionary Story Mode follows your custom skater through outrageous challenges and pranks, while Classic Mode brings back the addictive two-minute runs. Master an expanded trick system featuring new moves like the Sticker Slap and wall-pushing mechanics. Build and share custom parks with the enhanced Create-a-Park editor. Choose from a massive roster of pro skaters and unlockable legends. Experience multiplayer madness with new modes and online play. This sequel perfects the formula with its irreverent humor, punk soundtrack, and endless freestyle possibilities.

title: Top Gear RPM Tuning
description: Rev your engines and dive into the underground street racing scene with Top Gear RPM Tuning! This adrenaline-pumping racer puts you behind the wheel of 26 licensed high-performance vehicles from legendary manufacturers. Master the art of precision tuning as you customize every aspect of your ride - from engine modifications and nitrous systems to visual upgrades that make your car truly yours. Race through diverse urban environments across multiple game modes including Circuit, Drag Racing, and Time Attack. Challenge rivals in intense one-on-one battles or compete in championship tournaments to prove your dominance. The advanced physics engine delivers realistic handling that rewards skilled drivers who perfect their racing lines and braking points. Build your reputation, unlock new parts, and transform street machines into unbeatable racing legends!

title: Top Spin
description: Top Spin revolutionizes tennis gaming with its innovative Risk Shot system, letting you attempt spectacular winners that can swing momentum in crucial moments. Create your own player and climb from amateur courts to Grand Slam glory in the deep career mode, developing your skills and style along the way. Face off against 16 real tennis stars including Lleyton Hewitt, Andy Roddick, and Anna Kournikova across meticulously recreated venues from Roland Garros to Wimbledon. The precise analog stick control delivers unmatched shot placement and spin variety, while the dynamic AI adapts to your playstyle. Master baseline rallies, perfect your serve-and-volley game, or develop crushing topspin shots. With fluid animations, TV-style presentation, and multiplayer tournaments for up to 4 players, Top Spin serves up the most authentic and addictive tennis experience on Xbox.

title: Torino 2006
description: Experience the thrill of the XX Olympic Winter Games in Torino 2006, the official video game of the 2006 Winter Olympics. Compete in eight authentic Olympic events including alpine skiing, ski jumping, speed skating, and bobsled across stunning recreations of actual Turin venues. Master precise timing and control as you race down treacherous slopes, launch off massive ski jumps, and navigate high-speed ice tracks. Choose from 24 national teams and customize your athlete's appearance and equipment. The innovative control system captures the nuance of each sport, from carving perfect turns in the slalom to maintaining balance during aerial tricks. Multiplayer modes let you challenge friends locally in heated competition for gold medal glory.

title: Tork: Prehistoric Punk
description: Travel through time as Tork, a caveboy who can transform into powerful prehistoric creatures! This action-platformer sends you on an epic quest across diverse time periods to rescue your village from an evil shaman. Master Tork's unique shape-shifting abilities - become a swift velociraptor to speed through levels, a mighty mammoth to smash obstacles, or a soaring pterodactyl to reach new heights. Each transformation grants special powers essential for solving environmental puzzles and defeating enemies. Explore lush jungles, frozen wastelands, and mysterious ruins filled with collectibles and secrets. With vibrant cartoon graphics, creative level design, and innovative transformation mechanics, Tork delivers a prehistoric adventure where evolution is your greatest weapon!

title: Total Club Manager 2004
description: Take complete control of your football club in this comprehensive management simulation. Build your squad through shrewd transfers and youth development while managing tactics, training, and team morale. Navigate the complexities of club finances, stadium improvements, and board expectations as you guide your team from lower divisions to championship glory. Features deep tactical customization with formation editors, individual player instructions, and match-day strategy adjustments. Handle press conferences, player negotiations, and staff appointments while dealing with injuries, suspensions, and form fluctuations. Experience authentic league structures across multiple countries with realistic transfer windows and competition rules. Watch matches unfold in 2D or text commentary as your tactical decisions play out in real-time. Balance short-term success with long-term sustainability as you build a dynasty from the ground up in this immersive football management experience.

title: Total Club Manager 2005
description: Take control of your favorite football club in this comprehensive management simulation. Build your squad through shrewd transfers and youth development while managing tactics, training, and team morale. Experience the pressure of match days with detailed 3D match engine showcasing your tactical decisions in action. Navigate board expectations, handle press conferences, and balance the books as you guide your team from obscurity to glory. Features extensive database of real players and teams across multiple leagues, in-depth tactical systems, and realistic transfer markets. Deal with injuries, suspensions, and player personalities while developing your managerial reputation. Create custom formations, set individual player instructions, and watch your strategic vision unfold on the pitch. Whether rebuilding a fallen giant or taking non-league minnows to the top flight, every decision shapes your club's destiny in this addictive football management experience.

title: Total Immersion Racing
description: Experience authentic motorsport across three prestigious racing classes in Total Immersion Racing. Start your career in GT cars, progress through powerful GTS machines, and ultimately master PRO prototype racers on both real-world circuits and imaginative tracks. Four difficulty levels from Amateur to Extreme ensure both newcomers and veterans find their perfect challenge. Build your reputation through Career mode, climbing from entry-level GT to championship glory in prototype racing while unlocking new vehicles and circuits. Perfect your racing lines in Time Trial, tackling any unlocked track to shave precious seconds off your best laps. Conquer 37 unique challenges across five categories including GT, GTS, PRO, Manufacturer, and grueling Endurance events. Race single events from one to twenty-five laps with dynamic day/evening lighting on most tracks. This comprehensive racing simulation delivers varied motorsport disciplines with challenging AI that adapts to your skill level.

title: Total Overdose
description: Total Overdose delivers an explosive cocktail of Mexican-styled mayhem and over-the-top action. Play as Ramiro Cruz, an ex-convict infiltrating a drug cartel to avenge his father's death and save his brother. Master the art of "Loco Moves" - spectacular slow-motion gunplay combos that let you dive through the air with dual pistols blazing, perform wall-runs while shooting, and execute devastating special attacks. The game blends Max Payne-style bullet-time with Robert Rodriguez film aesthetics, featuring a vibrant Mexican setting filled with Day of the Dead imagery. Drive lowriders through dusty border towns, engage in wild shootouts in cantinas, and chain together stylish kills for massive score multipliers. With its unique scoring system, replay value comes from perfecting your combos and discovering new ways to dispatch enemies with flair.

title: Totaled!
description: Unleash automotive destruction in Totaled!, the intense demolition racing game where survival is optional but carnage is guaranteed. Race through 18 brutal tracks across diverse environments from dusty desert arenas to rain-slicked city streets, each designed to maximize vehicular mayhem. Choose from 12 customizable cars and engage in multiple game modes including traditional racing, last-man-standing demolition derbies, and the chaotic Bomb Tag. The revolutionary damage modeling system realistically deforms your vehicle with every impact - watch hoods crumple, doors fly off, and engines smoke as you battle through the pack. Chain together devastating combo attacks to earn nitro boosts while navigating through explosive obstacles and environmental hazards. With responsive arcade handling that rewards both speed and strategic ramming, every race becomes a white-knuckle battle for supremacy where finishing first means nothing if you can't finish at all.

title: Toxic Grind
description: Survive a twisted futuristic game show on your BMX in Toxic Grind, the only extreme sports game with a narrative storyline. Navigate through 11 deadly levels filled with obstacles and challenges as contestants compete for their lives in this dystopian spectacle. Execute vert tricks, grinds, and wallrides while chaining combos to unlock powerful adrenaline tricks that boost your score and chances of survival. The Underground story mode sends you through missions to unlock new stages, while Arcade offers free play and Pro Circuit tests your skills across multiple levels for the best average score. Master the control scheme using hops, loop tricks, and holds to navigate treacherous environments. Multiplayer modes include Quick Draw score races, Turf War territory battles, and Tug of War point-stealing competitions. Despite mixed reception for its ambitious story integration, this unique BMX experience dares to blend extreme sports with narrative drama.

title: TransWorld Snowboarding
description: Experience the ultimate snowboarding rush in TransWorld Snowboarding, where authentic riding meets arcade thrills. Carve through massive open mountain environments featuring real-world locations like Whistler and Aspen. Pull off insane tricks across halfpipes, rails, and natural terrain with an intuitive control system that rewards creativity. Choose from top pro riders including Todd Richards and Peter Line, each with unique styles and signature moves. The game's innovative "Respect" system tracks your reputation as you complete challenges and film video parts. Dynamic weather and snow conditions affect your runs, while the stellar soundtrack from punk and hip-hop artists fuels your sessions. Master everything from technical rail grinds to massive backcountry jumps in this defining snowboarding experience.

title: Transworld Surf
description: Carve massive waves and pull off insane aerial tricks in Transworld Surf, the extreme surfing game that brings the world's best breaks to your Xbox. Choose from 13 pro surfers including Taj Burrow, Andy Irons, and Shane Dorian as you tackle legendary surf spots from Pipeline to Teahupoo. Master the innovative control system that lets you perform authentic maneuvers like floaters, snaps, and massive airs while reading the wave to find the perfect barrel. Build up your karma meter by landing combos and riding deep in the green room to unlock special moves and hidden content. Experience dynamic water physics that create unique waves every session, ensuring no two rides are the same. With multiple game modes including Pro Tour, Free Surf, and multiplayer competitions, plus a killer soundtrack featuring punk and surf rock, Transworld Surf delivers the ultimate virtual surfing experience.

title: Trigger Man
description: Step into the shadowy underworld as a mob enforcer in this gritty third-person shooter. Navigate through seedy urban environments including warehouses, docks, and casino districts while carrying out hits for the Coladangelo crime family. Use stealth tactics to get close to targets or go in guns blazing with an arsenal of authentic weapons. The game features a unique "whack meter" that rewards clean, professional kills. Face off against rival gangs, crooked cops, and betrayers within your own family across eight intense missions. Strategic gameplay emphasizes positioning and timing - every bullet counts when you're outnumbered. Experience the dark atmosphere of organized crime with a noir-inspired visual style and moody soundtrack that captures the tension of mob life.

title: Triple Play 2002
description: Step up to the plate in EA Sports' Triple Play 2002, where arcade-style baseball action meets authentic MLB gameplay. Experience the thrill of America's pastime with all 30 MLB teams and real player rosters from the 2001 season. The revolutionary Big Play Control system puts you in command of spectacular diving catches, wall-climbing grabs, and game-saving double plays. Create custom players and franchises in the deep Season and Dynasty modes, or jump into quick exhibition matches. Featuring smooth animations, realistic stadiums, and dynamic commentary from Jim Hughson and Buck Martinez, Triple Play 2002 delivers accessible yet strategic baseball. Master the intuitive pitching and batting mechanics that balance arcade fun with simulation depth. Whether you're stealing bases, turning double plays, or launching home runs into the stands, every moment captures the excitement of Major League Baseball.

title: Trivial Pursuit: Unhinged
description: Test your knowledge in this wildly unconventional take on the classic trivia game! Trivial Pursuit: Unhinged transforms the beloved board game into a raucous party experience with outrageous questions, hilarious wrong answers, and zany mini-games. Choose from multiple game modes including Classic, Unhinged, and Quick Play. Battle through six twisted categories featuring pop culture, bizarre facts, and laugh-out-loud content. The game features full voice acting, animated hosts, and special "Unhinged" rounds where wrong answers earn bonus points. Challenge friends in local multiplayer for up to 6 players or tackle solo mode. With thousands of questions ranging from genuinely educational to completely absurd, every game delivers fresh surprises and memorable moments.

title: Tron 2.0: Killer App
description: Enter the digital frontier in this action-packed fusion of first-person shooting and light cycle racing. As Jet Bradley, son of ENCOM programmer Alan Bradley, you're accidentally digitized into a corrupted computer world threatened by viral infection. Wield iconic disc weapons and energy rods while battling through neon-lit cyberspace environments filled with hostile programs and security protocols. Experience thrilling light cycle battles on the Game Grid, upgrade your abilities through subroutine customization, and uncover a conspiracy that threatens both digital and real worlds. This Xbox exclusive edition features enhanced multiplayer modes including disc combat arenas and expanded light cycle races, plus bonus campaign missions not found in the PC version.

title: True Crime: New York City
description: Take on the mean streets of New York City as Marcus Reed, a gang member turned cop seeking redemption. This gritty open-world action game lets you explore a massive recreation of Manhattan, from Times Square to Chinatown. Fight crime your way - go by the book as a good cop or bend the rules using intimidation and excessive force. Your choices affect your karma and the story's outcome. Commandeer any vehicle, from police cruisers to motorcycles, as you chase down criminals through authentic NYC neighborhoods. Master martial arts combat, precise gunplay, and street fighting techniques. Interrogate suspects, collect evidence, and solve cases while navigating corruption within the NYPD. With branching storylines, multiple endings, and the freedom to explore the city that never sleeps, True Crime: New York City delivers raw urban action where every choice matters.

title: True Crime: Streets of LA
description: Step into the shoes of rogue cop Nick Kang as he dispenses his own brand of justice on the mean streets of Los Angeles. This open-world action game blends driving, shooting, and martial arts combat across a massive recreation of LA spanning 240 square miles. Choose your path through branching storylines where your actions determine whether you're a good cop or bad cop. Engage in high-speed pursuits through real LA neighborhoods, master brutal hand-to-hand combat with multiple fighting styles, and wield an arsenal of weapons in intense shootouts. Random street crimes keep the action unpredictable between story missions. With its pioneering GPS-accurate city map, dynamic karma system, and Hollywood-caliber voice acting featuring Christopher Walken, True Crime delivers a gritty crime saga where every choice shapes your destiny as LA's most controversial detective.

title: Turok: Evolution
description: Step into the boots of Tal'Set, a Native American warrior thrust into the savage Lost Land where dinosaurs rule and danger lurks at every turn. Turok: Evolution delivers intense first-person combat as you battle through prehistoric jungles wielding an arsenal of primitive and futuristic weapons. Switch seamlessly between stealth tactics and all-out warfare, using everything from traditional bows to devastating plasma cannons. Experience heart-pounding aerial missions on armed Quetzalcoatlus pterosaurs, engage in brutal hand-to-hand combat, and navigate treacherous environments filled with deadly traps. The game's unique Rage mode transforms you into a berserker warrior capable of devastating melee attacks. With expansive levels encouraging exploration and multiple paths to victory, every playthrough offers fresh tactical opportunities in this primal struggle for survival.

title: Ty the Tasmanian Tiger
description: Join Ty, a Tasmanian Tiger raised by bilbies, on his quest to save his family from the Dreamtime! This classic 3D platformer brings the Australian Outback to life with vibrant landscapes filled with rainforests, beaches, and billabongs. Master Ty's arsenal of trick boomerangs - from the Frostyrang that freezes enemies to the Flamerang that lights torches. Collect Thunder Eggs to unlock new worlds, rescue your fellow Tasmanian Tigers trapped in magical talismans, and battle the evil cassowary Boss Cass and his minions. Glide through the air, swim underwater caves, and ride wild animals across expansive levels packed with hidden collectibles. With its charming Aussie humor, colorful cast of native animals, and smooth platforming action, Ty delivers a uniquely Down Under adventure perfect for all ages.

title: Ty the Tasmanian Tiger 2: Bush Rescue
description: Join Ty the Tasmanian Tiger in this action-packed 3D platformer sequel! Battle the evil Boss Cass and his minions across the Australian Outback using an arsenal of upgraded boomerangs, including the explosive Kaboomerang and the searing Flamerang. Drive powerful Bush Rescue vehicles - race in the fourbie, soar in the helicopter, and swim in the submarine through diverse missions. Explore a vast hub world connecting multiple themed zones filled with collectibles and secrets. Team up with the Bush Rescue crew to save Southern Rivers from mechanical menace. Features enhanced combat mechanics, vehicle-based gameplay, and multiplayer mini-games. This Aussie adventure delivers humor, heart, and boomerang-slinging action for all ages!

title: Ty the Tasmanian Tiger 3: Night of the Quinkan
description: Join Ty and his mates in their biggest adventure yet as they battle the ancient Quinkan threat terrorizing the Australian Outback! This action-platformer combines classic 3D platforming with exciting mech combat as you pilot the powerful Shadow Bunyip through intense boss battles. Explore a vast open world filled with diverse environments from sprawling deserts to lush rainforests. Master Ty's signature boomerangs alongside new weapons like the Lasharang and Doom Rang. Team up with friends in cooperative multiplayer modes or compete in thrilling cart racing challenges. Collect Thunder Eggs, complete missions for the citizens of Burramudgee, and unlock new abilities as you fight to save Southern Rivers from the nightmarish Quinkan invasion in this family-friendly Australian adventure!

title: UEFA Champions League 2004-2005
description: Experience the pinnacle of European club football in UEFA Champions League 2004-2005. Take control of elite teams from across the continent as you battle through authentic group stages and knockout rounds to lift the coveted trophy. The game features official licenses for all participating clubs, complete with real player names, authentic kits, and meticulously recreated stadiums. Master the tactical depth with advanced team management options, formation adjustments, and strategic substitutions. The refined gameplay engine delivers responsive controls and realistic ball physics, while the dynamic camera system captures every crucial moment. Challenge friends in multiplayer modes or test your skills against intelligent AI opponents that adapt to your playing style.

title: UEFA Euro 2004
description: Experience the passion and glory of Europe's premier football tournament in UEFA Euro 2004. Take control of any of the 51 national teams and guide them through qualifying rounds to the finals in Portugal. Feel the intensity with authentic stadiums, official match balls, and real player likenesses. The innovative new shooting system gives you precise control over every strike, while improved passing mechanics let you thread balls through the tightest defenses. Build momentum with the new confidence system where player morale affects performance on the pitch. Create custom tournaments, relive classic Euro moments in scenario mode, or jump into quick matches. With comprehensive team and player statistics, authentic chants, and commentary that captures the tournament atmosphere, this is football at its finest.

title: UFC: Tapout
description: UFC: Tapout brings the brutal world of mixed martial arts to Xbox with intense, no-holds-barred fighting action. Step into the Octagon as one of over 25 real UFC fighters, each with authentic fighting styles and signature moves. Master the deep grappling system that revolutionizes ground combat - execute submissions, reversals, and devastating ground-and-pound techniques with intuitive controls. The innovative stamina system forces strategic thinking as fighters tire realistically throughout matches. Create your own fighter and rise through the ranks in Career Mode, training specific skills and earning sponsorships. Multiple game modes include Tournament, Exhibition, and the challenging Arcade Mode. Realistic damage modeling shows cuts, bruises, and swelling as fights progress. Experience the most authentic UFC presentation with official rules, referee stoppages, and commentary that captures the excitement of live events.

title: UFC: Tapout 2
description: UFC: Tapout 2 delivers the most authentic mixed martial arts experience on Xbox, featuring over 25 real UFC fighters across multiple weight classes. Master the ground game with an innovative grappling system that captures the chess match of submissions and reversals. Strike with precision using the responsive standing combat mechanics, throwing devastating combos, kicks, and clinch attacks. Create your own fighter and rise through the ranks in Career Mode, training specific skills and developing your unique fighting style. Quick fights, tournaments, and arcade modes offer instant action, while the deep simulation engine ensures no two fights feel the same. With motion-captured animations from real fighters and commentary that reacts to the action, every bout feels like a genuine UFC event. Step into the Octagon and prove you have what it takes to become the ultimate champion in this definitive MMA fighting experience.

title: Ultimate Beach Soccer
description: Take beach soccer to the extreme in Ultimate Beach Soccer, where sun-soaked sands meet intense arcade football action. Master spectacular bicycle kicks, diving headers, and gravity-defying volleys as you compete across exotic beach locations worldwide. Control international teams in fast-paced 4v4 matches where the smaller pitch and softer surface create non-stop action and incredible trick shots. Execute skill moves with intuitive controls, build up combo multipliers for showboating plays, and unleash powerful special shots that leave trails of sand in their wake. Dynamic weather changes from blazing sunshine to tropical storms add strategic depth to matches. Challenge friends in multiplayer tournaments or conquer the world tour mode, unlocking new beaches, customization options, and legendary players. With its vibrant visuals, energetic soundtrack, and pure arcade gameplay, Ultimate Beach Soccer delivers the ultimate fusion of football skills and beach party atmosphere.

title: Ultimate Pro Pinball
description: Experience the most realistic pinball simulation ever created in Ultimate Pro Pinball. This collection delivers four meticulously crafted tables with physics so authentic you'll forget you're playing a video game. Every flipper response, ball spin, and table tilt mirrors real-world pinball mechanics with stunning precision. Master complex multiball modes, discover hidden bonuses, and chase high scores across diverse themed tables including the sci-fi epic Timeshock and the horror-themed Web. Advanced camera angles let you view the action from multiple perspectives while dynamic lighting and reflections create an immersive arcade atmosphere. With adjustable difficulty settings and extensive operator menus, customize every aspect of gameplay to match your skill level.

title: Ultimate Spider-Man
description: Experience the ultimate comic book adventure as you play both hero and villain in Ultimate Spider-Man. Web-swing through a vibrant cel-shaded Manhattan as Spider-Man, using acrobatic combat and web-based attacks to protect the city. Then unleash chaos as Venom, Spider-Man's deadly nemesis, with devastating tentacle attacks and superhuman strength. The game brings Brian Michael Bendis's acclaimed Ultimate Spider-Man comic series to life with an original story that fits seamlessly into the comics' continuity. Free-roam exploration lets you discover hidden tokens and complete side missions across a detailed recreation of New York City. Switch between both characters' unique gameplay styles - Spider-Man's agile web-slinging and combo-heavy fighting versus Venom's brutal, feeding-based combat system that requires consuming enemies to survive.

title: Ultra Bust-a-Move
description: Ultra Bust-a-Move brings the beloved bubble-popping puzzle action to Xbox with vibrant 3D graphics and addictive gameplay. Match three or more colored bubbles by shooting them from your launcher to clear the screen before they reach the bottom. This enhanced version features multiple game modes including classic Puzzle mode with hundreds of levels, frantic Versus battles against CPU or friends, and the strategic Challenge mode with unique objectives. New power-ups like rainbow bubbles and bomb bubbles add explosive variety to the traditional formula. The game includes colorful characters from the Bubble Bobble universe, each with special abilities that change your strategy. With precise analog stick aiming, combo systems for high scores, and unlockable content, Ultra Bust-a-Move delivers hours of bubble-bursting fun for puzzle fans of all skill levels.

title: Unreal Championship
description: Unreal Championship brings the legendary Unreal Tournament experience exclusively to Xbox, delivering intense arena combat designed specifically for console gaming. Battle across exotic alien worlds in fast-paced multiplayer matches supporting up to 16 players via Xbox Live or system link. Master devastating weapons from the Flak Cannon to the Lightning Gun while competing in classic game modes including Deathmatch, Capture the Flag, Double Domination, and the strategic new Bombing Run. The game features refined controls optimized for gamepad play, making circle-strafing and precision aiming feel natural. Choose from unique species like the Anubans, Juggernauts, and Nightmares, each with distinct abilities that affect gameplay. Dynamic arenas filled with jump pads, teleporters, and environmental hazards keep matches unpredictable and exciting.

title: Unreal Championship 2: The Liandri Conflict
description: Unreal Championship 2: The Liandri Conflict revolutionizes arena combat by blending intense first-person shooting with visceral third-person melee battles. Switch seamlessly between perspectives as you unleash devastating combos with energy swords, staffs, and hammers, then leap back to rain destruction with classic Unreal weaponry. Choose from unique warriors, each with distinct fighting styles and special abilities like teleportation, cloaking, or berserker rage. Master the acrobatic movement system featuring wall jumps, ledge grabs, and aerial dodges to outmaneuver opponents across deadly arenas. Experience the Ascension Rites campaign following Anubis's quest for honor, or dominate in multiplayer modes including Nali Slaughter, Overdose, and Capture the Flag. This Xbox exclusive delivers the ultimate gladiatorial spectacle.

title: Unreal II: The Awakening
description: Step into the boots of John Dalton, an ex-Marine turned Marshal patrolling the lawless frontier of space. Unreal II: The Awakening delivers intense single-player FPS action across exotic alien worlds as you investigate attacks on human colonies. Wield an arsenal of devastating weapons including the iconic flamethrower, rocket launcher, and the powerful Dispersion Pistol. Battle diverse alien races from the aggressive Skaarj to the mysterious Arakni, each with unique AI behaviors and tactics. Experience stunning visuals powered by the Unreal Engine with vast outdoor environments and detailed interiors. Command your crew aboard the spaceship Atlantis between missions, upgrading weapons and planning your next move. With epic boss battles, tactical combat scenarios, and a gripping sci-fi narrative about ancient artifacts that could reshape the galaxy, this standalone adventure expands the Unreal universe in bold new directions.

title: Urban Chaos: Riot Response
description: Take to the streets as Nick Mason, leader of the elite T-Zero riot response unit, in this intense first-person tactical shooter. Battle through a city torn apart by gang warfare, using riot shields for mobile cover and non-lethal weapons alongside deadly force. Issue commands to firefighters and medics while earning medals for restraint or brutality. The innovative shield mechanics let you bash through enemies, protect civilians, and coordinate with emergency services. Face off against the vicious Burners gang using unique equipment like tasers, riot guns, and molotov cocktails. Each mission presents moral choices between maximum force and protecting innocents, with a reactive scoring system that rewards your approach. Experience visceral urban combat where every decision shapes the city's fate.

title: The Urbz: Sims in the City
description: Build your reputation and rule the city in The Urbz: Sims in the City, where street cred is everything. Create your unique Urb and navigate diverse districts from the artsy Foundry to the glamorous Diamond Heights. Master social interactions through new conversation games, learn district-specific skills like graffiti art and DJ mixing, and climb the social ladder by impressing local celebrities. Customize your pad with unlockable furniture, rock exclusive fashion styles unique to each area, and experience dynamic day-night cycles that transform the city's vibe. Unlike traditional Sims games, success here isn't about careers or families—it's about becoming the ultimate urban legend through style, skills, and social dominance.

title: V-Rally 3
description: V-Rally 3 delivers the ultimate rally racing experience across five continents with over 80 meticulously crafted stages. Master the art of rally driving through diverse terrains from Kenya's dusty savannas to Sweden's icy forests, each demanding unique racing techniques. Choose from 20 officially licensed rally cars including Subaru Impreza, Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution, and Ford Focus RS, each with authentic handling characteristics. The revolutionary V-Rally Mode creates an immersive career where you manage your team, hire mechanics, and compete for championship glory. Time Attack mode challenges you to shave precious seconds off your best times, while the 4-player split-screen multiplayer brings intense wheel-to-wheel competition. With dynamic weather effects and realistic physics, every race becomes a thrilling battle against the clock and the elements.

title: Van Helsing
description: Hunt legendary monsters in this action-packed adaptation of the 2004 film, featuring Hugh Jackman reprising his role as the famed vampire hunter. Drawing inspiration from Devil May Cry's combat style, wield dual handguns and deadly Tojo blades as you battle werewolves, vampires, and Dracula's minions across gothic Transylvania. Master a fluid combat system that seamlessly blends gunplay with melee attacks, performing stylish combos to dispatch supernatural foes. Discover enhanced ammunition that bathes Van Helsing in blue energy, unleashing devastating attacks on enemies. Navigate treacherous environments using your grappling hook to reach high ledges and chain aerial combos. Execute evasive rolls to dodge incoming attacks while maintaining offensive pressure. Acquire iconic weapons from the film including shotguns and bow guns as you progress. One of the few PS2 games supporting 480p, this delivers cinematic monster-hunting action with film-authentic voice acting.

title: Vexx
description: Embark on a dark fantasy adventure as Vexx, a young warrior seeking revenge against the evil Dark Yabu who destroyed his village and enslaved his people. Armed with powerful War Talons - mystical gauntlets that grant incredible combat abilities - battle through sprawling 3D platforming worlds filled with dangerous creatures and challenging puzzles. Master devastating combo attacks, wall-climbing, and gliding mechanics as you collect Shadowraith Hearts to unlock new realms. Each massive level offers multiple objectives and hidden secrets to discover. From frozen mountain peaks to underwater temples, volcanic forges to desert ruins, explore diverse environments while upgrading your abilities. With its edgy protagonist, fluid acrobatic combat system, and blend of platforming with beat-em-up action, Vexx delivers a unique twist on the 3D adventure genre that rewards exploration and mastery.

title: Vietcong: Purple Haze
description: Step into the boots of Sergeant First Class Steve Hawkins and experience the brutal intensity of the Vietnam War in this tactical first-person shooter. Navigate through dense jungles, treacherous tunnels, and war-torn villages as you lead your squad through 19 harrowing missions. Purple Haze delivers authentic Vietnam-era combat with period-accurate weapons including M16s, AK-47s, and deadly booby traps. Command your AI squadmates using tactical orders, call in devastating napalm strikes and artillery support, and engage in fierce firefights against Viet Cong guerrillas. The game features both stealth and all-out assault gameplay, letting you choose your approach through each mission. Experience the chaos of jungle warfare with immersive sound design and atmospheric visuals that capture the tension of Vietnam combat.

title: Virtual Pool: Tournament Edition
description: Virtual Pool: Tournament Edition delivers the most realistic pool simulation on Xbox, featuring precision physics that replicate every nuance of real billiards. Master 8-ball, 9-ball, rotation, and straight pool across beautifully rendered tables in stunning venues. The revolutionary aiming system offers multiple difficulty levels, from helpful guidelines for beginners to pure skill-based play for experts. Challenge AI opponents with distinct playing styles or compete against friends in intense multiplayer matches. Practice mode lets you perfect your technique with instant replay analysis. Authentic ball physics account for spin, speed, and table conditions, while the career mode takes you from local halls to championship tournaments. With its deep gameplay mechanics and accessible controls, this is pool perfection.

title: Voodoo Vince
description: Step into the oversized shoes of Voodoo Vince, a wisecracking burlap voodoo doll brought to life in this quirky 3D platformer. When your creator Madam Charmaine is kidnapped by the villainous Kosmo the Inscrutable, you must bounce, spin, and punch your way through the mystical French Quarter of New Orleans to save her. Embrace your curse by inflicting damage on yourself to unleash devastating voodoo powers on enemies - set yourself on fire, get squashed by anvils, or impale yourself with pins to clear rooms of foes. Navigate through 30+ twisted levels filled with jazz music, bayou swamps, and carnival madness. Collect zombie dust beads, solve puzzles, and master unique gameplay where hurting yourself is the key to victory in this darkly humorous adventure.

title: Wakeboarding Unleashed Featuring Shaun Murray
description: Hit the water with pro wakeboarder Shaun Murray in this extreme sports masterpiece that revolutionizes wakeboarding games. Shred across exotic locations from Venice to Lake Powell, pulling off insane tricks using the innovative control system that lets you tweak grabs and spins mid-air. Master over 85 tricks including tantrums, raileys, and 1080s while launching off massive wakes and grinding rails. The groove meter rewards style and flow, unlocking special moves when you chain combos perfectly. Challenge legends like Dallas Friday and Darin Shapiro across multiple game modes including co-op tandem riding. With realistic rope physics, dynamic water effects, and a killer soundtrack featuring hip-hop and rock tracks, this delivers the most authentic wakeboarding experience on Xbox.

title: Wallace & Gromit in Project Zoo
description: Join Wallace & Gromit in a hilarious zoo rescue adventure! The dastardly penguin Feathers McGraw has captured baby animals and it's up to the inventive duo to save them. Play as both Wallace and Gromit across six themed zoo zones, from the Jungle House to the Ice House. Use Wallace's contraptions like the Banana Launcher and Porridge Gun to overcome obstacles and defeat Feathers' diamond-stealing schemes. Switch between characters to solve puzzles - Gromit can crawl through small spaces while Wallace operates machinery. Collect nuts and bolts to unlock bonus content and mini-games. With classic British humor, colorful environments, and cooperative gameplay mechanics, this family-friendly platformer brings the beloved claymation characters to life in an all-new caper filled with invention and adventure.

title: Wallace & Gromit: The Curse of the Were-Rabbit
description: Join Wallace & Gromit in a hilarious adventure based on the Oscar-winning film! Play as both the cheese-loving inventor and his loyal dog Gromit as you protect the town's precious vegetables from the mysterious Were-Rabbit. Use Wallace's wacky inventions like the BunGun 6000 and Mind-O-Matic to capture rabbits humanely. Switch between characters to solve puzzles - Wallace handles gadgets while Gromit uses his agility to reach new areas. Explore West Wallaby Street and surrounding neighborhoods in this charming platformer filled with British humor. Complete mini-games, collect cheese, and uncover clues about the Were-Rabbit's identity. Features authentic voice acting, clay-styled graphics that capture Aardman's signature animation style, and family-friendly gameplay that stays true to the beloved characters.

title: Warpath
description: Lead your armies across devastated future battlefields in this intense real-time strategy experience. Command three distinct factions - the United States, Russia, and China - each with unique units, technologies, and tactical advantages. Deploy massive war machines including tanks, artillery, and experimental weapons as you fight for global dominance. The innovative territory control system lets you capture and fortify strategic points, establishing supply lines crucial for victory. Engage in brutal campaigns across multiple continents or test your skills in skirmish battles. Advanced AI opponents adapt to your strategies, ensuring every battle feels fresh. Destructible environments add tactical depth as you reshape the battlefield with explosive weaponry. Experience the chaos of modern warfare with stunning graphics and explosive combat that pushes the boundaries of console strategy gaming.

title: The Warriors
description: Based on Rockstar's cult classic film, The Warriors delivers intense street brawling action across 1970s New York City. Lead the Warriors gang through 20 missions mixing brutal hand-to-hand combat with stealth gameplay. Master devastating combos, wield improvised weapons from bats to bricks, and execute synchronized gang attacks. Experience events before the film in flashback missions that expand the Warriors' origin story. Each of the nine playable gang members brings unique fighting styles and abilities. Tag walls to mark territory, steal car radios for cash, and engage in fierce multiplayer rumbles. The game's gritty atmosphere captures the film's raw energy through cel-shaded visuals, authentic voice acting from original cast members, and a pulsing soundtrack. Fight rival gangs from the Baseball Furies to the Hi-Hats as you battle your way from Coney Island to the Bronx.

title: Whacked!
description: Enter the twisted world of Whacked!, where seven deranged contestants battle for their ultimate prize - a starring role in their own game show! This anarchic party combat game throws you into outrageous arenas filled with deadly obstacles and ridiculous weapons. Choose from a cast of unhinged characters including a demented rabbit, a psychotic clown, and a cannibalistic hillbilly, each with unique abilities and twisted backstories. Battle through insane game show challenges across surreal environments from prehistoric jungles to outer space. Unleash chaos with over-the-top weapons like giant hammers, explosive chickens, and missile-launching briefcases. Features frantic 4-player split-screen mayhem and Xbox Live support for online carnage. With its dark humor, cartoon violence, and non-stop action, Whacked! delivers pure multiplayer madness.

title: Whiplash
description: Take control of an unlikely duo - a wisecracking rabbit and a cynical weasel - chained together in this action-platformer adventure. Escape from the evil Genron Corporation's animal testing facility using teamwork and chaos. Swing Redmond the rabbit like a weapon while Spanx the weasel provides sarcastic commentary. Destroy corporate property for points and upgrades in environments filled with hazardous machinery and security systems. Use unique chain-based combat mechanics to battle guards and free other test animals. Experience humor-filled dialogue between the mismatched heroes as they wreak havoc through office buildings and laboratories. Master cooperative gameplay where both characters' abilities are essential for solving puzzles and defeating enemies in this satirical take on corporate greed.

title: Whiteout
description: Race through extreme winter conditions in Whiteout, Konami's adrenaline-pumping snowmobile racer that brings snocross action to your console.
