Originally developed as an ESPN Winter X Games title before being retooled, this intense racing game captures the thrill of high-speed snowmobile competition across treacherous mountain courses. Pull off death-defying tricks while battling opponents through snow-covered tracks filled with massive jumps, sharp turns, and dangerous obstacles. Master the physics-based handling as you navigate icy terrain, deep powder, and frozen landscapes that challenge your racing skills. Engage in aggressive combat racing, using strategic bumps and collisions to gain the advantage over rivals. Multiple game modes offer varied challenges from traditional races to trick competitions where style matters as much as speed. With its blend of arcade action, spectacular stunts, and competitive racing, Whiteout delivers pure winter racing excitement.

title: WinBack 2: Project Poseidon
description: WinBack 2: Project Poseidon delivers intense tactical third-person shooting action where every decision counts. Master the innovative cover system as you lead a team of elite operatives through 30 adrenaline-pumping missions against a deadly terrorist organization. Switch between three unique characters - each with specialized weapons and abilities - adapting your strategy on the fly. The game's signature Route system creates branching paths through levels, ensuring fresh experiences with each playthrough. Execute precision shots, coordinate devastating team attacks, and use environmental tactics to outsmart enemies. With its emphasis on strategic positioning, split-second timing, and methodical combat over run-and-gun action, WinBack 2 rewards patience and planning. Experience gripping covert operations across diverse locations from cargo ships to urban battlegrounds in this underrated gem of tactical shooting.

title: Wings of War
description: Take to the skies in Wings of War, where you pilot authentic WWI fighter planes through intense dogfights over the battlefields of Europe. Master the controls of legendary aircraft like the Sopwith Camel and Fokker Dr.I triplane as you engage in thrilling aerial combat missions. Execute barrel rolls, loop-the-loops, and diving attacks while managing your ammunition and fuel in strategic campaigns. Battle through historically-inspired missions from both Allied and Central Powers perspectives, each offering unique challenges and objectives. The game features realistic flight physics that reward skillful piloting, dynamic weather conditions that affect combat, and multiplayer dogfight modes where aces clash in spectacular aerial duels. Experience the dawn of aerial warfare with stunning visuals that bring the Great War's dramatic sky battles to life.

title: Without Warning
description: Experience intense third-person action as you fight to save innocent lives from ruthless terrorists who've seized a massive chemical plant. Switch between six unique playable characters - including special forces operatives, a cameraman, and security guards - each offering distinct perspectives of the unfolding crisis. Navigate through 12 hours of real-time gameplay where every second counts and your choices determine who lives or dies. Master an arsenal of authentic weapons while using strategic cover mechanics to survive deadly firefights. The innovative multi-character system lets you experience the same terrifying events from different viewpoints, revealing crucial story elements and hidden paths. With its cinematic presentation, branching narratives, and relentless pacing, Without Warning delivers a gripping counter-terrorism thriller where heroism comes in many forms.

title: World Championship Poker
description: World Championship Poker brings the intensity of high-stakes poker to your Xbox with an immersive tournament experience. Master Texas Hold'em, Omaha, Seven Card Stud, and more as you compete against sophisticated AI opponents with distinct playing styles and personalities. The career mode lets you build your reputation from local card rooms to the World Series of Poker, earning sponsorships and unlocking new venues along the way. Create your custom player with detailed appearance options and develop your own playing style. Features include comprehensive tutorials for beginners, advanced statistics tracking, and online multiplayer for up to 7 players. The game captures authentic poker atmosphere with realistic chip sounds, table animations, and professional commentary that responds dynamically to your plays.

title: World Championship Poker 2: Featuring Howard Lederer
description: Master the art of the bluff in World Championship Poker 2: Featuring Howard Lederer, the ultimate Texas Hold'em experience. Learn from poker legend Howard Lederer himself through exclusive tutorial videos and commentary that reveal professional strategies and insider tips. Test your skills against sophisticated AI opponents with realistic playing styles, or challenge friends in multiplayer tournaments. Create your custom avatar and work your way up from local card rooms to the prestigious World Championship. With multiple poker variants including Omaha and Seven Card Stud, detailed statistics tracking, and authentic casino atmospheres, this comprehensive poker simulation delivers the tension and excitement of high-stakes play. Every hand counts as you build your bankroll and reputation on the path to poker greatness.

title: World Championship Pool 2004
description: Rack 'em up with the world's greatest players in World Championship Pool 2004, the definitive billiards simulation featuring 24 real-life professional legends. Play as or against champions like Efren Reyes, Earl Strickland, and snooker icons Tony Drago and Steve Davis, each with authentic playing styles and techniques. Master multiple pool variants including 8-Ball, 9-Ball, and Snooker across beautifully rendered tables in prestigious venues. The advanced physics engine perfectly replicates ball spin, speed, and table friction for the most realistic pool experience on console. Build your career from local halls to world championship tournaments, improving your skills and earning respect. Practice mode offers comprehensive tutorials and shot analysis to perfect your technique. Challenge friends in multiplayer matches or test yourself against AI opponents that play like their real-world counterparts. With precise analog stick controls for cue positioning and power, this delivers authentic pool hall action.

title: World Championship Rugby
description: Experience the intensity of international rugby in World Championship Rugby, where strategic gameplay meets bone-crushing action. Take control of 20 national teams and compete in authentic tournaments including the World Championship and Six Nations. Master the game's deep tactical system - call set plays, execute perfectly-timed passes, and break through defenses with powerful runs. The innovative kicking system demands precision for conversions and penalties, while dynamic weather conditions affect ball handling and player performance. Create custom tournaments, develop your squad through training modes, and experience realistic rucks, mauls, and scrums. With full commentary, authentic stadium atmospheres, and multiple difficulty levels, this delivers the complete rugby union experience on Xbox.

title: World Championship Snooker 2003
description: Step into the baize-covered world of professional snooker with World Championship Snooker 2003, where precision meets pressure in the most authentic simulation of the sport. Master the art of cue ball control across multiple game modes including full tournaments, trick shot challenges, and quick matches. Face off against snooker legends like Ronnie O'Sullivan and Stephen Hendry, each with unique playing styles and AI behaviors that mirror their real-world counterparts. The advanced physics engine captures every nuance from spin and swerve to the satisfying crack of a perfect break. Build your career from amateur halls to the crucible of the World Championship, earning ranking points and prize money along the way. With commentary from John Virgo and detailed TV-style presentation, every frame feels like a broadcast masterpiece.

title: World Championship Snooker 2004
description: Step into the baize-covered world of professional snooker with World Championship Snooker 2004, the most authentic simulation of the sport. Experience the tension of the Crucible Theatre as you compete against snooker legends including Ronnie O'Sullivan, Stephen Hendry, and Mark Williams. Master precise cue control with the advanced aiming system that lets you apply spin, power, and swerve to every shot. Career mode takes you from qualifying rounds to the world championship final, while practice modes help perfect your technique. Features official tournaments, realistic ball physics, and commentary from John Virgo. Challenge friends in multiplayer or tackle trick shot challenges that test your skill and creativity.

title: World Poker Tour
description: Step into the world of high-stakes Texas Hold'em with World Poker Tour, the official game of the prestigious WPT championship series. Experience the thrill of professional poker as you compete in authentic WPT venues from Las Vegas to Monte Carlo. Master the art of bluffing, reading opponents, and strategic betting across multiple tournament formats including Sit N' Go, Season Mode, and Quick Play. Create your custom player avatar and climb the ranks from amateur tables to the final championship showdown. Advanced AI opponents provide realistic competition with unique playing styles and tells to exploit. Features include comprehensive poker tutorials for beginners, detailed statistics tracking, and authentic WPT presentation with commentary. Whether you're learning the basics or honing championship strategies, World Poker Tour delivers the complete poker experience with all the intensity and excitement of televised tournament play.

title: World Racing
description: Experience the ultimate street racing adventure across five continents in World Racing! Choose from over 100 licensed vehicles including sports cars, SUVs, and pickup trucks as you tackle 120+ challenging tracks spanning deserts, mountains, cities, and tropical islands. Master diverse racing disciplines from circuit races to point-to-point rallies, showcasing your skills across asphalt, dirt, ice, and sand surfaces. The innovative Speed Money system rewards aggressive driving - earn cash by drifting, jumping, and maintaining top speeds to unlock new vehicles and upgrades. Dynamic weather and day-night cycles add strategic depth to every race. Create custom championships, compete in extensive career mode, or challenge friends in split-screen multiplayer. With realistic physics and damage modeling, every race demands precision and nerve.

title: World Racing 2
description: World Racing 2 delivers an exhilarating open-world racing experience across five massive environments spanning over 100 square kilometers. Choose from 90+ licensed vehicles including sports cars, SUVs, and motorcycles as you tackle 120+ challenging races through diverse terrains from tropical beaches to snowy mountains. The revolutionary free-roaming gameplay lets you explore vast landscapes between events, discovering hidden shortcuts and secret areas. Dynamic weather and day-night cycles transform racing conditions in real-time, while the extensive tuning system allows deep customization of your vehicles' performance. Challenge friends in split-screen multiplayer or dominate the comprehensive career mode featuring multiple racing disciplines from street racing to rallycross.

title: World Series Baseball
description: Step up to the plate in World Series Baseball, where authentic Major League action meets arcade excitement. Command all 30 MLB teams with updated rosters and real player statistics. Experience the thrill of America's pastime through multiple game modes including Exhibition, Season, Playoffs, and Home Run Derby. The innovative pitcher-batter interface lets you paint the corners with precision pitches while batters must time their swings perfectly to connect. Dynamic fielding controls give you complete command over every play, from diving catches to double plays. Realistic ballpark atmospheres capture each stadium's unique character, complete with crowd reactions that respond to the action. Whether you're stealing bases, turning two, or launching a grand slam, every aspect of baseball strategy comes alive. Build dynasties in Franchise mode or jump into quick games for instant baseball action.

title: World Series Baseball 2K3
description: Step up to the plate in World Series Baseball 2K3, where authentic Major League Baseball action meets cutting-edge gameplay mechanics. Experience the thrill of America's pastime with all 30 MLB teams and their complete rosters from the 2003 season. Master the innovative pitch/swing interface that puts you in complete control of every at-bat, from painting corners with precision pitches to crushing home runs into the bleachers. Build dynasties in Franchise Mode, relive classic moments, or jump into quick exhibition games. Features ESPN's signature presentation style with dynamic commentary that brings each game to life. Whether you're turning double plays, stealing bases, or managing your bullpen in crucial situations, every decision matters on your road to the World Series.

title: World Series of Poker
description: Step into the world's most prestigious poker tournament without leaving your couch. World Series of Poker brings the thrill of high-stakes Texas Hold'em and other popular variants directly to your Xbox. Create your custom player and work your way from local casinos to the championship bracelet at the Rio in Las Vegas. Master your poker face with Xbox Live Vision camera support that reads your expressions, adding a psychological edge to online play. Challenge up to 8 players online or hone your skills against advanced AI opponents. Experience authentic WSOP atmosphere with commentary from Lon McEachern and Norman Chad. Unlock legendary pros like Chris Ferguson and Phil Hellmuth as you climb the ranks. With multiple game modes including tournaments, cash games, and the complete WSOP circuit, this is your chance to prove you have what it takes to become a poker legend.

title: World Snooker Championship 2005
description: Step into the baize-covered world of professional snooker with World Snooker Championship 2005, featuring all the tension and strategy of the sport's most prestigious tournament. Master precise cue control with an intuitive aiming system that captures every nuance of spin, power, and positioning. Play as or against snooker legends including Ronnie O'Sullivan, Stephen Hendry, and John Higgins across faithfully recreated venues like The Crucible Theatre. The comprehensive career mode lets you rise from amateur halls to championship glory, earning ranking points and prize money. Practice modes help perfect your technique, while multiplayer battles test your skills against friends. With realistic ball physics, authentic crowd atmosphere, and John Virgo's commentary, this delivers the definitive snooker experience on console.

title: World War II Combat: Iwo Jima
description: Experience the brutal Pacific Theater battles of World War II in this intense first-person shooter that recreates the legendary assault on Iwo Jima. Lead your squad of Marines through historically accurate campaigns, from the initial beach landings under heavy fire to the iconic flag-raising on Mount Suribachi. Command AI teammates using tactical squad controls, call in artillery strikes, and utilize authentic WWII weapons including M1 Garands, BARs, and flamethrowers. Navigate treacherous volcanic terrain while clearing out fortified Japanese bunkers and cave systems. Features both single-player campaign missions based on real battles and multiplayer modes supporting up to 32 players online.

title: World War II Combat: Road to Berlin
description: Lead your squad through the final, brutal campaigns of WWII in this intense tactical shooter. World War II Combat: Road to Berlin puts you in command of American forces pushing through war-torn Europe toward the Nazi capital. Experience authentic battlefield chaos across meticulously recreated historical battles including the Battle of the Bulge and the Rhine crossing. Switch between squad members on the fly, each with unique weapons and abilities. Use cover, flanking tactics, and coordinated assaults to overcome fortified German positions. The game features both American and Soviet campaigns, letting you experience the race to Berlin from both fronts. Destructible environments, realistic ballistics, and period-accurate weapons create visceral combat. Command tanks, call in artillery strikes, and lead desperate charges across no man's land.

title: Worms 3D
description: Take the classic Worms mayhem into the third dimension! Command your team of heavily-armed invertebrates across fully 3D landscapes where strategy takes on new depths. Navigate destructible environments with enhanced movement options including jetpacks and ninja ropes while wielding an arsenal of over 40 weapons from the iconic Holy Hand Grenade to the devastating Banana Bomb. The shift to 3D transforms tactical gameplay as you calculate trajectories around obstacles, hide behind cover, and rain destruction from above. Create custom teams with unique voices and personalities, then battle through single-player missions or engage in explosive multiplayer matches. With random map generation ensuring no two battles play the same, plus the series' signature humor and customization options, Worms 3D delivers turn-based tactical warfare where every angle matters and one well-placed shot can change everything.

title: Worms 4: Mayhem
description: Unleash cartoon chaos in Worms 4: Mayhem, where tactical warfare meets slapstick comedy! Command your team of militaristic invertebrates through fully 3D battlefields, customizing everything from their appearance to their victory dances. The weapons workshop lets you craft insane armaments - combine multiple effects to create the ultimate sheep-launching, poison-spreading super weapon. Story mode delivers 25 missions of strategic mayhem across five themed worlds, while multiplayer supports up to 4 players in explosive turn-based combat. Master wind physics, destructible terrain, and an arsenal of over 40 weapons including the iconic Holy Hand Grenade and Concrete Donkey. With its signature British humor and endless customization options, Worms 4: Mayhem transforms strategy gaming into pure comedic destruction.

title: Worms Forts: Under Siege
description: Build mighty fortresses and wage hilarious warfare in Worms Forts: Under Siege! Command your team of militant worms through epic siege battles where strategy meets mayhem. Construct medieval castles, Egyptian pyramids, and oriental temples, then defend them with an arsenal of outrageous weapons. Launch explosive sheep, deploy the devastating Concrete Donkey, or unleash the Holy Hand Grenade on enemy strongholds. Each structure you build affects gameplay - towers provide vantage points, hospitals heal troops, and science labs unlock devastating superweapons. With destructible environments, tactical fort-building, and the series' signature humor, every battle becomes a chaotic masterpiece of strategic destruction and cartoon carnage.

title: Wrath Unleashed
description: Command divine armies in Wrath Unleashed, a unique strategy hybrid where chess-like tactics meet mythological combat. Choose from four demigods - water goddess Aenna, fire warrior Epothos, earth master Durlock, or wind queen Helamis - each wielding elemental powers in the eternal struggle between Light and Darkness, Order and Chaos. Position mythical creatures across hexagonal battlefields representing different terrains, strategically moving troops to capture enemy temples. When opposing forces clash, gameplay shifts to intense arena battles where you directly control your creature in fights to the death. Master each faction's unique units from fire giants to cyclopes, utilizing their strengths across varied terrain types. Deploy godly powers to heal troops, teleport armies, or unleash devastating attacks. Four campaign stories narrated by Mako Iwamatsu explore each deity's path to dominion. This innovative blend of tactical board game and action combat creates a divine war unlike any other.

title: Wreckless: The Yakuza Missions
description: Race through the neon-lit streets of Hong Kong in this explosive arcade racer where chaos is your weapon. Choose between elite police officers or government spies as you smash through the criminal underworld using your car as a battering ram. Wreckless delivers pure vehicular mayhem with its revolutionary physics engine that lets you demolish everything in sight - from market stalls to entire buildings. Each mission throws you into spectacular high-speed chases where causing maximum destruction is the goal. Plow through traffic, launch cars into the air, and trigger massive chain-reaction crashes across Hong Kong's bustling districts. With two distinct campaigns, unlockable vehicles, and an emphasis on spectacular collateral damage over traditional racing, this is driving combat at its most anarchic.

title: WTA Tour Tennis
description: Experience the intensity of professional women's tennis in WTA Tour Tennis, where you compete as or against the world's top female players. Master authentic stroke mechanics including topspin, slice, and power shots across multiple court surfaces from hard courts to clay and grass. Each surface demands different strategies, affecting ball speed and bounce dynamics. Create your own player and rise through the rankings in Career Mode, or jump into quick Exhibition matches and tournaments. The game features realistic player animations and signature playing styles of WTA stars, bringing their unique strengths to life. Time your serves perfectly, execute strategic drop shots, and unleash powerful baseline rallies in this comprehensive tennis simulation that captures the athleticism and excitement of the women's professional tour.
